jobs.title: Sr. Security Engineer (Penetration Testing)
jobs.excerpt: Why Us? CertiK is a pioneer in blockchain security, leveraging best-in-class AI technology to protect and monitor blockchain protocols and smart contracts.
jobs.description:
Why Us?

CertiK is a pioneer in blockchain security, leveraging best-in-class AI technology to protect and monitor blockchain protocols and smart contracts. Founded in 2018 by professors from Yale University and Columbia University, CertiK’s mission is to secure the web3 world. CertiK applies cutting-edge innovations from academia to enterprise, enabling mission-critical applications to scale with safety and correctness.

About the Role

The primary responsibility of this role is for CertiK’s security-related services. Intersecting cybersecurity and blockchain, CertiK’s security offerings include security consulting, security reviews, security auditing of smart contracts and blockchains, verification of smart contracts, penetration testing, and more. We are looking to hire someone with a passion for application security and penetration testing. This is a fun and challenging full-time position. If you are excited about hacking, threat modeling, scanning, auditing, designing, and enhancing the security of applications across the board then you will thrive in this role. While you work with clients, we will also provide you with plenty of opportunities to get involved with research and development efforts to help us raise the standards of blockchain security.

Responsibilities

  • Perform security assessments on web, mobile, thick client applications, and browser extensions
  • Conduct external and internal network penetration tests
  • Perform security source code reviews
  • Perform cloud security reviews
  • Develop comprehensive pentest reports for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Research and develop innovative techniques, tools, and methodologies for pentesting applications in the blockchain space
  • Contribute to the community by developing tools, presentations, and blog posts

Requirements

  • Passionate about cryptocurrency, DeFi, and blockchain, with a willingness to learn Web3 technologies such as smart contracts
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in application security and penetration testing
  • Experienced in source code review for different languages, with a strong understanding of JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Experienced in mobile application penetration testing
  • Familiar with cloud platforms and their security risks, such as AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Experience in programming with scripting languages such as Python and Bash
  • Solid understanding of cryptography
  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or Information Security
  • Strong spoken and written communication skills

Bonus Points

  • Experienced in pentesting Web3 applications such as crypto exchanges, wallets, Dapps, and key custodian solutions
  • Experienced in smart contract security audits
  • Familiar with browser extension architecture and security risks
  • Actively participate in the blockchain security community
  • OSCP, OSWE, OSCE, GWAPT, or comparable certification
  • Participated in bug bounty programs and audit contests
  • Published security-related blog posts and spoken at security conferences and/or local meetups

About the Company

One of the fastest-growing and most trusted companies in blockchain security, CertiK is a true market leader. To date, CertiK has worked with over 3,200 Enterprise clients, secured over $310 billion worth of digital assets, and has detected over 60,000 vulnerabilities in blockchain code. Our clients include leading projects such as Aave, Polygon, Binance Smart Chain, Terra, Yearn, and Chiliz.
Investors = Insight Partners, Sequoia, Tiger Global, Coatue Management, Lightspeed, Advent International, SoftBank, Hillhouse Capital, Goldman Sachs, Coinbase Ventures, Binance, Shunwei Capital, IDG Capital, Wing, Legend Star, Danhua Capital and other investors.

Compensation

Target annual base salary for this role performed in the US is $100,000 - $180,000. The exact compensation at which this job is filled will be determined by the skills and experience of qualified candidates.

CertiK also offers a variable commission program for business development sales roles.

jobs.title: Bid Administrator (Mexico Remote)
jobs.excerpt: The Bid Administrator role drives operational efficiency across the bid lifecycle, by managing global procurement portals, internal tracking, and cross-functional SME contributions to ensure on-time completion of RFP/Tender submissions.
jobs.description:
The Bid Administrator role drives operational efficiency across the bid lifecycle, by managing global procurement portals, internal tracking, and cross-functional SME contributions to ensure on-time completion of RFP/Tender submissions. Above all, it serves as the primary knowledgebase administrator, optimizing the central knowledgebase, aligning messaging with product updates, and maintaining strict brand and quality standards across all proposal assets. Together with the rest of the Bid Management team, this role primarily involves internal collaboration with teams such as Product, Marketing, Legal, and Sales, with occasional direct customer or prospect engagement.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the end to end administrative process for security questionnaires, RFPs/Tenders and any procurement documentation.
  • Maintain internal RFP/Tender tracking mechanisms to ensure real-time accuracy.
  • Manage e-procurement portal requirements from end to end, including constraint identification and credential maintenance. Manage, configure and refine alert monitoring to ensure high-accuracy capture of relevant global opportunities.
  • Proactively monitor automated tender scraping systems to identify new and current RFP/Tender opportunities globally, executing a timely triage process to initiate the qualification cycle.
  • Design and continually optimize the content repository structure, ensuring ease of access, security and data integrity.
  • Systematically curate and structure the content repository to optimise searchability and auto-fill performance across proposal management platforms, ensuring automated responses draw from verified master content.
  • Proactively collaborate with a cross-functional network of SMEs where knowledge reviews may be required, consolidating input and editing it into a defined style, tone of voice, ensuring that it is clearly articulated and easy to integrate into a proposal.
  • Partner with Bid Management team members to coordinate and complete standardized proposal documentation, independently executing administrative submissions (e.g., standard declarations, compliance forms) and liaising with cross-functional teams to gather required supporting documentation.
  • Schedule and lead review cycles of the content repository to ensure all baseline text remains accurate and secure, and identify outdated or missing content. Refine new responses from completed bids to add back into the system. Perform manual updates, archiving, and tagging of master response sets.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to maintain available standardized master document sets, including up-to-date templates and pre-written technical responses.
  • Assist with QA reviews on ongoing RFPs/Tenders to ensure compliance, accuracy, tone and consistency across submissions.
  • Utilizing the feedback from win/loss reviews to refine and improve response templates for future opportunities.
  • Actively participate in professional development opportunities and Bid Management best-practice sessions to continually sharpen skills.

Essential:

  • 2+ years experience as a Bid Administrator, Tender Coordinator, or an equivalent combination of education and experience to successfully perform the key responsibilities of the job.
  • Higher Education level, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (docs, sheets, slides) and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel)
  • Excellent organizational skills including accuracy, timeliness, and detail orientation, with a proven ability to work well while managing multiple activities and consistently meeting established goals under tight deadline pressures.
  • Advanced skills in database / knowledge management administration, platform maintenance and structuring complex knowledge bases for quick retrieval.
  • Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal).
  • Ability to work local hours for the EMEA region.

Preferred:

  • Industry Experience: Knowledge and experience working in Enterprise software/SaaS or EdTech sector.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: At least 2 years of experience working closely with diverse departmental streams, including Sales, Managers, Technical Teams, Developers, and Administrative staff, to source and shape proposal content.
  • Multilingual Capability: Professional fluency in Spanish (or additional major European languages) is strongly preferred to support seamless navigation of global procurement portals and international market requirements.
  • Professional Certification: APMP certification (Foundation level)

Total Rewards @ Turnitin
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.

Our Mission is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.

Our Values underpin everything we do.

  • Customer Centric: Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
  • Passion for Learning: We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
  • Integrity: Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
  • Action & Ownership: We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
  • One Team: We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
  • Global Mindset: We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

Global Benefits

  • Remote First Culture
  • Health Care Coverage*
  • Education Reimbursement*
  • Competitive Paid Time Off
  • Self-Care Days
  • National Holidays*

Seeing Beyond the Job Ad
At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad. We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.

Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. jobs.title: Team Lead, Android Core Product
jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Tech Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
Availity delivers revenue cycle and related business solutions for health care professionals who want to build healthy, thriving organizations. Availity has the powerful tools, actionable insights and expansive network reach that medical businesses need to get an edge in an industry constantly redefined by change.

At Availity, we're not just another Healthcare Technology company; we're pioneers reshaping the future of healthcare! With our headquarters in vibrant Jacksonville, FL, and an exciting office in Bangalore, India, along with an exceptional remote workforce across the United States, we're a global team united by a powerful mission.

We're on a mission to bring the focus back to what truly matters, patient care. As the leading healthcare engagement platform, we're the heartbeat of an industry that impacts millions. With over 2 million providers connected to health plans and processing over 13 billion transactions annually, our influence is continually expanding.

Join our energetic, dynamic, and forward-thinking team where your ideas are celebrated, innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. We're transforming the healthcare landscape, solving communication challenges, and creating connections that empower the nation's premier healthcare ecosystem.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Technical Account Management Services, the Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as a liaison between Availity’s technical teams, health plan analyst, Strategic Account Managers (SAS) and the strategic health plan partners, ensuring that the products or services align with the customers' technical needs and business objectives. TAMs are responsible for ensuring customer success by proactively building, maintaining, and expanding relationships with our strategic Payer Partners to advance the direction of Availity in the healthcare information technology marketplace. TAMs will focus on becoming a Trusted Advisor to the clients, coordinate cross-functional efforts, manage timelines, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards. TAMs will provide exceptional customer service and support to build strong, long-term relationships with clients. Providing thought leadership and delivering account management excellence. The TAM is an expert on their book of business and represents the voice of the customer internally and the interests of the organization externally. The TAM is an expert communicator and relationship builder that implements key marketing strategies to enhance the company's position. Some travel is required.

Sponsorship, in any form, is not available for this position.

Why do you want to work for this team:

  • This is a fast-paced, flexible, and collaborative work environment where you are encouraged to bring your authentic self every day in the pursuit of serving our clients.
  • This position gives exposure to multiple areas within Availity and is a great career path to future Account Management roles within the company.

To be qualified for this role you:

  • Have at least 3 years of account OR customer management experience in healthcare, payer, provider relations, or technology environment.
  • Have an associate degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or equivalent work experience, bachelor’s degree a plus.
  • Have strong interpersonal skills. Experience facilitating meetings and engaging with multiple stakeholders at all levels of the organization is vital.
  • Team player that works in support of others and in close collaborative partnership.
  • Have knowledge of healthcare payer processing, provider/hospital office operations, customer service and IT operations.
  • Are a trusted problem-solver who listens to business problems and can provide potential solutions.
  • Interpret technical issues and translate them into actionable business impacts for executive and operational audiences.
  • You have exceptional customer service skills.
  • Have strong analytical and research skills with ability to guide client based on analytical data.
  • Monthly monitoring, and creation of SLA adherence and process improvement based on output.
  • Leveraging data to identify opportunities for operational improvement, payer adoption growth, and issue prevention.
  • Highly motivated, self-starting, and proactive – not reactive. Maintain awareness of all active implementations, production support efforts, strategic programs, and roadmap initiatives impacting assigned accounts.
  • Identify dependencies, risks, blockers, and competing priorities that may impact client outcomes.
  • Ability to see the bigger picture and have demonstrated ability to use discretion and make sound decisions.
  • Have HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) knowledge.
  • Demonstrated leadership and ability to remain collaborative within high stakes environments (ability to remain calm during internal/external escalations)

What will set you apart:

  • Serve as the primary operational escalation point for strategic payer partners, coordinating cross-functional resources through solutioning or issue resolution.
  • You thrive in a rapidly changing and highly ambiguous environment.
  • Can effectively manage complex projects end-to-end ensuring high levels of satisfaction and execution.
  • Have knowledge of technical systems integration and internal operating systems e.g. Salesforce, Jira, Gainsight, Confluence.
  • Experience with a large national payer with complex operational, implementation, escalation, and governance needs across multiple business units and technical platforms.

What you will be doing:

  • Supporting the relationship between complex assigned accounts and Availity, and acts as a point of contact for accountability, issue escalation/resolution, and product implementations.
  • Supporting aspects of the re-contracting process including pricing, proposal, administration functions, preparation for negotiations and customer presentations.
  • Obtaining, utilizing, and accurately summarizing key competitive data to affect positive account growth.
  • Working with cross functional teams to coordinate and implement new functionality for assigned payers.
  • Staying current on industry and competitive trends and applies knowledge of marketplace to account planning processes.
  • Identifying and coordinating marketing, management, and technical resources necessary to achieve existing account up-sell objectives.
  • Communicating with accounts on a regular basis based on tier structure and need, via newsletters, email, phone, and/or face to face meetings.
  • Consults with Health Plan customers to identify and qualify opportunities to up-sell new products or services
  • Monitoring and supports retention through volume analysis and account penetration.
  • Reporting regularly on the progress and accomplishment of stated goals by updating metrics that track results.
  • Building strong inter-departmental relationships to achieve individual and Account Management team objectives.
  • Establishing, maintaining, and updating Relationship Account Plans with all assigned accounts.

Availity culture and benefits:

Availity is a certified "Great Place to Work," "Best Workplaces for Technology Companies," "Best Workplaces for Women," and "Best Workplaces for Millennials!"

Culture is important to us and there are many ways for you to make your mark here!

We have several Diversity & Inclusion teams and various ways to engage with fellow Availity associates. "AvaiLadies," "Beyond Black," "HOLA," "Availity Pride," "VetAvaility," Young Professionals Group, and "She Can Code IT" are just some of the communities you can get involved in.

Availity is a culture of continuous learning. We have many resources and experts across our organization to support your growth and career development.

We offer:

After you apply, you will receive text and email communications thanking you for applying and providing updates throughout the recruitment process.

jobs.description:
About Convergent Research

Convergent Research is a nonprofit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO). We design, launch, and support mission-driven, time-bound organizations built to solve important scientific and engineering bottlenecks.

FROs are designed to tackle the kinds of problems that benefit from unusual levels of focus, coordination, and scale. Convergent provides the operational backbone that allows FRO teams to move quickly—from legal formation, funding, hiring, finance, and governance to partnerships, communications, and operational systems.

We’ve now taken 14 FROs from idea to operating entity, including four launches in 2026. And we’re not slowing down.

About the Role

Turning an ambitious scientific idea into a functioning organization requires a lot more than good science.

There are entities to form, teams to hire, systems to stand up, funders and partners to coordinate, decisions to make, and approximately one million details that need to happen in the right order. At the same time, the founders doing this work are often building an organization for the first time.

That’s where you come in.

As our Program Launch Manager, you’ll sit at the center of the FRO lifecycle. You’ll help promising scientific projects become functioning organizations while also running large-scale founder programs that develop the next generation of FROs.

You’ll be part project manager, part operator, and part trusted partner. One minute you might be building a launch plan across legal, finance, people, and IT. The next, you’re helping a scientist understand an unfamiliar operational decision, chasing down a dependency that could delay launch, or making sure a founder residency participant has what they need to make progress.

This isn’t a traditional project-management or account-management role. Our systems and playbooks are still evolving, and every FRO is different. You’ll need to bring structure without creating bureaucracy, keep things moving without losing sight of the people involved, and turn what we learn from every launch into a better system for the next one.

You Are (Skills):

  • A project manager who can make ambiguity actionable. Give you a complicated goal with multiple teams, unclear dependencies, and a moving timeline, and you can turn it into a practical plan. You know who owns what, what needs to happen next, where the risks are, and which decisions are holding everything else up.

  • Operationally rigorous. You notice the details that matter. You keep accurate records, follow through reliably, and know that a small operational gap today can become a much larger problem three weeks from now.

  • People-centered and emotionally intelligent. Launching an organization can be exciting, confusing, stressful, and occasionally all three before lunch. You build trust quickly, meet people where they are, and know when to coach, facilitate, advise, push, or simply listen.

  • A confident, clear, proactive communicator. You can run an effective meeting, write a concise status update, ask the uncomfortable-but-important question, and translate complicated processes into something another human can actually understand. You’re equally comfortable working with scientists, founders, executives, vendors, funders, and functional specialists.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You’ve worked somewhere entrepreneurial—perhaps a startup, nonprofit, consultancy, research organization, or similar environment—where not every process came with an instruction manual. You bring structure while recognizing that the right answer may be different for every FRO.

  • A fan of functional systems. After doing something manually for the fifth time, you start wondering whether there’s a better way. You like turning bespoke work into useful processes, templates, documentation, and operating rhythms—and you’re interested in using automation and AI thoughtfully when they can make those systems better.

  • A great juggler. Multiple launches, founder programs, stakeholders, decisions, and deadlines don’t scare you. You can manage several workstreams at once, adjust when priorities change, and keep things moving without adding unnecessary process.

You Will (Duties):

  • Lead FRO launches. You’ll own the day-to-day coordination of one or more FRO launches, bringing together Convergent’s legal, finance, people, compliance, procurement, IT, fundraising, communications, and leadership teams. You’ll build and manage launch plans from proposal approval and funding commitment through entity formation, operational activation, team onboarding, and early FRO execution. You’ll run launch meetings, track decisions and dependencies, surface risks early, resolve blockers, and help coordinate launches across both U.S. and international contexts.

  • Run founder programs. You’ll own the operational delivery of FRO Founder Residencies, open calls, Launchpad programs, and other partner-led initiatives—from planning and participant onboarding through programming, selection, and closeout. You’ll coordinate program design, participant experience, and internal operational work while providing thoughtful, high-touch support to founders and teams.

  • Be a trusted partner to FRO founders. You’ll serve as a consistent and responsive point of contact for founders and FRO leaders during launch and early operations. You’ll help them understand Convergent’s operating model, systems, decision rights, governance expectations, and available support. You’ll advocate for their needs while also helping them navigate the realities of building a new organization.

  • Listen and learn. Every FRO teaches us something. You’ll create structured feedback loops with FRO teams to understand what is working, where friction exists, and what they need from Convergent. Then you’ll make sure those lessons actually go somewhere—sharing insights with internal teams and helping turn recurring pain points into improvements.

  • Help FROs become operationally independent. Convergent provides significant support during launch, but the goal is not for that support to last forever. You’ll track operational readiness, coordinate handoffs, and help teams move from temporary Convergent support toward durable internal ownership.

  • Make the launch system better. You’ll maintain and improve Convergent’s FRO Launch Playbook, templates, checklists, documentation, and operating rhythms. You’ll turn lessons from individual launches into repeatable processes, clearer systems, and useful metrics for future FROs. Where appropriate, you’ll use automation and AI to keep information, documentation, and tracking accurate and up to date.

  • Pitch in where needed. We’re still building the system while using it. Occasionally that means an unusual project, a new partner initiative, or something nobody has done before. You’ll be comfortable jumping in, figuring out what needs to happen, and helping make it happen.

In 6 Months, You Will Have:

  • Built trusted relationships across the FRO ecosystem. Founders, internal functional leads, and key external partners will know you as someone who understands their needs, communicates clearly, and follows through.

  • Taken ownership of one or more FRO launches. You’ll be running the launch plan and operating cadence, creating clarity across owners, milestones, decisions, dependencies, risks, and next steps.

  • Improved the way we launch FROs. You’ll have identified and meaningfully improved at least one part of the FRO launch process, playbook, or documentation system.

  • Created better visibility into our launch portfolio. Convergent teams and leadership will have a clearer picture of where launches stand, what needs attention, and what is coming next.

  • Helped prepare Convergent for the next generation of FROs. You’ll have contributed to upcoming residency, program, and launch work—and made the system stronger for the teams that come after you.

What You Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in project management, operations, program management, account management, implementation, consulting, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, cross-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Experience working directly with founders, executives, clients, partners, or other senior stakeholders.

  • Strong written, verbal, organizational, and follow-through skills.

  • Experience building or improving processes, playbooks, templates, or operating systems.

  • Comfort working independently in a distributed, rapidly changing environment.

Nice to Have:

  • Based on the U.S. East Coast, or comfortable working East Coast hours and supporting projects in the United Kingdom.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to support programs and events.

  • Experience launching or scaling a startup, nonprofit, research organization, lab, program, or other new initiative.

  • Experience working across countries, time zones, or international operating environments.

  • Experience supporting scientific, technical, or mission-driven teams.

  • Experience managing external vendors, consultants, institutional partners, or funders.

  • Familiarity with AI-enabled tools for documentation, reporting, workflow automation, or project management.

We Offer (Amazing Benefits):

  • A rare chance to build institutional architecture for frontier science and work with some of the smartest and most talented experts from different fields

  • Competitive Salary: The salary range for this role is $111,000 - 159,000 Convergent uses a consistent compensation philosophy across all roles. We benchmark salaries to San Francisco market data and aim for the grade midpoint, which for this role is approximately $159,000. We then apply a geographic adjustment if an employee is located outside of SF, NYC, or Boston, For example, in Denver, CO the midpoint for this role would be around $135k, and in Eugene, OR it would be $119k. We also maintain a minimum of 70% of the SF midpoint, which is reflected in the range floor. This structure helps us keep pay transparent, consistent, and equitable across locations while reflecting local market conditions.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

As a Principal Consultant in our Zero Trust Advisory practice, you will lead complex, client-facing engagements, translating advanced Zero Trust theory into resilient, real-world security architectures. You will serve as a senior technical and strategic advisor for our most sophisticated clients, shaping their security posture and driving high-value transformation. This role is pivotal in delivering elite advisory services while also scaling Unit 42's market-leading Zero Trust practice.

  • Lead Zero Trust transformations and turning complex security challenges into resilient architectures for enterprise clients.

  • Run security engagements that include Managing risk assessments, audits, policy development, and incident response tabletop exercises.

  • Act as a Trusted Advisor by translating business risks into actionable security plans for C-suite executives and technical teams.

  • Use knowledge of threat actors, MITRE ATT&CK, and AI security to improve client defenses.

  • Build Zero Trust roadmaps across Identity (IAM), network, endpoint, and cloud domains.

  • Identify vulnerabilities and audit enterprise architectures to find "hidden trust" zones and visibility gaps; design "least-privilege" controls.

  • Perform security assessments across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Ensure SASE, Identity, and XDR tools work together as one automated system.

  • Guide clients using NIST CSF, ISO, CIS, and CISA frameworks.

  • Oversee project scoping, budgets, and risk mitigation for multiple simultaneous engagements.

  • Drive growth of practice by identifying new opportunities, growing existing client relationships, drafting Statements of Work (SOWs), and responding to RFPs.

  • Create intellectual property, speak at industry events, and mentor junior team members.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Must speak English and Portuguese, Spanish a plus

  • 6+ years of experience leading cybersecurity advisory, risk management, or professional services engagements for enterprise clients.

  • Demonstrated expertise in designing end-to-end security architectures aligned with frameworks like NIST SP 800-207 and the CISA ZT Maturity Model.

  • Extensive experience performing information security and risk assessments based upon industry-accepted standards (e.g., NIST CSF, CIS 18, ISO 27001).

  • Hands-on experience with the implementation and administration of common GRC tools and technologies.

  • Demonstrated track record in strengthening existing and developing new client relationships.

  • Experience communicating complex technical concepts to both executive and engineering audiences.

  • ​​Expertise and deep knowledge in complex SOC and MSSP environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven track record of strengthening client relationships and contributing to business growth through pre-sales and solution positioning.

  • Experience architecting security solutions in hybrid and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Conduct comprehensive security assessments of AI systems and tools using frameworks such as:

    • MITRE ATLAS for adversarial tactics and techniques.

    • OWASP Top 10 for LLMs to identify vulnerabilities in AI/ML models.

    • NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) for risk analysis and mitigation.

  • Operational Technology cybersecurity expertise and experience with Palo Alto Networks technologies, including Prisma Access, NGFW, and Cortex XDR.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Zillow has built and acquired a portfolio of market-leading products for agent productivity, listing media, showing coordination, transaction management and analytics solutions. About the role

The Partner Analytics team within Business Data is hiring a Data Scientist to lead analytics to uncover insights to drive both better business decisions and customer experiences across our product portfolio.

What you'll do

  • Independently scope and deliver end-to-end data science projects, from problem framing through model development, validation, and productionization

  • Build and maintain industry performance and customer segmentation models, applying appropriate techniques (e.g., clustering, regression, tree-based models) and ensuring they are robust, interpretable, and actionable

  • Partner with Data Engineering and ML Engineering to deploy and maintain models in production, including feature development, batch/real-time scoring, and monitoring model performance over time

  • Design and analyze experiments and observational studies (A/B testing, causal inference) to evaluate product features and business initiatives

  • Translate ambiguous business problems into well-defined analytical approaches, selecting appropriate methodologies and success metrics

  • Provide data-driven recommendations to leaders, clearly communicating trade-offs, assumptions, and impact

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Follow Up Boss, Preferred, and zProto align on goals, define KPIs, and deliver integrated insights

  • Contribute to scalable data assets (clean datasets, metrics definitions, dashboards) that enable self-service analytics

Scope & impatc

  • Owns moderately complex problem areas with clear business impact, delivering solutions with limited oversight

  • Influences decision-making within their immediate domain and contributes to adjacent areas through collaboration

  • Balances speed and rigor, making sound trade-offs in modeling, experimentation, and analysis

  • Begins shaping team standards and improving how data science work is executed within the org

Who you are

  • Strong foundation in statistics, machine learning, and experimentation, with demonstrated ability to apply methods to real-world business problems

  • Proficient in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, PySpark) and SQL; comfortable working with large datasets in modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Spark)

jobs.description:
Creative Chaos is seeking a creative, strategic, and results-driven Social Media Lead to take charge of our multi-channel B2B social media presence.

We don’t do fluff and fillers for the sake of filling up empty space. We believe B2B content should spark curiosity, deliver real value, and make people feel seen. That’s where you come in.

We’re on the hunt for a Social Media Lead who blends creative storytelling, strategic thinking, and expert-level copywriting. Someone who knows how to write with purpose, tailor messages by platform and ideal customer profiles, and transform complex ideas into digestible yet insightful content. Someone who thrives at the intersection of data and creativity.

We’re not looking for just another social media manager. We want someone who gets internet culture, has experience with and truly understands B2B in the US, and can build a community—not just a following.

What you’ll do

  • Own and evolve our social media presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and Reddit — tailoring content for each platform while ensuring everything aligns with our brand SOPs, values, and voice.
  • Craft purposeful, valuable content — including social posts, captions, hooks, video scripts, carousels, and more — with clear, engaging, on-brand copy that speaks to the audience and drives action.
  • Be the copywriting voice of our brand on social. Your words will reflect our tone, vision, and personality — and you'll continuously refine them to make them sharper, smarter, and more memorable.
  • Create content that speaks to people, not at them. You’ll know how to make content feel personal and relevant — like a conversation that just gets them — and you’ll always keep strategy and audience intent at the core.
  • Understand the difference between valuable content and fluff. You’ll have a strong editorial filter. You can sense when a post lacks substance, when it tries too hard, or when it needs a stronger point of view.
  • Use AI smartly to streamline workflows, automate low-value tasks, and focus your energy on high-impact creative thinking and experimentation.
  • Become an expert on our ICPs (ideal customer profiles) — You’ll develop deep audience empathy and build content that resonates with their real struggles, questions, and goals.
  • Tell stories with strategy. You understand that behind every post should be a purpose — whether that’s brand awareness, lead generation, or community building — and you’ll craft narratives that serve both our goals and the audience’s needs.
  • Leverage analytics and insights to improve performance, guide decision-making, and evolve strategy. You won’t chase vanity metrics—you’ll care about the numbers that actually move the business.
  • Stay plugged into trends, publications, events, and industry conversations — and use those insights to fuel timely, relevant content that positions us as a forward-thinking voice in the space.
  • Foster community — You’ll reply, react, engage, and contribute in a way that makes people feel heard and valued, not just marketed to.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field
  • Proven 5 years of experience in managing social media platforms for a company or brand preferably in a SAAS based company.
  • Demonstrated experience managing B2B social media accounts with measurable success, ideally in a startup or fast-moving environment.
  • Familiarity with platforms like LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and Reddit — with real examples of how you've used them creatively and strategically.
  • Proficiency in tools like Hootsuite, HubSpot, or similar social media management platforms.
  • An eye for great content — You know what makes content scroll-stopping vs. scroll-pastable, and you have the judgment to create and help others create the former. You're not afraid to experiment but you always aim to bring clarity and substance to the audience.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and copywriting skills — with an obsession for clarity and tone.
  • Strong creative direction skills: you can translate strategy into visuals and copy that hit the mark.
  • Deep understanding of analytics, KPIs, and what it really takes to grow a brand online (not just followers, but engagement and conversion).
  • Curious, adaptable, and always learning — whether it's a new algorithm change or a podcast episode that sparks an idea.
  • Constantly learning — plugged into podcasts, communities, newsletters, and trends that fuel your thinking

Uniphar – Who we are.

With a workforce of more than 3500 employees spread across Ireland, United Kingdom, Mainland Europe, MENA, and the USA, Uniphar is a trusted global partner to pharma and MedTech manufacturers, working to improve patient access to medicines around the world. Uniphar provides outsourced and specialized services to its clients, leveraging strong relationships with 200+ of the world’s best-known pharmaco-medical manufacturers across multiple geographies, enabled by our cutting-edge digital technology and our highly expert teams. Uniphar is organized into three key divisions: Supply Chain & Retail, Global Sourcing, and Pharma. This position will support human resources across the US division.

Click here to find out more: About Us - Who we are | Uniphar

Culture at Uniphar

Uniphar is a combination of many businesses each with their own identity, culture, values, and ways of working. Uniphar lives and breathes four key pillars which unpin and support our culture.

We have a people first approach - we do the right thing. We support an entrepreneurial spirit where adaptability, commitment & resilience is embodied in our way of working. We have a Common Purpose that connects our diversified businesses and people. Finally, Trust is at the heart of how we operate.

Everything Uniphar does is enabled by our people, and, as we continue to grow domestically and internationally, we become more diverse. This diversity fuels our business and culture.

Sustainability

Sustainability is at the core of what we do and is deeply embedded in our business strategy. We want to contribute positively to the people and the world around us. Running our business in a sustainable way ensures that Uniphar will continue to prosper in the long-term. We are focused on ensuring that each of the five pillars of our sustainability strategy are a fundamental part of our decision-making process.

Role Overview:

The Senior Clinical Project Manager (Sr CPM) will be responsible for the overall execution of clinical operations activities on behalf of Uniphar Development Partners for trials spanning Phase I through Phase Ill.

The Sr CPM serves as the primary contact to Contract Research Organizations (CROs), Service Providers, site investigators, study personnel, as well as internal Uniphar Development functional areas, the Product Development Team (PDT) members, and the Partner to relay trial progress, status and/or issues associated with the daily operations of one or more clinical trials. The Sr CPM will be responsible for all aspects of the clinical trial from pre-study planning, protocol review, management of CRO(s) and other 'Service Providers, through clinical study report finalization for regulatory submission. The Sr CPM will ensure trial conductivity follows ICH-GCP, FDA/EMA, or other regulatory health authorities, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), as applicable. The Sr CPM will also ensure all operational trial deliverables are met according to project agreement(s), timelines, budget, operational procedures, and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manages all study-related activities to meet defined study timelines, stated goals, budgets, while ensuring GCP/ICH guidelines and the relevant SOPs are met
  • Responsible for vendor management as related to the study, in particular, oversight of CRO activities related to conduct of clinical studies
  • Leads internal study team meeting with functional area representatives
  • Responsible for leading and coordinating the development of study-related documents such as Clinical Project Plans, Informed Consent, Case Report Forms (CRFs), Monitoring Plan, Patient Diary, CRF Completion Guidelines, Safety Management Plans, Communication Plans, Clinical Study Quality Plans, and other relevant study plans and charters
  • Maintains primary responsibility for the content of all study-related operational manuals, such as study operations manuals, pharmacy manual, and Service Provider manuals
  • Oversees investigator recruitment/selection and the conduct of trials at investigative sites
  • Participate as necessary in monitoring visits (co-monitoring), reviews monitoring visit reports and letters, and ensures CRO quality within trials
  • Plans, executes, and leads Investigators' Meetings, if applicable; or may lead Site Initiation Visits, Clinical Research Associate (CRA)/Monitor training, and/or any other study related training
  • Tracks study progress ensuring timely data collection, query resolution, monitoring, protocol adherence through the review of protocol deviations and, in collaboration with data management, through internal listings reviews
  • Proactively escalates project-related issues to the Senior Management, or designee, to ensure timely resolution of issues
  • Responsible for the quality control of clinical data of the assigned studies / projects. Develops correction action plans, as necessary to ensure integrity of clinical data
  • Provides Senior Management with regular study updates/status reports on study execution
  • Contributes to knowledge management within Clinical Operations, proactively identifies potential study issues/risks and recommends/implements solutions, may lead lessons learned from previous studies to be considered in new study design and implementation
  • Supports the preparation of standard operating procedures within Uniphar Development for management of clinical programs
  • Assists in the planning of Data (Safety) Monitoring Boards, Safety Monitoring Committees, or other data review committees
  • Participation in qualification/audit activities of CROs
  • Reviews and provides input to vendor contracts and may contribute to contract and budget re-negotiation efforts
  • Manages invoice reconciliation from all Service Providers
  • Works closely with Uniphar Developments Project Management & Planning (PM&P) to forecast budgets (actual vs. projected) on a periodic basis, including budgets provided by Service Providers; provides input to the integrated study timelines
  • May be assigned sub-projects and may perform other duties as assigned by Uniphar Development Senior Management or designee

Qualifications:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent (background in life sciences preferred). Advanced degree is preferred.
  • Eight or more years of clinical trial research management experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or CRO setting with at least 2 years of project management experience; at least 4 years monitoring experience, with ability to independently perform all types of monitoring visits
  • Demonstrated experience in managing multiple or complex projects across Phase I through Ill, including global clinical trials with multiple-CRO partners preferred, from start-up to database-lock

THE POSITION:

Medical Information is a critically important customer-facing function that supports the safe and effective use of pharmaceutical company products by providing timely, scientifically balanced, evidence based, nonpromotional information in response to unsolicited requests from healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, and payers. Medical Information also plays an important role in post-marketing handling of adverse events and product complaints. As part of the Medical Information Contact Center (MICC) team, this position delivers industry-leading services, which include Contact Center staffing for responding to product information requests, identifying and handling of adverse events and/or product quality issues, and medical writing as needed to generate written response for use in response to medical questions received. This position requires clinical and therapeutic knowledge, critical and analytical thinking, and customer/patient-centric approach. Medical Information Specialists typically support multiple pharmaceutical clients, multiple products, and multiple therapeutic areas.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

MEDICAL INFORMATION SUPPORT

  • Respond to medical information inquiries from physicians, pharmacists, nurses, and other health care professionals, consumers, and payers. Utilize medical information skills to identify, research, and critically evaluate medical literature to create responses to medical information inquiries.
  • Utilize writing skills for adverse event and product complaint narrative during intake as well as medical inquiry custom responses.
  • Handle requests across multiple channels and platforms (phone, email, CRM, chat, etc.)
  • Identify adverse events and product complaints during interactions with customers. Perform intake sufficient to generate adverse event and product complaint reports in compliance with EVERSANA-MICC and client standard operating procedures. Knowledge of FDA’s postmarketing adverse event reporting regulations and safety terminology. Ability to make accurate assessments regarding what information needs to be obtained and level or depth of information to be collected.
  • Coordinate processes necessary for responding to product quality-related complaints. This process may involve interactions with personnel in the following departments: Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and the complainant.
  • Maintain product, therapeutic area, and client specific requirements knowledge.
  • Ensure good documentation, high quality, and excellent customer service.
  • Medical writing and Medical Information content development. Provide medical writing to assist in drafting of Medical Information response documents [FAQs, Scientific Response Documents (SRDs), Custom Response Documents (CRDs)] and/or work collaboratively with medical writing team to develop these materials.  Staffing at scientific medical affairs booths.
  • On-call responsibilities on an as assigned basis.
  • Miscellaneous projects such as market and competitive product research, operational and process improvements, field team training and field liaison support.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

jobs.description:
Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterprise

The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities — an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance — that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems.

For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Whether you're building this platform, proving its value to customers, or bringing it to market through our partner ecosystem, your work directly drives those outcomes for some of the most complex organizations in the world.

This is one of the most ambitious enterprise AI platforms in the market — built on decades of deep domain expertise across industries as varied as manufacturing, banking, insurance, financial services, and healthcare, and already running in production at real scale for organizations with some of the most demanding data and compliance requirements in the world. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications — with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry — this is where that work is happening.

Position Overview

The Engagement Manager is accountable for shaping, qualifying and governing customer engagements that deliver measurable business outcomes through Siemens Professional Services. Working across industries and a broad portfolio that includes Intelligence Center X (ICX), SLC, Mendix and other Siemens Digital Industries Software offerings, this role connects customer priorities, account strategy, solution architecture, commercial structure and delivery readiness.

The role owns the engagement lifecycle from early discovery and value framing through proposal, contracting, mobilization and executive governance. Success requires the ability to translate business needs into executable services engagements, build trusted relationships across customer and Siemens teams, protect delivery and commercial integrity, and expand the services pipeline through successful outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Account Strategy and Opportunity Development

  • Lead the Professional Services component of account plans across an assigned portfolio of customers and industries.

  • Partner with Sales, Portfolio Development, Presales, Solution Architects and Delivery leaders to identify, shape and prioritize services opportunities.

  • Connect customer business priorities to Siemens capabilities, defining outcome-oriented transformation roadmaps rather than isolated product deployments.

  • Build trusted relationships with customer executives, business leaders, technology stakeholders and delivery sponsors.

  • Maintain a qualified pursuit pipeline and contribute to bookings, revenue and growth objectives through expansion of existing accounts and development of new opportunities.

  • Bring relevant industry, portfolio and delivery insights into account strategy, customer workshops and executive discussions.

2. Discovery, Value Framing and Engagement Definition

  • Lead structured discovery to clarify the customer problem, desired outcomes, value hypotheses, operating constraints and measures of success.

  • Orchestrate the right Siemens and partner expertise across ICX, SLC, Mendix and adjacent products to define an integrated solution and services approach.

  • Translate discovery outputs into a clear engagement model, scope, deliverables, assumptions, dependencies, acceptance criteria and governance structure.

  • Develop defensible estimates, schedules, staffing models and commercials using approved Services Delivery Framework methods and tools.

  • Identify delivery, technical, commercial, security, data, adoption and organizational risks early, with explicit mitigations and ownership.

  • Prepare and review Statements of Work and related proposal content, ensuring alignment with global standards, legal requirements and customer expectations.

  • Engage Legal, Finance, Commercial, Product and leadership stakeholders when non-standard terms, complex dependencies or elevated risk require resolution.

3. Commercial and Financial Management

  • Ensure proposals are commercially viable, financially sound and structured to balance customer value with Siemens delivery risk.

  • Select the appropriate engagement and contracting model, including fixed-fee, time-and-materials, phased, pilot-to-scale and partner-supported approaches.

  • Optimize the delivery mix across local, nearshore, offshore, partner and contractor resources while preserving accountability, quality and required expertise.

  • Maintain accuratepursuit forecasts for bookings, revenue, cost, margin, resource demand and timing in the relevant business systems.

  • Provide peer reviews of proposals and support annual and quarterly services planning.

4. Delivery Mobilization and Governance

  • Bridge Sales and Delivery by leading a disciplined handover that confirms scope, customer commitments, commercials, risks, staffing and success criteria.

  • Work with Services leadership to secure appropriately skilled engagement leadership, project management, architecture and delivery resources.

  • Ensure effective project mobilization, customer onboarding, governance cadence, decision rights, escalation paths and working agreements.

  • Participate in executive steering committees, project reviews and account reviews to maintain alignment on outcomes, risks, decisions and commercial health.

  • Support the Project Manager and Delivery Lead in resolving scope, resource, dependency and commercial issues without displacing delivery accountability.

  • Identify expansion opportunities based on achieved value, emerging needs and the customer roadmap, and transition them into qualified pursuits.

  • Ensure lessons learned, reusable assets and customer feedback are captured and shared across the engagement management community.

5. Practice Leadership and Continuous Improvement

  • Promote consistent use of Siemens engagement, estimating, proposal, governance and risk-management standards.

  • Contribute reusable playbooks, templates, case studies and best practices that improve speed, quality and scalability across the practice.

  • Build working knowledge across the Siemens portfolio and maintain sufficient fluency to connect product capabilities into coherent customer solutions.

  • Mentor peers and delivery contributors in engagement shaping, executive communication, commercial discipline and customer governance.

  • Represent Siemens with integrity and comply with all applicable legal, commercial, information security, health and safety, and business-conduct requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience across professional services, consulting, enterprise software, solution delivery, customer success or services sales, including meaningful experience shaping and governing complex engagements.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional pursuits from discovery through proposal, contracting, mobilization and delivery governance.

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including estimation, pricing, contracting models, forecasting, margin awareness and risk management.

  • Executive-level communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics, influence decisions and manage competing stakeholder expectations.

  • Experience coordinating global and partner-enabled delivery teams across multiple priorities and organizational boundaries.

  • Ability to define clear outcomes, scope, assumptions, dependencies, acceptance criteria and governance for software-enabled transformation initiatives.

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • Willingness to travel and work across customer locations and time zones as required, consistent with company policy and local requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Siemens Digital Industries Software, including one or more of ICX, SLC, Mendix, Teamcenter, NX, Opcenter, Graph Studio, AI Studio or related portfolio offerings.

  • Experience shaping multi-product or solution-centric programs that integrate applications, data, AI, workflow and enterprise platforms.

  • Experience working across industrial, manufacturing, aerospace and defense, automotive, electronics, semiconductor, energy or other complex enterprise environments.

  • Background in large-scale software implementation, program leadership, solution architecture, organizational change or value realization.

  • Experience with prescriptive, best-practice-led deployments that balance customer requirements with standard capabilities and sustainable operating models.

Success Measures

  • Quality and conversion of the qualified services pipeline.

  • Bookings, revenue, margin and forecast accuracy for the assigned portfolio.

  • Engagement readiness at handover, including clarity of scope, staffing, commercials, governance and risk ownership.

  • Customer confidence, executive alignment and measurable progress toward agreed business outcomes.

  • Expansion of successful engagements into repeatable, scalable customer value.

  • Adoption of standard methods, reusable assets and lessons learned across the practice.

Core Competencies

Competency

What good looks like

Customer and business acumen

Understands customer strategy, operating context and value drivers.

Engagement shaping

Turns ambiguity into a clear, executable and outcome-oriented engagement.

Commercial discipline

Balances customer value, delivery feasibility, financial objectives and risk.

Executive communication

Communicates decisions, tradeoffs, risks and impact with clarity.

Orchestration

Aligns Sales, Presales, Architecture, Delivery, Product, partners and customers.

Governance and escalation

Creates decision clarity and drives timely resolution of issues.

Portfolio fluency

Connects multiple Siemens capabilities into coherent solutions.

Growth mindset

Uses delivered value to build trust, references and expansion opportunities.

Closing

    Compensation and Benefits

    The pay range for this position is 146,700–293,400 annually. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher within this range depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

    In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a target incentive of 7.5% of the base salary. Siemens offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Join One of the Fastest-Growing Online Education Companies in the World

At ELVTR, we're transforming online education by connecting ambitious professionals with industry leaders from companies like Nike, Netflix, Google, Amazon, and more.

Since launching in 2020, we've grown into a global learning community with over 300 expert instructors, delivering more than 200 live online courses across 12 industries. To date, we've helped 22,000+ graduates worldwide gain the skills, confidence, and connections needed to advance their careers.

If you love organizing content, have an eye for quality, and enjoy the mix of creative and technical work that comes with managing digital learning materials, we'd love to meet you.

This is a full-time, remote role.

As our Content Manager, you'll sit at the intersection of our website and our Learning Management System, making sure every course, page, and recording looks professional and works flawlessly for the thousands of learners who rely on it. Your work directly shapes how students experience our courses — from the moment they land on a course page to the moment they hit play on a lecture.

You'll take ownership of content publishing end-to-end, working closely with Marketing, Instructors, and Operations to keep our platforms accurate, current, and error-free.

You'll Love This Role If You:

  • Enjoy staying organized while juggling multiple content pipelines at once
  • Have a sharp eye for detail and quality control
  • Like the idea of learning (or already know) basic video editing
  • Are comfortable working across both a website CMS and an LMS
  • Take pride in a polished, professional finished product
  • Can work independently and manage your own priorities
  • Believe that clean, well-structured content makes a real difference to the end user

What You'll Do

  • Publish, format, and update text, images, and multimedia content on our website
  • Upload and manage course materials, structures, and student resources within our Learning Management System (LMS)
  • Process recorded materials (webinars, lectures, and more) to prepare them for publishing
  • Perform basic video editing — trimming, adding text overlays, and simple transitions — for course materials and promotional content
  • Ensure all published content is well-structured, error-free, and displays correctly across both the website and the LMS
  • Flag and troubleshoot formatting or display issues before content goes live
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Instructor teams to keep content accurate and on-brand

Requirements

  • Previous experience as a Content Manager, Content Administrator, or in a similar role is a plus
  • Familiarity with Content Management Systems (CMS) and Learning Management Systems (LMS)
  • Basic video editing skills (e.g., CapCut, iMovie, or similar software)
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Upper-Intermediate English level

Nice to Have

  • Experience in the online education or EdTech industry
  • Familiarity with audio/video processing tools beyond basic editing
  • Experience maintaining or organizing large content libraries
  • Basic understanding of web publishing or HTML formatting

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary,opportunities for career advancement as ELVTR continues to grow globally
  • Learn and Grow: Free access to ELVTR courses, ongoing professional development opportunities, career growth within one of the world's fastest-growing online education companies
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from wherever you're most productive, flexible and supportive work environment, collaborative international team
  • Health & Wellbeing: Gym membership reimbursement, mental health support, generous paid vacation allowance

Why Join ELVTR?

  • Make an Impact: Every piece of content you publish helps professionals build new skills, advance their careers, and unlock opportunities they never thought possible.
  • Grow Your Career: We're committed to developing our people. As ELVTR continues to expand globally, you'll have opportunities to grow professionally, take on new challenges, and shape the future of online education.
  • Join a Winning Team: Work alongside passionate educators, creators, marketers, and innovators who are committed to delivering world-class learning experiences and making education more accessible around the world.

Ready to Help Shape the Future of Online Learning?

If you're looking for more than just another content role — if you want to help build a seamless, professional learning experience for thousands of students — we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of ELVTR's next chapter of growth.

ELVTR is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace for all.

NCR Corporation (NYSE : NCR) est un chef de file dans la transformation, la connexion et l’exploitation de plateformes technologiques pour les services bancaires autogérés, les magasins et les restaurants. Title: Inside Sales Specialist

Location: QUEBEC VIRTUAL

Work style: Remote

Responsibilities:

As a Inside Sales Specialist, you will be one of the primary points of contact for our clients and internal teams, ensuring client needs are met and their expectations exceeded. You will play a critical role in driving client satisfaction, retention, and advocacy. Nurturing client relationships through effective communication via calls and emails. Providing guidance to clients, both reactively and proactively, supporting their needs and business requirements. Show agility and quick thinking to address client concerns, resolve issues efficiently and effectively, and collaborate on projects with internal teams to deliver positive client outcomes. Deep customer empathy is a very important characteristic when working with our customers. We need to address a myriad of questions that come to us with different levels of complexity from both customers and internal source and must be able to drive for the fastest resolution to ensure our customers’ happiness.

Essential daily and weekly duties and responsibilities:

  • Participates in organizational design work to continuously assess program strengths, while identifying areas for improvement client engagement process.

  • Collaborates with support teams and corporate staff regarding issues and projects relevant to operational support and client experience.

  • Owns the internal communication with all stakeholders, ensuring effective client communications.

  • Ensures curriculum and interventions are in alignment.

  • Manages programmatic schedule and services to ensure the efficiency and efficacy of client progression.

  • Identifies and implements best practices to increase overall operational effectiveness.

  • Facilitates team and interdepartmental training and meetings, to maintain precise process flow and ensure consistency of services.

  • Produces reports of program status throughout the client’s life cycle.

Position Requirements:

  • Demonstrated success in working with teams and driving results to achieve targets.

  • Strong relational skills to positively communicate with people from diverse backgrounds and experiences.

  • Background with operational effectiveness, including navigating ambiguity, budgeting exercises, and meeting operational objectives.

  • Experience identifying, innovating, and implementing best practice techniques and interventions.

  • Communication skills that create positive impact and engagement (written, verbal and presentations)

Qualifications:

  • Preferred to have 2 years of experience in a professional setting.

  • Experience in MSFT Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and CRM tools (preferably Salesforce).

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and adaptability.

  • Proactive and self-motivated mindset with a passion for delivering an exceptional client experience.

  • Proficiency in virtual communication tools such as MSFT Teams or Zoom.

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment that believes in accountability and continuous improvement.

  • Detail oriented with ability to identify potential issues, recommend and implement resolution plans

  • Ability to multi-task; high energy; strong sense of ownership; strong sense of urgency; ability to improvise; good problem-solving skills; ability to respond in a crisis; ability to rally a team; proven leadership skills

We will present case studies on investors who are doing things well, and why. And scoops on what’s happening. This journalist will report and produce editorial content on issues facing some of the largest money managers and investors in the world. Such content includes, but is not limited to, breaking news articles, news analysis, news features and enterprise reporting, along with some video and social media posts.
