We offer a creative, upbeat and exciting workplace that values curiosity, a sense of mission, excellence in reporting, top-notch writing skills, and innovation. We prioritize in-depth, analytical reporting and narrative writing. We value talent, and this position will give reporters the opportunity to break news and talk to some of the most influential investors in the world.

Qualified applicants must have the courage to approach investors, have great conversations that uncover information, and be able to tell insightful stories that dig deep into trends effecting institutional investing in the United States as well as the world.

Markets Group, the world’s leading events group, is building a news team that will deliver critical financial news to executives responsible for the investment of large institutional assets such as pension funds, endowments and foundations, family offices, and private wealth. With a goal to become a leading news source for institutional investing, the right reporter for this position will bring a passion for finance, the confidence to approach C-suite individuals, and an ability to break news and dive deeply into actionable topics.

jobs.title: Legal Executive Assistant
jobs.excerpt: Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for an Legal Executive Assistant to support our General Counsel and our broader Legal team.
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for an Legal Executive Assistant to support our General Counsel and our broader Legal team.

Position Description

Oklo is seeking an experienced, dynamic, technically capable Legal Executive Assistant to support our General Counsel, and also to provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to our entire Legal team. You will help our General Counsel with calendar management, scheduling meetings, helping to prepare content and materials, supporting notary or apostille needs, etc. But you will also support the broader Legal team, including helping to plan and organize team travel and offsites, overseeing outside counsel billing and accruals, supporting new team member onboarding, and providing other administrative and operational support.

This role demands a combination of administrative prowess and the agility to navigate a fast-moving company in order to support our lean Legal function as it continues to scale to support Oklo’s rapid growth. We are looking for someone who is creative and can leverage AI and other tools to provide support at scale.

Discretion is essential to this role. The Legal Executive Assistant will regularly handle highly confidential and sensitive information relating to the important matters being handled by the Legal team. Given the significance and scope of this work, the successful candidate must demonstrate sound judgment and treat confidentiality, compliance, and accountability as fundamental responsibilities of the position.

This is a remote US-based role, but you must be able to travel to our HQ twice per quarter. Given that our General Counsel is based in California, there is a slight preference for this person to be located in the Pacific time zone.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Provide comprehensive support to the General Counsel and team, including calendar management, coordinating meetings, and handling travel arrangements;
  • Coordinate meeting logistics, prepare agendas, and support cross-functional communications;
  • Prepare and edit presentations, reports, and other critical documents, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery;
  • Help plan and arrange for team meetings and offsites, including planning travel arrangements, events, and content;
  • Support with legal knowledge management, including updating internal wiki pages and other company-wide materials;
  • Manage legal billing operations, including outside counsel invoice processing, vendor setup, and e-billing system management;
  • Assist with departmental budgeting, expense tracking, and quarterly financial accruals in coordination with the finance team; and
  • Facilitate the seamless onboarding of new legal team hires, including equipment setup, system access, and welcome training.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 5-8 years proven experience as an assistant or in a similar role supporting an in-house General Counsel or broader Legal department
  • Proven experience managing calendars, executive scheduling, and travel logistics
  • Familiarity with outside counsel billing practices, and e-billing platforms
  • Strong technical proficiency with the ability to quickly adapt to new tools and software, including Google Suite, Slack, Box, Atlassian, Microsoft Office Suite, and Adobe Acrobat to make tracked changes, add redlining/comments to documents, and create PDFs
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, multitask, and prioritize tasks
  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to anticipate needs and challenges

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Previous experience working in a high-growth startup
  • Proficiency or interest in AI productivity and automation tools

Competencies

We are looking for a Legal Executive Assistant who is:

  • Exceptionally organized and attentive to detail
  • Experienced with executive calendar management, travel coordination, and meeting logistics
  • Discreet and capable of handling confidential legal and corporate information with integrity
  • Knowledgeable about outside counsel billing practices and accrual processes
  • Effective at prioritizing complex, competing demands and driving projects to completion
  • A clear, professional communicator who interacts smoothly with internal leaders and external partners
  • Adaptable and resourceful in navigating fast-moving startup environments
  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $70,000-$110,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

  • Build a fanatical focus on the seller and partner experience into everything you deliver.

Bonus Points:

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Manage a Team of Ops Associates for a fast-growing NYC-based custom apparel start-up (Remote)Hi, this is Arpana, one of the founding members of Fresh Prints.
jobs.description:
Manage a Team of Ops Associates for a fast-growing NYC-based custom apparel start-up (Remote)

Hi, this is Arpana, one of the founding members of Fresh Prints.

In December 2016, I came across a job post on Naukri from Jacob Goodman, one of the co-owners of Fresh Prints. They were looking for someone to lead Operations in India. The post had already been taken down, but I decided to send Jacob an email anyway. To my surprise, he replied, and soon I found myself stepping into what would become a life-changing opportunity.

During the interview process, it became clear just how new everything was. There was no office, no payroll system, no established infrastructure. But what stood out was Jacob and Josh's unwavering belief in the vision they had for Fresh Prints. They didn't have all the answers, but their passion was contagious, and I knew I wanted to help build something from the ground up.

So I jumped in. I found an office, figured out payroll, and even brought in my childhood best friend to help get things started. Those early days were full of unknowns, but that's what made them so exciting. I got to wear multiple hats, solve problems on the fly, and help build something tangible. What started as a team of two soon grew into teams across Finance, Tech, and Marketing.

As the first employee of Fresh Prints India, I've had the privilege of helping shape the company from its earliest days. After taking a short break to have my daughter, I returned to lead HR and Recruiting. Since then, we've grown from a scrappy startup into a team of 400+ people across three countries. But even today, we still believe it's day one.

One of the moments I'm most proud of was how we navigated COVID-19 together. Overnight, universities shut down, events stopped, and we went from million-dollar months to zero revenue.

But we'd spent years preparing for uncertainty. From day one, we believed our balance sheet had to be a strength, so we always planned to be able to operate for at least a year without revenue or layoffs. When COVID hit, we were scared, but we were prepared.

Then we adapted. As demand for PPE surged, we pivoted from custom apparel to supplying protective equipment. It wasn't just about keeping the business alive—it was about meeting a real need. That willingness to move quickly and solve problems together helped us come out stronger while many companies were simply trying to survive.

The opportunities that were available to me when I joined as the first employee are still here today—in fact, they're even bigger. We're at an exciting point in our journey, and we're looking for people who want to have a real impact on what comes next.

If you're someone who sees opportunity and isn't afraid to chase it, this is the role for you. We're looking for people with an entrepreneurial mindset who take ownership, challenge the norm, and enjoy solving problems without a playbook. At Fresh Prints, there are no limits—but if you're looking for a role with a clear set of instructions, this probably isn't it.

If our story resonates, we want to hear from you!

Here's more about the Operations Manager role:

The operations team handles the most crucial part of the business and is directly responsible for every step in delivering the end product to our customers.

  • How do we build a team that drives the business forward?
  • How do we motivate Operations Associates to respond to a higher volume of tickets at an even higher quality?
  • How do you most efficiently manage incoming requests from printers, customers, and Campus Managers?
  • How can we reduce our costs and increase our profit margins overall?

As a member of the Operations Leadership team, you’ll be a driving force behind moving our Operations team forward. You will own an entire area and have a team of people to lead and motivate. You will set and track metrics by which your success will be measured.

We’re looking for someone who has fantastic people management skills, is a quick learner, and isn’t afraid to take on challenges daily. This is a high-impact role that requires excellent leadership and prioritization abilities. We’re on a remarkable growth trajectory and as Fresh Prints grows, you will too. You will be given the autonomy and guidance to have a tremendous impact on your role.

You’ll be managing a talented team of 3 to 7 associates, depending on which team you lead.

Responsibilities

  • Fully own a part of our supply chain. That includes any projects, requests from other functions, headcount planning, helping the team realise its full potential and making it future-proof
  • Managing a team of Ops Associates
  • Managing communications with vendors & customers
  • Managing escalations from the team and solving logistical issues
  • Setting and tracking team metrics
  • Make sure all goals are reached
  • One-on-one meetings with your direct reports and with your manager

We’re specifically looking for someone who has:

  • Founded, co-founded, or independently run a real operating business.
  • Built or scaled a business serving paying customers.
  • Managed employees directly—not only agencies, vendors, or freelancers.
  • Personally handled hiring, coaching, performance management, and difficult people decisions.
  • Owned business operations, customers, vendors, costs, and financial outcomes.
  • Built processes from scratch in a fast-moving, resource-constrained environment.
  • Strong commercial judgment and the confidence to form an independent point of view.
  • Approximately 5–12 years of total experience, including meaningful people-management experience.
  • Managed at least 3–5 employees at some point, preferably more.
  • Strong communication, analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Fluency in English and comfort working night shifts.

Preferred Business Backgrounds

Experience building or running a business in any of the following areas would be especially relevant:

  • E-commerce or D2C
  • Apparel, fashion, merchandise, or printing
  • Supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, or fulfilment
  • Consumer products
  • Vendor or marketplace operations
  • B2B operational businesses
  • Customer service or technology-enabled operations

The industry does not need to match Fresh Prints exactly. What matters is that you have managed real employees, customers, operations, and financial outcomes.

What Does Not Qualify

Freelancing, solo consulting, passive co-founder roles, short-term side projects, or family-business involvement without clear ownership will not be considered equivalent to building and operating a business.

What We Value

  • Entrepreneurial thinking
  • Strong people leadership
  • Ownership and accountability
  • Practical business judgment
  • Proactive problem-solving
  • Comfort with ambiguity
  • Clear and structured communication
  • Data-driven decision-making
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure
  • Willingness to stay hands-on

This is a high-impact role with significant autonomy and the opportunity to grow into broader Operations leadership as Fresh Prints continues to scale.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive annual salary between USD 15,000 to USD 24,000
  • Health insurance
  • Mental Health Benefits
  • Learning opportunities
  • Working in a great culture

Job Location

  • Remote Working

Working Hours

  • Working hours are 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST, Monday to Friday

Fresh Prints is an equal employment opportunity employer and promotes diversity; actively encouraging people of all backgrounds, ages, LGBTQ+, and those with disabilities to apply.

Fresh Prints never charges any money during the hiring process. If you’re asked to pay for a job, it’s not real.

jobs.description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain, the UK, or the UAE.
  • Contract:
    • Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain)
    • UK: Full-time, permanent (local contract)
    • UAE: Full-time, permanent via Deel (our employer of record in the UAE)
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link -
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

Curious what it's actually like to work at Airalo? We've put together a guide for each of the hubs we hire from most, covering our benefits, remote culture, employment setup, and what our team values most:

  • Life at Airalo · España:
  • Life at Airalo · United Kingdom:
  • Life at Airalo · United Arab Emirates:

Airalo built the world's first eSIM marketplace. Today most of our customers buy a data plan for a trip, use it, and come back the next time they fly. We are building something people install once and keep, that works at home as well as abroad.

The industry we came out of spent decades building walls to protect itself from its own customers: fine print, fair-use policies, roaming charges that arrive after the holiday is over, contracts written to be hard to leave. We are taking those down, and we are doing it with clarity and care rather than noise.

Most of that is design work. The machinery under connectivity is genuinely complicated, and none of it is the customer's problem, making it disappear is the job.

Designing something people live with is a different job from designing a good purchase. A trip purchase is won at checkout, in a few minutes, often in an airport. A product that stays on someone's phone for years has to be worth opening when nothing is wrong.

We are looking for the design leader who can take us there. You'll report to the Chief Product Officer, as a peer to the leaders of Consumer Product and B2B Product.

What you own:

  • Own every surface, consumer and business. On consumer, that's acquisition, conversion, customer experience, retention, core systems, Airalo One, and our new bets, each with its own product manager and engineering team. On B2B, it's reseller experience, corporate experience, and partner onboarding. Make all of it feel like one relationship rather than a series of separate transactions.

  • Set design strategy. Define what the product should feel like in two years, which bets get us there, and what we are deliberately not doing.

  • Lead research and design as one function. Run the product design guild and the research team, with research shaping strategy rather than answering requests for it.

  • Own brand in the product, co-authored with Marketing. Marketing leads the campaign and positioning; you own how the brand is felt, the design system, typography and colour, motion and haptics, in-app photography, and the tone of everything from a paywall to an error message.

  • Build quality as a system. Define what finished means and hold the authority to enforce it: one design system the B2B platform inherits from rather than forks, accessibility designed in rather than retrofitted, and words treated as design rather than copy added at the end.

Your First Year:

  • Land the brand evolution in the product, with our flagship connectivity launch as the vehicle.

  • Take the app from viable to lovable: micro-animations, haptics, and patterns that feel native on iOS and Android rather than one layout that satisfies neither.

  • Decide what the design system needs — it has a real accessibility standard and no dedicated engineers, running on champions per platform.

  • Draw the working boundary between design and product management so designers are neither order-takers nor deciding alone.

  • Move research from answering questions to setting them, and make its output something the roadmap actually turns on.

  • Build the career framework for design and research, with a bar you can defend at each level.

  • Hire, tell us what shape the team should be, not only how big.

Must-haves:

  • Have led design for a business at real scale, responsible for a whole product rather than a slice of one, consumer depth matters most, and experience also running a business or professional product is a strong advantage, since running both from one team is the specific problem here.

  • Have led or worked closely with research, and know what it's for beyond validation.

  • Have written a design strategy, won the argument to get it adopted, and lived with the result.

  • Are still close to the work, not the main designer, but someone whose judgement on a screen is worth deferring to.

  • Have grown designers into leads and leads into managers.

  • Can make the case for design in commercial terms as fluently as in design terms.

  • Reach for one system that scales rather than bespoke solutions that multiply, and know what a design system costs to maintain, not only to launch.

You should apply if…

  • You think in systems, not screens. You can hold a whole product, consumer and B2B, as one relationship, and you build the design system, career framework, and quality bar that make good work repeatable rather than heroic.

  • You treat research as a strategic input, not a rubber stamp. You want research setting the questions the roadmap turns on, not just validating decisions already made.

  • You can own brand inside the product. You're comfortable co-authoring brand strategy with Marketing while owning how it actually shows up, motion, tone, typography, the moment a customer touches the product.

  • You've done this at scale and stayed close to the work. You've led design organizations, but your eye for a screen is still one people defer to.

  • You can argue design in the language of the business. You've written and sold a design strategy, and you can make its commercial case as fluently as its craft case.

Why People Join Us

🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.

For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home.

🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers.

Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane.

🇦🇪 Why people join us in the UAE

We're a fully remote team across 60+ countries, built on a simple idea: trust people to own their work and deliver without unnecessary layers or heavy process getting in the way.

Many people joining us from the UAE are looking for clarity in scope and real ownership in their role. They want to know what they're responsible for, how success is measured, and have direct access to the people making decisions.

What often stands out is the combination of a global, product-led company with a flexible remote setup. For many, it's the opportunity to work on a product used by millions of travelers worldwide, alongside a team that moves quickly and values clear ownership and accountability.

Before You Hit Apply

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Security Systems Technical Lead to be embedded on our client’s Security Technology team.

The Technical Lead will provide expertise and direction for the design, deployment, optimization, and ongoing health of enterprise physical security technology. This role supports complex security systems initiatives, evaluates and improves existing technologies and processes, and serves as a key technical partner to security, IT, engineering, and vendor teams. The Technical Lead will oversee solutions from requirements and design through implementation and operational support, while identifying opportunities to improve system reliability, scalability, lifecycle management, and overall security program effectiveness.

This is a full-time, fully remote position offering a comprehensive benefits package.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning, technical execution, and delivery of enterprise physical security technology projects, including PACS, VMS, video analytics, and related security infrastructure.
  • Own projects from requirements gathering and technical design through testing, deployment, commissioning, and operational handoff.
  • Develop project plans, schedules, milestones, and technical requirements while managing dependencies, risks, and resource needs.
  • Evaluate existing security systems and develop remediation strategies to improve system health, reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness.
  • Provide technical leadership for system migrations, upgrades, integrations, and lifecycle initiatives across on-premises, hybrid, and SaaS environments.
  • Perform or oversee system configuration, provisioning, integration testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution across enterprise security platforms.
  • Review technical designs, system architectures, device configurations, and infrastructure requirements to ensure solutions meet security, operational, and enterprise standards.
  • Partner with security operations, IT, engineering, vendors, and other stakeholders to align technical solutions with business and operational requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve security technology processes, system lifecycle management, and operational workflows through standardization and automation.
  • Develop technical documentation, SOPs, implementation plans, and recommendations that support sustainable system operations and continuous improvement.

Required

  • 10+ years of experience designing, implementing, supporting, or managing enterprise physical security systems and technologies.
  • Strong technical expertise with Physical Access Control Systems (PACS), Video Management Systems (VMS), badging, and related technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise platforms such as Lenel OnGuard, C•CURE 9000, Genetec Security Center, or comparable systems.
  • Demonstrated experience with system migrations, integrations, upgrades, commissioning, and lifecycle management.
  • Strong understanding of security system architecture, networking, databases, servers, and cloud/hybrid environments.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, assess system health, identify root causes, and develop remediation strategies.
  • Strong project coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple technical initiatives, priorities, and dependencies.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across security, IT, engineering, vendors, and other stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Are you passionate about building robust data architectures that power next-generation, AI-driven business intelligence? Do you thrive in the intersection of data engineering and analytics, wearing both hats to design scalable backends and deliver actionable insights?

We are looking for a Senior Marketing Analytics Manager - Business Intelligence & Data Architecture to join our Marketing Analytics team. In this role, you will work closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Data Engineering teams to build the foundational "Gold Layers" and semantic models that enable self-serve reporting and agentic AI workflows.

This is a great opportunity for a highly technical analyst who is hands-on with Python, Databricks, and SQL, and is excited about creating the infrastructure that enables AI for BI. If you’re energized by the challenge of bridging the gap between raw data pipelines and advanced analytical outputs, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Act as the bridge between Data Engineering and Marketing Analytics, designing, building, and maintaining robust ETL pipelines and "Gold Layer" tables in Databricks.
  • Develop and document semantic layers, data dictionaries, and markdown files designed specifically to train and enable AI agents for scalable, self-serve BI.
  • Develop dashboards and analyses to surface business-critical KPIs and assess sales and marketing performance.
  • Perform ad-hoc reporting and deep dives to uncover key insights across programs and initiatives to inform strategy and decision making.
  • Partner with marketing stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable data models and analytics-ready datasets.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Bachelor's in Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Economics or other related analytical fields.
  • 5+ years of relevant analytics, business intelligence, artificial intelligence or data engineering work experience.
  • Expert in SQL, python, DBT and visualization platforms (Tableau preferred).
  • Hands-on experience working with Databricks (or similar lakehouse architectures) to transform and model large datasets.
  • Experience building data backends, semantic layers, and structured documentation optimized for AI ingestion and agentic workflows.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with experience in data analysis.
  • Comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate data transformation, analysis, and visualization workflows.
  • Experience supporting Sales, Product or Marketing teams.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building interactive applications using Streamlit or Claude workflows.
  • Experience building web applications
  • Experience working in web analytics
  • Sales and marketing experience including familiarity with MarTech tools.
  • Navigate large, multifaceted datasets to answer hard questions — drawing on the right analytical or statistical approach for each problem.
  • Data Science, machine learning or predictive analytics experience.
  • Actively builds AI fluency relevant to BI and analytics work, including prompt engineering for data tasks, exploring AI-assisted features in tools, and staying current on how AI is reshaping the analytics landscape.
  • Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies.

Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Total Rewards

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. jobs.title: Lead, Business Development & Licensing - Sureel AI
jobs.excerpt: A little bit about our teamSureel AI is building the standards and infrastructure for AI rights, licensing, attribution, protection, and intelligence, starting in music and expanding across media.
jobs.description:
A little bit about our team

Sureel AI is building the standards and infrastructure for AI rights, licensing, attribution, protection, and intelligence, starting in music and expanding across media.

We are building the infrastructure that enables creators and rights holders to control how their work is used by AI, protect their rights, understand its use and value, and participate in new AI licensing models. We also provide AI companies and digital platforms with the systems they need to access rights, permissions, attribution, guardrails, reporting, and licensing infrastructure programmatically.

Acquired by Warner Music Group, Sureel operates as an independent, federated company, combining startup speed with the reach of a global music company.

Our commercial relationships sit at the heart of what we're building: with the AI companies and digital service providers (DSPs) who integrate our attribution infrastructure into their platforms, and with the rights holders whose works and interests that infrastructure protects. As Director, Business Development & Licensing, you'll own the business function across both sides of that equation, working closely with senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and external partners across the music, technology, and legal worlds. Your work will directly shape the commercial architecture of AI attribution at scale.

Your role

You will lead Sureel's business function, reporting to the CEO and two Co-Presidents. This is a senior, commercially focused role. When Sureel is negotiating with a service provider or a rights holder, you will own the business function of that negotiation.

You will also serve as Sureel's primary liaison with industry bodies such as DDEX and regulatory bodies such as WIPO where their activities relate to Sureel's business.

A key part of the role will be developing business models and modeling outcomes for charging clients, including DSPs and AI companies. A strong understanding of economics and music rights will be important.

Your objective is to structure agreements that increase adoption of Sureel's infrastructure, create repeatable commercial models, and establish frameworks that can scale across multiple rights holders, AI companies, and markets.

You will negotiate licensing models, revenue structures, payment flows, and the economic frameworks that determine how permissions through Sureel's technology translate into compensation. You will also oversee the business use cases for integrating Sureel's infrastructure with AI companies and DSPs, defining what a commercially viable integration looks like and structuring the terms around it.

You'll work closely with Product and Client Relations. They will bring the product and partner perspectives, while you will lead the commercial structure and economics that support the business.

This is an opportunity to help define the business function of a company working in a new and evolving area, and to help shape how creators are compensated in the age of AI.

What you'll do:

  • Own the business function for Sureel's negotiations, whether with AI companies, DSPs, other digital service providers, or rights holders, leading commercial strategy, deal structure, and terms from first conversation through signature.

  • Negotiate the economics of platform integrations, including licensing models, revenue structures, payment flows, and frameworks that reflect the value of Sureel's technology alongside rights holders' catalog and distribution positions.

  • Develop the business use cases for integrating Sureel's infrastructure with AI companies and DSPs, defining commercial success and prioritizing opportunities based on enterprise value.

  • Develop licensing and economic frameworks for an emerging category, using relevant AI and rights-technology transactions to inform agreements that can work across different partners and markets.

  • Structure multi-stakeholder commercial arrangements among rights holders and industry participants, positioning Sureel's infrastructure as the mechanism for executing those agreements.

  • Partner with Client Relations on rights-holder relationships, owning the commercial terms and deal economics while they lead the broader relationship and delivery.

  • Work closely with Warner Music Group counterparts on commercial terms, licensing structures, and strategic priorities.

  • Provide market intelligence on emerging technologies, competitive developments, licensing innovation, and deal dynamics across the AI and DSP landscape.

  • Represent Sureel with industry and standards organizations, including DDEX, WIPO, and other initiatives shaping AI rights and licensing.

  • Develop pricing and packaging for Sureel's platform, including enterprise fees, API and usage-based pricing, transaction fees, revenue share, licensing administration, analytics, and hybrid structures.

  • Create repeatable commercial and licensing frameworks that can scale across partners rather than requiring every agreement to be built from scratch.

  • Help structure how Sureel infrastructure is used in commercial agreements, including rights, permissions, guardrails, attribution, reporting, and economic obligations between rights holders and AI companies.

  • Handle confidential and proprietary information, including deal terms, partner economics, and negotiations with discretion and integrity.

  • Help shape emerging industry standards and licensing frameworks so they can be implemented programmatically and work with Sureel's architecture.

Who you are:

  • You have deep experience structuring and negotiating commercial agreements in music, media, or technology, including licensing deals, platform integrations, revenue-share structures, or rights-technology transactions.

  • You've owned the business side of negotiations with platforms, DSPs, technology companies, or rights holders and carried complex deals from term sheet through signature.

  • You understand the economics of the music industry: how rights generate revenue, how licensing frameworks are built, and how value flows between platforms, intermediaries, and rights holders.

  • You're comfortable with data and financial detail. You can model a revenue structure, pressure-test assumptions, and explain the business logic clearly to technical teams and senior counterparties.

  • You can structure complex deals and find approaches that work for the different parties involved.

  • You build trust quickly and can represent leadership in high-stakes negotiations, make judgment calls on terms, and know when to escalate.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person and can stay calm in a fast-moving environment.

  • You understand how pricing, licensing structures, technical standards, and ecosystem incentives can support platform adoption and durable commercial outcomes.

  • You are interested in the music industry and enjoy working in a small, collaborative, startup-paced team.

We'd love it if you also had:

  • Direct experience negotiating with AI companies, DSPs, or other digital service providers on licensing, integration, or commercial partnership terms.

  • Experience working with artists, labels, publishers, or CMOs/PROs on the commercial side, or serving as a senior deal advisor to them.

  • Experience across deal structuring and licensing, business development, commercial strategy, or partnerships.

  • Involvement in industry licensing, standards, or policy initiatives shaping how AI and rights interact.

  • Experience working directly with C-level executives on commercial strategy, negotiation preparation, and translating senior conversations into agreements.

  • Experience developing commercial models for infrastructure, APIs, marketplaces, payments, rights technology, or other platforms where value is monetized across multiple layers of a transaction.

  • Curiosity about the music and entertainment landscape and AI's impact on creators.

Sureel AI is an independent, federated company within Warner Music Group. We're committed to building a diverse team and to fair recognition for creators everywhere.

If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

About us

Chronosphere, a Palo Alto Networks company, is the observability platform built for control in the modern, containerized world. Chronosphere empowers customers to focus on the data and insights that matter by reducing complexity, optimizing costs, and remediating issues faster. Chronosphere reduces data volumes and associated costs by 84% on average while saving developers thousands of hours. Recognized as a leader by major analyst firms, Chronosphere is trusted by the world's most innovative brands, including DoorDash, Affirm, and Zillow.

About the role

Chronosphere, a Palo Alto Networks company, is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead foundational areas of our Storage and Cost Optimization tiers. You’ll operate with one foot in the factory and one foot in the field, bridging between our customers and our engineering team, building feedback loops, and testing hypotheses. You must be comfortable with a deeply technical product that serves a deeply technical audience. Along with building great products, you’ll drive the messaging and storytelling for how these products help solve problems for developers.

We run two lanes: a validation track to choose and specify what to build, and an agile build track to get it delivered. You’ll be responsible for both.

Qualifications

You will

  • Perform primary research, interviewing end-users and buyers.

  • Build a researched perspective on current customer and future prospects needs.

What you will achieve

You will start off in your role understanding the current roadmap and plans as a way to learn our product and gain insight to customer needs. While you execute on the short-term roadmap, you’ll establish your independent perspective on the state and evolution of the Cost Optimization and Storage needs of the market through ride-alongs in customer conversations, doing your own research and internal conversations with experts and learning from internal teams.

Following this initial period, you will take full ownership of the Cost Optimization product area and parts of the Storage tier, establish problem statements, PRDs, drive scrum meetings, sprint planning, including ownership of success metrics, establishing/changing pricing when required, defining SLOs, establishing and managing to a COGS profile and working cross functionally across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales and other functions to help GTM teams position and independently sell.

The main success criteria of this role is to be able to chart the best possible path and execute on those plans and deliver value to customers. An ongoing task thereafter is to take these new capabilities to the next level by staying close to customers and prospects.

You have

Shorthand exists to empower creative teams to produce and publish beautiful, transformative content radically faster. The mission of Shorthand is to create a beautifully informed world. To do that, we need to build a platform that makes it easy to create immersive reading experiences for the web, because it would otherwise be unaffordable and painfully cumbersome for organisations to produce this type of content.

  • Is technically credible and confident discussing CMS workflows, integrations and implementation considerations with customer web and platform teams.
  • Can independently run discovery, product demonstrations and commercial conversations without relying heavily on presales or solution engineering support.
  • Has strong consultative selling skills and can connect Shorthand's platform capabilities to strategic customer objectives around content, storytelling, engagement and digital experience.
  • Communicates exceptionally well in both written and verbal formats, and can simplify complex concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Learns quickly, prioritises effectively, and maintains high attention to detail while managing multiple enterprise sales cycles simultaneously.
  • Thrives working remotely and collaboratively across distributed teams and time zones.
  • Brings curiosity, resilience and initiative, and enjoys helping shape go-to-market strategy for emerging products and categories.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Significant experience successfully selling enterprise marketing solutions to CEOs, CMOs, VPs and Directors of Marketing, Content, Communications, Editorial and related functions.
  • Experience selling into organisations using WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Contentful, Optimizely, Drupal or similar CMS/DXP platforms.
  • Experience navigating technical validation processes with digital, engineering or web platform teams.
  • Ability to independently deliver product demonstrations and manage technical discovery conversations without dedicated presales support.
  • Experience introducing new products to market.
  • Proven track record of closing large, strategic, high-quality deals.
  • Proven success in both direct and partner-led sales.
  • Technical aptitude or background in technology is highly regarded.
  • A consultative sales style and experience selling solutions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to sell collaboratively across multiple internal stakeholders and teams.

Personality Attributes

  • You are a proactive self-starter who doesn't need to be told what to do and is resourceful in finding solutions.
  • You are collaborative, consultative and not afraid to get your hands dirty.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment and possess a high level of curiosity.
  • You are goal-oriented, resilient and motivated by achieving outstanding results.
  • You are a supportive and proactive team player.
  • You love working remotely.
  • You are tech-savvy and excited to become an expert in the Shorthand platform.

Why work for us

We offer:

  • Fully remote working, flexible hours and a co-working allowance if you'd like one.
  • True autonomy, with the freedom to own and grow your territory.
  • The opportunity to shape our enterprise sales motion as we continue to grow across North America.
  • A category-defining product trusted by leading global brands, publishers, universities and not-for-profits.
  • The opportunity to work in a growing SaaS company that's still small enough for you to make a real impact.
  • A home office allowance, laptop and any peripherals you need to do your best work.
  • An Employee Share Option Plan for all team members.
  • A Health & Wellness Allowance together with access to coaching and counselling services.
  • A 401(k) plan and 100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for US-based team members.
  • Paid parental leave if you're growing your tribe.
  • A proudly carbon-neutral organisation, taking climate action with Trace as part of our broader sustainability strategy.
  • A base salary range of US$110,000–125,000, with additional variable commission. Actual compensation will depend on your skills, experience and local market benchmarks.

Shorthand's interview process

We value direct communication and want to be transparent about how we hire. Our process includes:

  1. An initial Zoom conversation with the hiring manager.
  2. A take-home task using our platform (approximately 2–4 hours).
  3. Panel interviews with members of the team, including our CEO.
  4. Reference and background checks before a formal offer is made.

Our workplace is 100% distributed and all interviews are conducted virtually. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process.

Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Principal Data Lead to help lead the strategy, governance, and quality of data on one of our large-scale federal data platform programs. In this role, you'll own execution of the data strategy for a multi-year enterprise data platform, lead the data supply chain, and drive a multi-phase metadata maturity program that raises the bar for how data is documented, trusted, and reused across the platform. You'll govern how data is promoted from initial ingestion through validated, trusted status, set and maintain data quality standards, and serve as the connective tissue between the platform team and the many upstream source-system teams and business data owners who depend on it.

This is foundational work: the metadata and data quality practices you lead are what make it possible to safely expand governed self-service analytics and AI use cases. If you enjoy building durable data governance capability inside a live, high-stakes production environment — not just writing policy — we'd love to hear from you.

This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location:

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S., be able to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance, and obtain a U.S. Federal Government client badge. Bixal does not sponsor employment visas or assume sponsorship of existing employment visas.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $160,000 – $200,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Own execution of the data strategy for a large-scale enterprise data platform, aligning day-to-day delivery with the organization’s broader data strategy and strategic goals.

  • Serve as the primary coordination point across multiple upstream source-system teams and business data owners, managing handoffs, ingestion readiness, and shared metadata standards across the ecosystem.

  • Lead the data supply chain — source onboarding, ingestion, and transformation — and drive a multi-phase metadata maturity program, treating metadata as an operational capability rather than a one-time cataloging effort.

  • Govern the promotion of data through a tiered catalog architecture (e.g., raw, source, and trusted layers), defining clear admission criteria and applying the model consistently across teams.

  • Set and maintain data quality standards across the platform, including completeness, conformance, freshness against SLAs, and defect/rework tracking.

  • Partner with engineering, product, and AI/platform teams to ensure metadata and data quality are sufficient to support expanding self-service analytics and AI use cases.

  • Establish and track measures of data quality, metadata coverage, and promotion/certification cycle time, and use them to prioritize remediation work.

  • Communicate data strategy progress, risks, and dependencies to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership.

  • Participate in Agile/SAFe delivery cadences, including planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified and trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, plus at least 10 years of related experience.

  • Strong track record coordinating across multiple stakeholder teams and data owners in complex, multi-system environments.

  • Demonstrated experience owning or leading a data strategy for a large, multi-source enterprise data platform.

  • Experience designing and operating metadata governance or maturity programs, including cataloging, ownership models, and promotion/certification criteria.

  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, or similar) and metadata/catalog tooling (e.g., Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Microsoft Purview).

  • Experience defining and enforcing data quality standards, including completeness, conformance, freshness, and defect tracking.

  • Working knowledge of distributed data processing concepts and common data programming or query languages (e.g., SQL, Python, Scala), sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams on pipeline design and performance.

  • Experience defining and enforcing data quality standards, including completeness, conformance, freshness, and defect tracking.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical data concepts for non-technical audiences, including client leadership.

  • Professional certification in a cloud or data platform (e.g., AWS, Databricks), data governance (e.g., DAMA CDMP), or Agile delivery (e.g., SAFe).

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in highly regulated federal data domains (e.g., healthcare, benefits, or financial data).

  • Familiarity with responsible AI governance and how metadata and data quality maturity gate the expansion of AI use cases.

  • Hands-on experience building, tuning, or troubleshooting data pipelines on a cloud lakehouse platform (e.g., Databricks or comparable).

  • Exposure to CI/CD, source control, and observability tooling as applied to data platform and pipeline operations.

  • Experience with data lineage and impact-analysis tooling.

  • Experience supporting or serving in a Key Personnel role on a federal contract.

  • Background in federal digital services delivery.

How We Support Our Team:

jobs.description:
D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS) is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It is the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the first and only to offer dual-platform quantum computing products and services, spanning both annealing and gate-model quantum computing technologies. D-Wave’s mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum today through enterprise-grade systems available on-premises and via its Leap™ quantum cloud service, which offers 99.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations across commercial, government, and research sectors trust D-Wave to address complex computational challenges using quantum computing. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how D-Wave is shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: .

About the role

jobs.title: Outbound GTM Lead | Colombia
jobs.excerpt: HireHawk is a fast-growing staffing and recruitment solutions company helping businesses build high-performing teams through both onshore and offshore hiring support.
jobs.description:
HireHawk is a fast-growing staffing and recruitment solutions company helping businesses build high-performing teams through both onshore and offshore hiring support. We partner with companies across multiple industries to solve hiring challenges, improve recruiting efficiency, reduce operational friction, and connect them with rigorously vetted talent.

HireHawk goes beyond traditional staffing by supporting the full hiring infrastructure companies need to scale, including recruiting, talent sourcing, payroll coordination, compliance support, onboarding workflows, and ongoing workforce management.

About the Role

This is a hands-on outbound GTM and sales execution role for someone who can build, manage, and continuously improve a scalable outbound engine.

The Outbound GTM Lead will own the infrastructure, workflows, and day-to-day systems required to keep HireHawk’s SDR team operating at full capacity. This includes lead list creation, prospect segmentation, contact enrichment, Apollo workflows, call prioritization, CRM processes, SDR enablement, call review, outbound reporting, and multichannel campaign development.

The immediate priority for this role is to strengthen and scale HireHawk’s phone-based outbound motion by ensuring SDRs consistently have high-quality, relevant prospects to call, clear scripts and qualification criteria, structured follow-up processes, and actionable coaching based on call performance.

As the outbound engine matures, this role will also build and optimize additional outbound channels, including email and LinkedIn, to support or independently generate qualified opportunities.

This is not a pure marketing role and not a traditional Account Executive role. The focus is on building the systems, processes, messaging, and SDR execution required to generate more qualified meetings and create a predictable outbound pipeline.

The Outbound GTM Lead will work closely with SDRs, sales leadership, and account management to ensure HireHawk’s outbound motion is structured, measurable, repeatable, scalable, and aligned with our staffing and recruitment services.

Responsibilities:

Outbound Infrastructure & List Building

  • Build, optimize, and manage HireHawk’s outbound infrastructure across Apollo, CRM systems, sales engagement tools, data enrichment platforms, and reporting systems.
  • Own lead list creation, prospect segmentation, contact enrichment, phone-number validation, sequence setup, and outbound campaign execution.
  • Develop high-quality prospect lists segmented by ICP, industry, buyer persona, geography, company size, hiring activity, hiring signals, and staffing need.
  • Ensure SDRs consistently have sufficient volumes of high-quality, phone-ready prospects to maintain strong daily calling activity.
  • Build repeatable systems for sourcing, enriching, validating, prioritizing, and routing leads to SDRs.
  • Continuously improve list quality based on connect rates, conversation quality, meeting conversion, and SDR feedback.
  • Identify and test new prospecting signals, data sources, and enrichment methods that improve outbound performance.

SDR Enablement & Call Performance

  • Partner closely with SDRs to improve daily outbound execution, call prioritization, productivity, follow-up discipline, and qualified meeting conversion.
  • Regularly review SDR call recordings and live call performance to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Provide actionable feedback and coaching on call openings, value propositions, qualification, objection handling, follow-up, and meeting conversion.
  • Develop and continuously improve cold-call scripts, talk tracks, objection-handling frameworks, and follow-up cadences.
  • Track recurring objections and market feedback and use those insights to improve targeting, messaging, scripts, and campaign strategy.
  • Help establish realistic activity and conversion benchmarks for SDR performance.
  • Build repeatable SDR playbooks, SOPs, workflows, training materials, and call-review processes.

Outbound Strategy & Multichannel Growth

  • Build and optimize outbound workflows across cold calling, email, LinkedIn, and CRM-based follow-up.
  • Prioritize channels based on measurable business impact rather than activity alone.
  • Initially focus on strengthening HireHawk’s phone-based outbound engine before scaling additional outbound channels.
  • Develop email and LinkedIn outbound programs once the core SDR calling process is operating effectively.
  • Determine when email and LinkedIn should function as follow-up and air-cover channels versus independent lead-generation channels.
  • Develop persona-specific and industry-specific messaging based on buyer pain points, market feedback, and campaign performance.
  • Run structured outbound experiments across ICPs, messaging, channels, call scripts, and hiring signals.

Analytics, Reporting & Process Improvement

Analyze SDR activity and outbound campaign performance across:

  • dials
  • connect rates
  • conversations
  • positive conversations
  • meetings booked
  • show rates
  • qualified meetings
  • qualified opportunities
  • conversion rates
  • performance by list, persona, industry, and campaign
  • Identify where outbound conversion is breaking down across list quality, targeting, messaging, call execution, follow-up, or qualification.
  • Build and maintain dashboards that make outbound performance clear and actionable.
  • Use performance data to continuously improve lists, scripts, workflows, SDR execution, and campaign strategy.
  • Maintain CRM hygiene, accurate lead stages, follow-up tasks, campaign attribution, and reporting discipline.
  • Reduce unnecessary manual work through automation while maintaining high data quality and strong SDR execution.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in a staffing agency, recruitment firm, RPO, talent acquisition company, HR services business, or workforce solutions company.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and managing outbound prospecting workflows using Apollo or similar sales intelligence and engagement platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience creating, enriching, validating, segmenting, and prioritizing outbound prospect lists.
  • Strong understanding of outbound cold calling, SDR workflows, call prioritization, prospecting sequences, follow-up cadences, and qualified meeting generation.
  • Experience working directly with SDRs or BDRs and improving their performance through call review, coaching, scripts, objection handling, and process development.
  • Ability to analyze outbound funnel performance and identify whether problems are caused by targeting, list quality, messaging, call execution, follow-up, or qualification.
  • Experience building or improving outbound sales systems and processes from the ground up.
  • Experience creating multichannel outbound campaigns across phone, email, LinkedIn, and CRM-based follow-up.
  • Strong understanding of staffing and recruitment buyer personas, pain points, objections, and sales motions.
  • Experience creating outbound messaging, cold-call scripts, email copy, LinkedIn messaging, and objection-handling frameworks.
  • Experience using AI and automation tools to improve list quality, prospect research, hiring-signal identification, segmentation, personalization, campaign development, and workflow efficiency.
  • Strong analytical and operational mindset with the ability to translate outbound performance data into practical improvements.
  • Highly organized, process-driven, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Comfortable joining live sales calls, listening to SDR recordings, reviewing call notes, and providing direct performance feedback.
  • Comfortable being hands-on with execution rather than operating only at a strategy or management level.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Clay, Instantly, Smartlead, Zapier, Make, or similar GTM tools.
  • Experience managing or supporting high-volume cold-calling environments.
  • Familiarity with power dialers, parallel dialing, call analytics, and SDR productivity tools.
  • Experience developing outbound motions targeting U.S.-based SMBs and mid-market companies.
  • Experience building outbound systems in a startup or high-growth environment with limited resources.
  • Experience improving outbound performance without significantly increasing SDR headcount.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted lead research, enrichment, segmentation, call analysis, and messaging workflows.

What success looks like:

Within the first 30–60 days:

  • SDRs consistently have enough high-quality, phone-ready prospects to maintain strong daily outbound activity.
  • Prospecting and list-building workflows are structured, repeatable, and increasingly automated.
  • Call scripts, objection handling, qualification criteria, and follow-up processes are clearly documented and actively improving.
  • SDR calls are reviewed regularly and coaching is tied to measurable performance data.
  • Outbound reporting clearly identifies where conversion is succeeding or breaking down.

Within the first 90 days:

  • HireHawk has a repeatable and scalable phone-first outbound system.
  • Manual list-building requirements have been significantly reduced.
  • SDR productivity and qualified meeting generation have improved.
  • Clear outbound playbooks and SOPs are in place.
  • Email and LinkedIn campaigns are being tested and scaled based on their ability to support or independently generate qualified opportunities.
  • The outbound engine is structured well enough to support additional SDR headcount without creating operational bottlenecks.
