jobs.title: Managed Services Operations Lead - FinOps
jobs.excerpt: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business.  By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.

The Managed Services Operations Lead, FinOps is the senior technical authority for AHEAD’s Cloud FinOps service, serving as thought leader and subject matter expert for clients, partners, and internal delivery teams. The role leads the development, design, and implementation of FinOps solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and is accountable for the technical quality, consistency, and maturity of FinOps delivery across the managed services client portfolio.

Operating as a principal-level practitioner, this role owns the most complex client scenarios, serves as the primary technical escalation point for Cloud FinOps Engineers, and sets the standards, data models, automation, and reusable assets that the practice delivers against. The role also defines and drives the AI and automation roadmap for the FinOps practice, translating advanced analytics and machine learning capabilities into productized, explainable, and trusted service offerings. This is an individual contributor role that provides technical leadership, mentorship, and coordination across delivery resources without direct personnel-management responsibility.

The role requires a strategic mindset, mature executive communication skills, and commercial awareness, engaging client senior leadership, finance and procurement stakeholders, service and process owners, AHEAD service leadership, and sales teams directly. The role is performed remotely within the United States and includes up to 15 percent domestic travel, along with occasional after-hours or weekend support during major incidents, reporting deadlines, approved change windows, or other activities required by contracted service commitments.

Duties / Responsibilities

    Technical Leadership and Solution Design

    • Serve as the primary technical escalation point for Cloud FinOps Engineers supporting client engagements, resolving the most complex technical and financial analysis scenarios.
    • Act as principal engineer for high-complexity client situations requiring advanced cloud engineering, financial modeling, and cross-domain judgment.
    • Lead the development, design, and implementation of complex, mission-critical, enterprise-grade FinOps solutions, including AI-enabled capabilities where they deliver measurable client value.
    • Ensure FinOps services and deliverables are provided on time and at the highest quality standards while meeting or exceeding client expectations and contracted service commitments.
    • Develop and maintain technical roadmaps and innovation plans for supported FinOps solutions and services.
    • Establish project estimates and plans, identify risks and mitigations, and oversee the development and delivery of technical FinOps solutions.
    • Provide technical leadership and coordinate technical delivery resources across skillsets, including cross-practice work and deliverables, without direct personnel-management responsibility.
    • Provide credible time and effort estimates based on available information, and initiate and author project change requests when additional work is identified beyond agreed scope.

    Cloud Cost Analysis and Optimization

    • Lead deep-dive investigations into cloud spend drivers, billing anomalies, optimization opportunities, and cost visibility gaps across AWS, Azure, and GCP using native tooling and approved third-party FinOps platforms.
    • Define the methodology by which the practice identifies, quantifies, prioritizes, and drives optimization opportunities including rightsizing, idle resource cleanup, storage and data transfer optimization, licensing alignment, and scheduling strategies.
    • Own the framework for tracking optimization opportunities through identified, recommended, approved, implemented, and realized states, ensuring financial outcomes are validated and unrealized savings are not double-counted or misattributed.
    • Set the approach for cost visibility and allocation in containerized and Kubernetes workloads, including shared cluster cost distribution, namespace and label-based allocation, and idle capacity analysis.
    • Lead analysis and optimization of AI and GPU-related spend, including accelerated compute utilization, model training and inference costs, and consumption of managed AI and machine learning services.
    • Extend cost analysis and governance to SaaS, software licensing, and marketplace spend where these fall within the agreed scope of the engagement.
    • Define and oversee best-practices reviews that combine cost analysis with operational excellence analysis, using cloud-native and approved AHEAD tooling.

    Allocation, Unit Economics, and Reporting Architecture

    • Lead the design and implementation of scalable approaches for cost allocation, tagging strategy, showback, chargeback, budgeting, forecasting, and optimization across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
    • Define unit economics and cost-per-unit metric frameworks that tie cloud spend to business drivers such as customers, transactions, environments, products, or workloads.
    • Own the architecture of dashboards, reports, budgets, forecasts, executive summaries, and recurring service review content, and set quality standards for what the practice produces.
    • Define data validation and reconciliation standards across billing exports, connectors, cost datasets, and reporting models to improve trust in reported values, including adoption of standardized billing data formats such as FOCUS.
    • Establish continuous tagging governance through cloud-native policy enforcement, policy-as-code, and automated remediation, refining coverage as untagged or non-compliant resources are identified.
    • Set standards for client-facing FinOps tooling and portals, ensuring predictive analytics, multi-account views, and resource, configuration, and environment change reporting remain current and accurate.

    Commitment and Rate Strategy

    • Own the commitment strategy across the client portfolio, including reserved capacity and savings plan modeling, purchase governance, coverage and utilization targets, expiration and renewal planning, and savings realization tracking.
    • Lead support of enterprise agreement, private pricing, and committed-spend discussions by providing consumption analysis, commitment scenarios, and drawdown forecasts to client and AHEAD stakeholders.
    • Approve or review commitment recommendations produced by the team before they are presented to clients, ensuring financial assumptions and risk exposure are sound.

    Client Advisory, Growth, and Communication

    • Build and maintain strong client relationships, drive business growth, and identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling FinOps and adjacent AHEAD services.
    • Collaborate with clients to understand their technical, operational, and financial challenges and develop tailored FinOps solutions to address their needs.
    • Create and present solution designs, options, ideas, and innovations to clients’ senior leadership teams, and help client leadership set strategic direction beyond individual tactics.
    • Advise clients on FinOps best practices, governance models, operating models, and maturity improvements, including organizational adoption approaches such as crawl-walk-run.
    • Develop high-quality deliverables and presentations for client engineering teams, finance and procurement stakeholders, and senior leaders, including both technical and non-technical documentation.
    • Lead recurring client advisory and service review discussions covering cost and billing changes, optimization progress, roadmap items, migration candidates, and feedback on AHEAD’s service delivery performance.
    • Partner with CloudOps, DevOps, platform, application, finance, procurement, and client stakeholders to support implementation of recommendations and validate realized outcomes.
    • Maintain timely ticket updates, work documentation, meeting follow-ups, and internal and customer communications in accordance with service delivery expectations.
    • Support pre-sales, solutioning, scoping, positioning, and service maturation efforts by providing subject matter expertise, effort input, and delivery perspective, and identify and escalate new client opportunities.

    AI, Automation, and Practice Engineering

    • Define and drive the AI and automation roadmap for the FinOps practice, including use cases such as anomaly detection, rightsizing recommendations, commitment optimization, and intelligent budgeting and forecasting.
    • Evaluate and productize capabilities from FinOps platforms and cloud-native machine learning services into standard AHEAD offerings, including build-versus-buy recommendations and platform selection guidance.
    • Define the data quality, tagging, and metadata standards required for reliable AI-driven insights and automation of FinOps workflows.
    • Establish processes for monitoring and tuning models used for forecasting, anomaly detection, and optimization, ensuring transparency, explainability, and stakeholder trust in the outputs.
    • Collaborate with AHEAD’s AI, machine learning, and platform engineering teams to co-innovate joint FinOps solutions and reference architectures.
    • Build and oversee queries, data transformations, and automation using SQL and scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash, including event-driven and API-based integrations across FinOps platforms, ITSM tools, and cloud-native services.
    • Direct the integration of third-party tools, billing data sources, and reporting platforms into approved FinOps tooling and governance structures, including onboarding of new clients, accounts, subscriptions, and projects.
    • Oversee execution of approved remediation activities, including workload resizing, workload deletion, and commitment implementation, ensuring client change-control procedures and permission models are followed.

    Mentorship and Practice Development

    • Provide mentorship, coaching, and professional development opportunities to Cloud FinOps Engineers and other team members, empowering them to grow and excel in their roles.
    • Review team deliverables and analyses for technical accuracy, financial soundness, and presentation quality, elevating team capability and consistency.
    • Develop and maintain standards, procedures, data models, playbooks, work instructions, automation, and reusable assets that improve the maturity, consistency, and scalability of the FinOps practice.
    • Build team fluency in AI-assisted and automated workflows so engineers and analysts apply these tools effectively and with appropriate judgment in daily delivery.
    • Actively lead collaboration within AHEAD’s technical communities and influence team members, the broader internal organization, and external customers to adopt new concepts, best practices, and approaches.
    • Partner with Delivery Managers and service leadership to identify delivery risks, technical gaps, resourcing needs, and improvement opportunities across the FinOps practice.
    • Monitor delivery hours against contracted monthly allocations across the portfolio, flagging utilization trends and coordinating any approved overage or rescoping through the change-request process.
    • Serve as a reliable resource for thought leadership content, workshops, industry conferences, and webinars representing the practice.
    • Deliver FinOps and tooling education and training for client teams to build internal cost-management capability, in addition to mentoring within the AHEAD practice.

General

    • Maintain availability during the assigned team’s standard business hours, with reasonable flexibility to accommodate recurring client meetings and service reviews across United States time zones.
    • Participate in and provide senior escalation support for the team’s on-call or escalation rotation where applicable to the assigned account portfolio.
    • Stay current on cloud pricing models, FinOps best practices, emerging AI and analytics capabilities, and service provider roadmaps while helping refine how AHEAD delivers cloud cost optimization and advisory services.
    • Provide occasional after-hours support for client meetings, reporting deadlines, change windows, critical incidents, or urgent cost-related issues when required.
    • Maintain relevant professional and cloud certifications consistent with role, practice, and individual development requirements, and meet or exceed individual goal objectives.
    • Other job duties as assigned.

Education and Experience

    Minimum Required –

    • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, finance, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
    • 10+ years of information technology experience, including 5+ years focused on FinOps, cloud cost management, cloud governance, or related cloud engineering.
    • 5+ years in a customer-facing, stakeholder-facing, consulting, or service delivery role with responsibility for presenting findings, solution designs, and recommendations to technical, financial, and executive audiences.
    • 2+ years using and administering FinOps and cloud management platforms such as Harness CCM, Cloudability, CloudHealth, CloudZero, native cloud cost management tools, or similar solutions.
    • Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, or operating large-scale, multi-account, multi-subscription, or enterprise cloud environments.
    • Subject matter expertise in at least one major public cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) with working depth in a second; strong Azure or AWS experience preferred.
    • Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery, serving as an escalation point, and reviewing the work of other engineers for quality and consistency.
    • Proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash, sufficient to build and maintain cost data transformations, automation, and recurring reporting.
    • Multiple relevant certifications such as FinOps Certified Practitioner, FinOps Certified Professional, AWS Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, Google Cloud certifications, or similar.
    • Demonstrated experience integrating third-party tools, billing data sources, and reporting platforms.
    • Strong analytical, financial modeling, spreadsheet, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a shared services or multi-client environment.
    • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
    • Ability to successfully complete AHEAD and client-required background screening; certain client environments may require additional vetting or clearance.

Preferred Experience

    Experience working in a managed services, consulting, or outsourced service delivery environment.
    • Experience building or maturing a FinOps practice, service offering, or center of excellence, including standards, playbooks, and reusable assets.
    • Hands-on experience with cloud data and analytics platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks for aggregating and analyzing cloud cost and usage data.
    • Familiarity with machine learning and advanced analytics concepts such as time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and clustering, and how they apply to cloud cost optimization and capacity planning.
    • Experience integrating FinOps platforms with automation, orchestration, and AI services to build end-to-end workflows and recommendations.
    • Experience with policy-as-code and cloud governance tooling such as Terraform with Sentinel, Open Policy Agent, Azure Policy, or AWS Config to operationalize FinOps guardrails.
    • Experience with forecasting, budgeting, allocation methodologies, showback or chargeback models, commitment planning, and savings realization tracking.
    • Familiarity with the FinOps Framework and with standardized billing data formats such as FOCUS.
    • Experience with Kubernetes or container cost allocation, and with AI or GPU cost management.
    • Experience with reporting and visualization platforms such as Power BI or Tableau.
    • Familiarity with ticketing and workflow platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar tools.
    • Experience contributing to pre-sales activities, including scoping, positioning, proposal support, and technology adoption.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

    Expert-level understanding of cloud billing constructs including on-demand usage, reserved capacity, savings plans or commitments, amortization, allocation methods, and forecasting drivers.
    • Expert-level experience analyzing cloud billing data, usage trends, tagging compliance, and optimization opportunities across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
    • Hands-on experience designing and implementing FinOps capabilities around cost visibility, allocation, governance, optimization, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
    • Experience with enterprise cloud platforms and services across compute, storage, networking, databases, containers, security, and identity, with the ability to connect technical design decisions to financial outcomes.
    • Knowledge of enterprise FinOps principles including crawl-walk-run adoption models, cloud-native cost optimization strategies, governance frameworks, infrastructure as code, and cloud operating models.
    • Working knowledge of unit economics concepts and the ability to connect infrastructure consumption to business and product metrics.
    • Understanding of cost behavior in containerized, serverless, data platform, and accelerated computing environments.
    • Understanding of performance, scaling, and functional characteristics of cloud and open-source technologies, with the ability to recommend standard design patterns and best practices.
    • Experience driving organizational adoption of transformational initiatives such as FinOps, cloud governance, cost accountability, showback, chargeback, and operational maturity improvement.
    • Knowledge of enterprise organizations across multiple industries and internal IT functions such as enterprise architecture, operations, finance, procurement, and security.
    • Strong consulting and business acumen, with the ability to translate technical, automation, and AI capabilities into clear business value, return on investment, and executive-ready narratives.
    • Ability to work through a solution live with a client, including whiteboarding a FinOps approach to a business, financial, or technology challenge without prior preparation.
    • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with a professional customer-facing presence and the ability to lead executive-level advisory discussions.
    • Ability to communicate technical and financial concepts clearly to technical, operational, procurement, finance, and executive audiences.
    • Ability to lead work independently in the highest-complexity situations while collaborating effectively across distributed teams, time zones, and functions.
    • Strong documentation, organization, and time management skills with consistent follow-through and attention to detail.
    • Demonstrated ownership mindset with the ability to balance competing priorities in a fast-paced multi-client environment while maintaining service quality.
    • Continuous improvement mindset with an interest in automation, standardization, methodology refinement, and scalable service delivery.
    • Ability to mentor others, improve team capability, and contribute positively to practice development and knowledge sharing.
    • Strong project and situational awareness, with the judgment to escalate appropriately and accept responsibility for individual and team outcomes.

Culture and Expectations

    Support initiatives beyond immediate area of responsibility and encourage cross-team interaction.
    • Motivate people to think creatively and achieve success through others rather than through individual action alone.
    • Consistently pursue self-development and advance the AHEAD delivery model for self and teammates.
    • Operate as a self-starter who identifies needed work proactively rather than waiting for direction.
    • Earn and maintain the respect of engineering peers, delivery leadership, and the sales organization.
    • Bring a positive, team-oriented attitude toward AHEAD, its clients, and its partners, including willingness to extend effort beyond normal working hours for short intervals to support a client initiative or production rollout.

Physical Requirements

    The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions, in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), and other applicable federal, state, and local laws.

    Performance of Essential Functions: Ability to safely and effectively perform all essential job functions listed herein while meeting established productivity and quality standards.

    Attendance: Ability to maintain regular and predictable attendance, consistent with ADA, FMLA, and other applicable requirements. Includes ability to safely and reliably travel to and from an office and/or client work site, as required.

    Work Environment: Ability to perform job duties in primarily remote, office, client site, or technical environments, which may include:

    • Extended periods of sitting, typing, and working at a computer or in virtual meetings.
    • Occasional standing, walking, bending, and lifting or moving laptops, monitors, or small equipment, generally up to twenty (20) pounds.
    • Occasional exposure to client or production environments that may include higher noise levels, bright lighting, varying airflow, and changing temperatures.

nesto is Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS, nesto, and Nesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at:

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

About the team

You’ll be joining the Servicing stream, the product area responsible for the post-funding mortgage journey. This includes borrower self-serve experiences, agent-facing servicing tools, payment and prepayment workflows, renewals, payouts, statements, fees, exceptions management, and core servicing operations.

This is a Senior Product Manager role where part of your mandate is to help shape and own a specific servicing substream. You’ll work closely with the stream lead to define the boundaries of your focus area based on your strengths, the team’s needs, and the largest opportunities to improve the borrower and agent experience.

Your closest collaborators will include engineering teams building on Nesto Cloud, servicing operations experts who manage these workflows every day, and internal stakeholders across compliance, finance, contact centre, and growth operations.

What you’ll be doing

  • Act as one of the primary servicing subject matter experts for your substream, with a deep understanding of end-to-end servicing processes, operational realities, and regulatory requirements.
  • Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and prioritization for your area, ensuring it reflects real servicing needs, operational efficiency goals, risk controls, and compliance considerations.
  • Identify and assess the impact of new servicing features, policy changes, regulatory updates, and workflow improvements to help shape product direction and support strategic decisions.
  • Work closely with engineering, design, QA, operations, compliance, and support teams to validate solutions and ensure they align with servicing best practices and industry standards.
  • Support backlog refinement by prioritizing servicing-related epics and stories, balancing borrower experience, agent efficiency, technical feasibility, and business value.
  • Participate in release planning, UAT, and launch readiness to ensure servicing use cases are fully supported, edge cases are addressed, and downstream impacts are understood.
  • Conduct research on servicing trends, mortgage regulations, servicing technologies, and competitor approaches, bringing insights that inform product evolution.
  • Create and maintain clear documentation of servicing workflows, requirements, scenarios, decision logic, and system behaviours to support cross-functional teams.
  • Act as the go-to expert for your servicing workflows, supporting issue triage, answering questions, and helping the team deliver exceptional servicing experiences across lending products.

AI-augmented ways of working

  • Actively use AI tools such as Cursor, Claude, Figma AI, Gemini, and others to accelerate your PM workflow from discovery through delivery, including synthesis, prototyping, documentation, and measurement.
  • Move quickly to test hypotheses using the tools available. Build rough prototypes, pressure-test ideas, and use fast experiments to get to answers sooner.
  • Stay close to the work. The best people here do not hand things off and wait. They use every tool available to move the work forward.
  • Stay ahead of how AI is reshaping mortgage servicing and bring informed recommendations into the roadmap.
  • Share what you learn so your way of working improves the team around you.

Who we’re looking for

  • 5–7+ years of hands-on product management experience, ideally with exposure to mortgage servicing, lending operations, or a closely adjacent regulated financial services environment.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end servicing functions, including payments, prepayments, renewals, payouts, fees, statements, borrower communications, and exception handling.
  • Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements related to mortgage servicing and consumer lending, including provincial regulations, OSFI guidelines, insurance considerations, and reporting obligations.
  • Experience working with servicing platforms, loan management systems, or lending technology, with the ability to translate operational needs into clear product requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across product, engineering, design, operations, compliance, QA, and support teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate downstream impacts, identify edge cases, and improve complex servicing workflows.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex servicing concepts clearly to non-experts in Product and Engineering.
  • Proven, active fluency with AI tools across discovery, testing, documentation, analysis, and measurement. We will ask you specifically how you use them.

Preferred but not required

  • Experience with other lending products such as HELOC, personal loans, private lending, reverse mortgages, or construction financing.
  • Familiarity with borrower-facing and agent-facing servicing journeys, including the relationship between self-serve and assisted support.
  • Exposure to AI or ML-assisted servicing operations, intelligent routing, document intelligence, or workflow automation in a financial services context.

How we get to know each other

  • Recruiter Screen – 30 minutes
  • Discovery Call with Director of Product – 30 minutes
  • Take-home Assignment followed by Presentation and Q&A – 60 minutes
  • Final Stakeholder Interview – 45 minutes

Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the role

We are looking for a Staff Data Scientist, Data Products to serve as a senior analytical and product partner across Syndio's product and data-product portfolio. You will own measurement strategies for our product platform, translate usage and business data into product decisions, and help turn those signals — together with pay-equity, policy, job architecture, market, and workforce data — into customer-facing analytical products.

This is a high-autonomy, high-visibility staff role. You will lead ambiguous, cross-functional work from opportunity discovery through methodology, validation, production, and launch; partner with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Privacy, Legal, Sales, and Customer Success; and set standards for analytical rigor, interpretability, data quality, and responsible data use. The role is an individual contributor position with broad influence.

Why this job is exciting

Product Measurement & Decision Support

  • Own measurement strategies for Syndi's core user workflows — including offer endorsement, approval, and acceptance — defining events, metrics, and success criteria that guide product decisions.
  • Partner with engineering to design and validate event instrumentation for new features, ensuring tracking is accurate, consistent, and privacy-safe from the start.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses into feature adoption, workflow completion, user engagement, customer outcomes, and operational patterns to surface actionable insights.
  • Build and maintain production-grade dashboards and self-serve reporting in Mixpanel, BigQuery, and BI tooling that give product teams and senior leaders visibility into product health.
  • Translate complex, ambiguous usage data into clear, prioritized recommendations for technical, product, and executive audiences.

Data Product Development

  • Define and lead analytical strategies for new compensation and workforce data products that make Syndio more valuable, differentiated, and difficult to replicate.
  • Identify high-value opportunities to combine Syndio's aggregated and anonymized first-party data with compensation market data, job-posting and skills data, and other third-party sources.
  • Develop diagnostics that measure compensation governance and execution health, including policy-versus-practice gaps, job-architecture health, governance adoption, strategic alignment, and overpayment risk.
  • Lead complex initiatives from early exploration and hypothesis formation through analytical validation, productionization, commercialization, and launch.
  • Evaluate whether proposed data products are analytically defensible, interpretable, commercially valuable, privacy-preserving, and responsible to use.
  • Contribute to the give-to-get data strategy by identifying which product and customer signals can strengthen Syndio's broader data assets over time.

Cross-functional Leadership & Standards

  • Serve as a senior analytical partner in product discovery, sprint planning, roadmap discussions, business reviews, and product planning cycles.
  • Partner with Data Science on experiment design, causal analysis, model evaluation, and measurement of model-assisted workflows.
  • Work with Customer Success and Sales to connect product usage and data-product insights to customer value, health, and renewal risk.
  • Establish and champion standards for event data, analytical quality, documentation, interpretability, privacy, and responsible data use.
  • Provide technical and analytical leadership to other practitioners, raise data literacy across the product organization, and build self-serve capability.

About you

  • 8+ years of experience in product analytics, data science, analytics engineering, or a closely related role, including substantial experience supporting software products and/or developing analytical products.
  • Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools and workflows, using them to accelerate analysis, prototyping, code generation, documentation, and data-product development while validating outputs and exercising sound judgment.
  • Familiarity with emerging AI and BI innovation — including natural-language interfaces, automated insights, semantic layers, and agentic workflows — and the ability to evaluate where these capabilities can improve analytical products and customer experiences.
  • A track record of setting direction and leading complex, cross-functional initiatives with significant product or business impact.
  • Deep proficiency in SQL and strong working proficiency with Python, R, or a comparable analytical language.
  • Advanced knowledge of statistical measurement, benchmarking, experimentation, data modeling, segmentation, data quality assessment, and analytical validation.
  • Experience designing event schemas, product measurement strategies, funnels, dashboards, and self-serve reporting using tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, Looker, Tableau, or equivalent.
  • Experience combining large, imperfect datasets into analytically defensible, interpretable, and commercially valuable products or insights.
  • Exceptional judgment and comfort operating in ambiguous, evolving problem spaces; able to determine when approximation is appropriate and when precision is required.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders, communicate complex methodologies clearly, and drive alignment across technical and non-technical audiences.

Extra Credit

  • Experience instrumenting or evaluating a GenAI-native product, including model-assisted workflows.
  • Deep familiarity with compensation, pay equity, workforce planning, labor-market data, job architecture, skills taxonomies, or people analytics.
  • Experience with compensation surveys, job-posting data, privacy-preserving analytics, or third-party data licensing and governance.
  • Familiarity with GDPR/CCPA and related privacy considerations for user-level event data and aggregated or anonymized customer data.

Why you'll love it here:

  • 💰 Competitive Compensation. For this role our salary is targeted at $180,000 -$205,000 per year. Final offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience and expertise. We take a geo neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location.
  • 🏆 Syndio Equity. So you can share in Syndio’s success.
  • 🏝 Flexible Vacation Policy. We encourage our team to recharge when they need to, plus paid sick & safe time, compassion leave, and voting leave.
  • Paid parental leave

  • 🏥 Life Insurance & Disability. Syndio covers the full premium.
  • 🏦 401(k). To help you save for your future
  • Fully remote model -

The interview overview

  • Three video interviews with several team members
  • Final interviews with executive

If you share these values and are interested in joining us, we'd love to talk with you even if you don't 100% meet the "about you" listed here. jobs.excerpt: About Linkfire and the teamLinkfire is the marketing platform the music industry uses to connect fans with the music they love.
jobs.description:
About Linkfire and the team

Linkfire is the marketing platform the music industry uses to connect fans with the music they love. Thousands of artists and labels use our smart links every day, and rely on our reporting to understand how their campaigns perform. Every click runs through our platform and lands on the right streaming service in milliseconds, millions of times a day.

Our .NET services carry a large part of the platform: the APIs the product runs on, the integrations with the major streaming services, the scanning that keeps links valid across them, and the email marketing integrations behind fan communication.

Engineering is small and distributed, which means a wide surface area and real ownership rather than a slice of a slice. You would work alongside the engineers who have been building this platform for years, and they will spend real time bringing you into how it all fits together.

What you will do

  • Take .NET and API work from a roadmap item through spec to production. The thinking before the code and the follow-through after it, not only the implementation.
  • Own contained parts of the platform end to end, and grow that scope as you learn the systems.
  • Build the APIs the frontend and data sides of the team depend on, so design decisions get made with them rather than handed over.
  • Break large work into pieces that is shipable, flag risk early, and say clearly when something is going to be late.
  • Explain what you are building, and why, to people who are not engineers.
  • Use generative AI as part of how you work.

What we are looking for

  • Three or more years building .NET services and APIs, with enough depth that you can take a medium to large feature to production without anyone checking on you.
  • The ability to go from a roadmap item to a spec to working software, including asking the questions that need answering before any code gets written.
  • Pragmatism. You pick the simplest thing that works and can explain the trade-off you made.
  • You already use AI in your daily work and have formed opinions about where it helps and where it gets in the way. Tell us about it when you apply, we expect you to.
  • Curiosity that does not stop at your own stack. We work T-shaped, so depth in .NET with real interest in the surrounding pieces matters more to us than a longer list of technologies.
  • You say what you think, including when you disagree with someone more experienced than you.
  • Clear writing. Most of our communication is asynchronous and written.
  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

The stack

  • .NET 10, with ASP.NET Core Web API and gRPC for the internal and public-facing APIs we run at scale.
  • EF Core on SQL Server for data access, with Elasticsearch for search and Redis for caching.
  • AWS as our cloud platform, with SQS and SNS for messaging between services.
  • Docker and Kubernetes for containerised deployment.
  • GitHub, GitHub Actions and Terraform for CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
  • OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Mimir and Tempo for observability and monitoring in production.
  • NUnit and Testcontainers for unit, integration, end-to-end and performance testing, as part of the workflow rather than after it.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing APIs that other teams consume, and an API-first mindset.
  • Experience working asynchronously in a distributed team where you had to own decisions yourself.
  • Exposure to the pieces around the backend: frontend, data, or cloud infrastructure.

Location

Anywhere within European timezones. Copenhagen office if you want one, fully remote if you do not. This is a full-time permanent role.

Why join Linkfire

  • Engineers who will invest in you. You join people with deep knowledge of the platform whose explicit job is to bring you up to their level, not to hand you tickets.
  • Scale you can see. Millions of fan interactions a day, and your work sits behind it.
  • High ownership and real impact. A small team and a large platform, so what you build matters and you can point at it.
  • Remote-first culture. Flexibility, and colleagues across several countries.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits. A package that recognises your expertise and contribution.

About Kalepa:

Insurance is a $7T global industry built on professional labor: underwriting, claims, pricing, operations, and distribution. Kalepa is building AI that can perform that work.

We create professional-grade AI systems for insurers: software that can read, reason, decide, and act inside real workflows and operate over long-time horizons. Kalepa begins by augmenting professionals with the tools to succeed at their jobs. That earns us the right to learn from real decisions, capture decision traces, and automate what can be automated successfully over time.

Our products are already in production with leading insurers, driving measurable outcomes and expanding across functions. The opportunity is far broader than any single workflow: to build the AI operating system for decision-making across insurance. For people who want to work on AI that matters, in a sector where correctness, trust, and real-world impact count, Kalepa is just getting started.

Kalepa is backed by leading investors such as IA Ventures and Inspired Capital, and our team brings experience from Facebook, Palantir, Google, Amazon, McKinsey, Mastercard, and Uber.

Our Values (This is important):

Many organizations have a dusty list of corporate values that no one ever follows. Kalepa is not one of those companies. Our values are designed to unlock the potential of our employees.

Success at Kalepa is bred from five core principles:

  • Hustle and Determination - We hire people who take full ownership of their craft and relentlessly pursue excellence with speed and determination. We choose the hard problems and do not give up. This is the foundation of how we work and how we win.
  • Deliver Customer Impact - We're obsessed with customer impact. Every feature, every line of code, every decision is measured against one question: does this help insurers make better decisions? If it doesn't drive speed, accuracy, or profitability for our customers, we don't build it.
  • Meritocracy - We're building something exceptional, and that requires exceptional people and ideas. We have a high bar but we reward excellence with rapid growth. If you're the best at what you do, you'll thrive here.
  • Transparency - We value honest, transparent communication over politics. We challenge ideas, not people. We say what needs to be said, even when it's hard. This is how we solve problems fast and find the truth.
  • Experiment Relentlessly - Many of the problems we face have never been solved before. We tackle them by testing quickly, measuring rigorously, and iterating until we find the path forward. Speed of learning is our advantage.

In addition to our NY office, we have remote employees speaking 10+ languages across the globe. But we invest in bringing our people together both for regional meetups and global offsites (2021 - Playa Del Carmen | 2022 - Rome | 2023 - Buenos Aires | 2024 - Lisbon | 2025 - Cartagena).

Kalepa’s culture isn’t for everyone, and that’s ok. But for the people who are a fit, they can’t imagine working elsewhere.

About the role:

Your day-to-day will involve designing and building API endpoints, improving database and query performance, and integrating with a wide range of third-party services. You’ll translate product requirements into reliable business logic, help diagnose and resolve customer issues, and contribute to making our platform faster, more stable, and easier to use.

You'll collaborate with a global team of full-stack, data, ML, and DevOps engineers to build scalable backend solutions as we continue to grow. We're a small team where individual contributions have an outsized impact on both our technology and our business.

You'll be right at home if you:

Large-scale language models are evolving into engines of discovery, education, and engineering. To get there, they need sharper reasoning and better datasets. As a Machine Learning Specialist, you will take on hands-on ML challenges that feel like research competitions, but with direct impact on next-generation AI.

What You’ll DoOn a typical day, you will:

  • Solve applied ML tasks: iterating on problems that test and improve model reasoning, from baseline solutions to optimized workflows.
  • Evaluate scientific writing: compare research abstracts and introductions using review rubrics (e.g., NeurIPS guidelines) for clarity, correctness, and impact.
  • Debug advanced model behavior: probe LLMs on optimization, fairness, regularization, transformers, and applied NLP, documenting failure modes.
  • Design new benchmark tasks: identify datasets, analyze state-of-the-art papers, build evaluation scripts, and provide reference implementations.
  • Improve training datasets: deliver structured feedback that makes AI outputs more accurate, reliable, and useful.

What you’ll Bring

  • Strong background in machine learning, NLP, or data science.
  • Experience with supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, probabilistic modeling, and applied NLP.
  • Proficiency in Python, ML frameworks, and cloud-based workflows.
  • Master’s or PhD in CS/ML/data science preferred; peer-reviewed research or production ML systems a strong plus.
  • Clear communication skills, able to explain reasoning and “show your work.”

Why Join

  • Turn your ML problem-solving into real-world impact: your work trains and strengthens cutting-edge AI.
  • Be part of novel AI training initiatives: evaluating models, shaping datasets, and designing challenges at the research frontier.
  • Enjoy flexibility: remote, contract-based work with autonomy to set your schedule.

Ready to turn your machine learning expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world. We offer a pay range of $30-$50 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location.

Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

jobs.excerpt: The Project Manager Role in Exelab's Tailor-Made SolutionsAt Exelab, we build custom, innovative solutions that directly target our clients' unique business objectives.
jobs.description:
The Project Manager Role in Exelab's Tailor-Made Solutions

At Exelab, we build custom, innovative solutions that directly target our clients' unique business objectives. Each client engagement is essentially treated as a mini product development cycle: we start from a specific business goal or problem and craft a tailor-made solution (which might involve software, AI models, systems integration, etc.) to deliver measurable business impact. The Project Manager is responsible for ensuring that each project is delivered on time, on budget, and with the client properly informed and aligned throughout the process. This is not a role where you manage one large program for months. At Exelab, the PM follows several projects simultaneously across different clients, industries, and complexity levels: from ambitious custom product builds to smaller support and assistance contracts. This variety demands strong organizational discipline, the ability to context-switch rapidly, and enough understanding of each project to govern it effectively without needing to be involved in every detail.

Key Responsibilities

The Project Manager ensures the operational health of multiple client engagements simultaneously. Their core responsibilities include:

  • Budget, Timeline & Resource Governance: Own the financial and operational dimension of each project. Plan and track budgets, define realistic timelines, and ensure the right resources are allocated on a weekly basis. When trade-offs arise between scope, time, and cost, the PM structures the options, communicates them clearly to the client, and ensures a decision is made without stalling the project.

  • Client Communication & Expectation Setting: Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for clients: handling scheduling, responding to questions and escalations, planning activities, and keeping the client informed about progress. The PM sets expectations firmly and fairly, ensuring the client understands what will be delivered, when, and at what cost. When things don't go as planned, the PM communicates transparently and works toward a resolution rather than over-promising to keep the client happy.

  • Delivery Monitoring & Project Control: Track the progress of each project across its phases, ensuring deliverables are completed within the agreed timeline and budget. The Value Builder owns the product and its outcomes, and keeps the PM aligned on progress. The PM's focus is operational governance. In smaller engagements without a Value Builder, the PM takes on a broader scope, including more direct involvement in planning and client-facing decisions.

  • Multi-Project Organization: Maintain clarity and control across a portfolio of parallel projects at different stages and of varying sizes. This requires disciplined personal organization, effective use of project management tools, and the ability to switch context rapidly without losing track of anything. The PM proactively flags risks before they become problems and maintains a clear picture of each project's status at all times. AI tools are used directly in daily work to accelerate planning, documentation, and tracking.

In summary, the Project Manager at Exelab is the person who makes sure projects actually get delivered. They own the operational dimension (budget, timeline, resources, client communication) and ensure that the team's work translates into results the client can see. They treat each engagement as a delivery commitment with clear scope, timeline, and budget, adapting their level of involvement to the project's complexity but always maintaining visibility and control over what's happening and what comes next.

Requirements

Ideal Candidate Profile – Skills and Experience

Our ideal candidate combines operational discipline with enough understanding of the solutions being delivered to govern projects credibly. This is not a role that requires doing the technical work, but it requires understanding it well enough to know when things are on track and when they're not.

  • Multi-Project Management Experience: Solid track record of managing several projects simultaneously, with direct accountability for budgets, timelines, and deliverables. Experience in consulting, agencies, system integrators, or similar multi-client environments is particularly relevant. We want someone who has managed the full lifecycle of projects (from kick-off to go-live), including the phases where things don't go as planned and trade-offs need to be made quickly.

  • Client-Facing Communication & Firmness: Excellent communication is essential, but we specifically need someone who can set expectations and hold the line when necessary. Not someone who accommodates every client request to keep them happy, but someone who builds trust through reliability, transparency, and the ability to say "no" (or "not now, and here's why") without damaging the relationship. Experience managing client relationships where you had to deliver difficult messages and maintain trust is directly relevant.

  • Solution Understanding: The PM must understand the solutions well enough to govern projects credibly. Experience with CRM platforms, system integrations, or enterprise software helps, but we are not looking for a technical specialist. We need someone who can follow a technical discussion, understand what's being built, and recognize when something is off track. Prior hands-on experience with implementation projects is valued because it builds this intuition, but the PM role itself is about governance, not execution.

  • Learning Agility & Domain Flexibility: Every project is a different client in a different industry. The PM must be able to rapidly understand new business contexts and adapt. Deep expertise in one domain matters less than the demonstrated ability to quickly become effective in unfamiliar territory. A candidate who has successfully managed projects across several different industries will stand out over someone with many years in a single vertical.

  • Organizational Rigor & Autonomy: Managing multiple projects simultaneously requires disciplined self-organization and the ability to work autonomously. We need someone who prioritizes proactively, maintains clarity across parallel workstreams, and flags issues before they become emergencies. Practical, adaptive rigor matters more than rigid adherence to heavy methodologies.

  • Native Italian and at least B2-level English required.

In summary, an ideal candidate profile might read: "Experienced project manager with a track record of managing multiple client projects simultaneously; able to set expectations firmly while maintaining trust; understands technical solutions well enough to govern delivery without doing the work; adapts rapidly to new industries and client contexts; organized, autonomous, and focused on making sure things actually get done."

About HighLevel:HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role:

HighLevel is looking for passionate SDET3 for its Full-time remote engineering team in India. You will be responsible for ensuring that the new releases we make for features, enhancements, or new products meet the strict standards of quality & consistency. The buck stops at you and you will have the final say on the correctness, reliability & consistency of our builds.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and evolve the test automation platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and ease of use
  • Design and maintain robust automation frameworks across UI, API, and backend layers
  • Build and enhance internal QA tools that improve test efficiency
  • Drive adoption of automation best practices, coding standards, and efficient test design
  • Implement and maintain test observability systems for reporting, analytics, and defect insights
  • Conduct performance, load, and scalability testing for key features and services
  • Develop and maintain test infrastructure, supporting containerized and distributed environments
  • Collaborate closely with developers, QA, and DevOps to embed quality throughout the delivery pipeline
  • Improve test reliability and flakiness detection through intelligent retry and failure analysis systems
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of tooling, test data management, and CI/CD quality gates
  • Research and implement emerging technologies (AI/ML, LLMs, smart test generation, etc.) to advance test automation capabilities
  • Advocate for shift-left quality, influencing design and architecture discussions for better testability
  • Maintain clear documentation and onboarding materials for test frameworks and platform usage

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years in software testing or automation for web applications, SaaS platforms, or large-scale systems
  • Technical Depth: Proven expertise in designing and maintaining test automation frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, etc.)
  • Programming Skills: Strong in TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python — capable of writing scalable, maintainable automation code
  • Infrastructure Knowledge: Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Cloud Proficiency: Working knowledge of GCP or AWS for test infrastructure and environment setup
  • API & Backend Testing: Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, request validation, and integration testing
  • Performance Testing: Experience with tools like k6, Locust, or JMeter for load and scalability validation
  • Observability & Reporting: Familiarity with test reporting dashboards, metrics tracking, and alerting (Grafana, Prometheus, Slack integrations)
  • Debugging Skills: Strong ability to diagnose failures in distributed systems and identify root causes quickly
  • Architecture Awareness: Solid understanding of system design, micro-services, databases, and data flow across layers
  • AI/ML Awareness (Preferred): Exposure to AI-assisted testing or LLM-based test generation is a plus
  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills with a cross-functional mindset
  • Mindset: Ownership-driven, curious about platform scalability, and passionate about building tools that enable others to test better

jobs.excerpt: Candidates MUST be located and residing in the State of California WelbeHealth is a value-based healthcare organization that’s transforming the future of senior care by providing an all-inclusive care option to our most vulnerable senior population.
jobs.description:
Candidates MUST be located and residing in the State of California

WelbeHealth is a value-based healthcare organization that’s transforming the future of senior care by providing an all-inclusive care option to our most vulnerable senior population. We step in as the care provider and care planner that work to keep our participants within their communities, out of institutions, and cared for like family, all while receiving the healthcare and social services needed to thrive.

The Senior Director, Network Strategy will lead the development and execution of provider network strategy and contracting across WelbeHealth. The role combines strategic planning, operational leadership, and complex provider negotiations, with accountability for network adequacy, market expansion support, financial stewardship, and enterprise-wide collaboration. The Senior Director, Network Strategy will lead a team focused on network strategy and contracting, while partnering closely with Network Management, Operations, Finance, Analytics, Compliance, clinical leadership, and market teams. This role plays a key part in shaping how WelbeHealth builds provider relationships to support growth, participant access, and long-term value.

This role is different because the Senior Director, Network Strategy at WelbeHealth:

  • Combines strategic network leadership with hands-on provider contracting, providing the opportunity to shape how WelbeHealth builds, strengthens, and expands provider relationships while directly influencing network access, quality, and financial sustainability
  • Plays a critical role in WelbeHealth’s continued growth and market expansion, with a strong focus on California health system and provider relationships

We care about our team members. That’s why we offer:

  • Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Work/life balance - We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days
  • 401K savings + match
  • Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus
  • And additional benefits!

On the day-to-day, you will:

  • Develop and lead enterprise network strategies across existing and emerging markets, supporting market expansion efforts by designing strategies aligned to growth plans and local market dynamics
  • Assess and monitor network adequacy to ensure participants have timely access to high-quality providers, specialists, hospitals, and ancillary services, as well as identify network gaps, access barriers, and market-specific needs, developing strategies to address them
  • Monitor industry trends, regulatory requirements, and competitive market conditions that may impact network development and strategy
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of network strategy and contracting professionals, including managers and directors, providing strategic guidance and operational support to regional and field-based team members
  • Foster strong collaboration across departments including Finance, Analytics, Operations, clinical leadership, Compliance, and growth teams
  • Lead outreach and complex negotiations with hospitals, health systems, large physician groups, and other strategic provider partners
  • Explore innovative contracting approaches tied to outcomes such as improved participant access, care coordination, medical record retrieval, quality performance, and operational responsiveness

Job requirements include:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • Minimum of ten (10) years of experience in provider network strategy and managed care contracting
  • Must have experience leading negotiations with hospitals, health systems, and large provider organizations
  • Knowledge of network adequacy standards, provider operations, reimbursement methodologies, and value-based care models
  • Must have demonstrated success building provider networks across multiple markets or regions, with a focus on California
  • Must have experience within Medicare, Medicaid, managed care, PACE, or value-based care environments
  • Two (2) years of supervisory experience with demonstrated ability to mentor and develop team members
  • Strong leadership experience managing high-performing teams in a matrixed organization

If you’re a strategic network leader who is energized by building strong provider partnerships, navigating complex negotiations, and shaping networks that expand access to high-quality care, we’d love to hear from you!

Compensation consists of base salary plus bonus. WelbeHealth offers a competitive total rewards package that includes a 401(k) match, comprehensive healthcare coverage, and a broad range of additional benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience and relevant qualifications.

Compensation Offering
$168,895.66—$232,231.53 USD

In this spirit, please note that we have a vaccination policy for all our employees and proof of vaccination, or a vaccine declination form will be required prior to employment. WelbeHealth maintains required infection control and PPE standards and has requirements relevant to all team members regarding vaccinations.

jobs.description:
About Net at Work

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid-size businesses. Our award-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

About this Position

The Sage X3 Functional Consultant’s (FC) role is to plan, design, develop, and launch efficient information and operations systems in support of core organizational functions for Net at Work’s clients. Using both business and technical skills, the FC works directly with customers to identify business requirements with enough detail and clarity to allow technical solution proposal development.

The FC will apply proven communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills to help identify, communicate, and resolve systems issues in order to maximize the benefit of IT systems investments. Additionally, the FC works with the sales team to develop and close service projects and maintain customer relationships to ensure customer satisfaction and ease of ongoing support.

Job Responsibilities

SOW Activities and Delivery of Projects

  • Conduct analysis of client business processes and functional requirements.
  • Prepares appropriate documentation to communicate and validate the information.
  • Analyze data, evaluate existing application products, and recommend efficient, cost-effective solutions that support client business processes and functional requirements.
  • Document functional requirements, workflow, and system specifications.
  • Become familiar with the functions of client’s key systems in order to easily identify integration points and make recommendations.
  • Delivery of all projects in a defined area; ensure projects are completed at or ahead of schedule, costs are managed to budget, and customer expectations are exceeded.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet and/or exceed client expectations.
  • Work with clients throughout system testing and product acceptance phases to ensure quality and customer satisfaction.
  • Support sales team with business opportunities by assisting with estimate and proposal generation, performing demos, and responding to customer Pre-sales requests as needed.
  • Manage and support relationships and install products for existing clients. This includes handling questions, solving problems, writing reports, performing upgrades, as well as ensuring the client’s general satisfaction with the software and the company.
  • Promote value billing and efficiency in service delivery.

Functional Product Expertise

  • Develop subject matter expertise on Sage X3 product and serve as an escalation point for any implementation issues.
  • Apply technical and business knowledge to analyze client requirements and match them to system functionality.
  • Perform gap analysis, identify options, and make recommendations on best methods to address gaps including customization, third-party products, process changes and/or other industry best practices.
  • Complete required training and development regarding product versions, updates, and changes within the assigned time frame.

Industry and Best Practice Expertise

  • Develop technical and industry-specific knowledge on an ongoing basis and keep up to date with industry trends and the latest technology solutions.

Knowledge Share with Team and Clients

  • Interact with peers and managers to share knowledge, raise critical issues, and suggest process improvements.
  • Develop and maintain positive relationships with key client/partner/stakeholders to ensure effective communication channels exist and client/partner satisfaction is achieved.
  • Proactively seek/create opportunities to participate in client interactions to share knowledge and ensure the highest levels of customer satisfaction are achieved.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, quality assurance or equivalent work experience required.
  • Advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of Sage X3 ERP implementation or implementation of similar ERP solutions (Epicor, Infor, Syspro, Chempax, Workday, ProcessPRO, MS Dynamics)
  • Must have experience implementing ERP solutions within Distribution Manufacturing. Experience working with Bills of Materials, scheduling, Shipping, EDI Integrations, etc.
  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent, required.
  • A consulting background with a record of delivering complex software solutions within defined timeframes and budgets.
  • Strong business expertise, a keen understanding of business needs, and the ability to ensure technical solutions, strategies, and practices, and deliver business and customer value.
  • Experience translating business requirements into solution specifications.
  • Experience leading requirements definition and design sessions through use of interviews, surveys, user workshops, product/prototype demos, etc.
  • Successful track record of delivering on agreed-upon business objectives and performance on key metrics.
  • Ability to effectively document business and technical designs.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
  • Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Strong relationship and social skills with the ability to build and manage a strategic external industry network.

This is a remote role that will require a minimum of 50% travel to client locations in the US.

Customer Requirements

This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

Core Competencies

  • Client Champion – Relentlessly exceed client expectations. Consistently anticipate needs to deliver valuable solutions and extraordinary outcomes.
  • Problem Solver – Smart, analytical, inquisitive, knowledge-seeker that thrives on a challenge.
  • Promise Keeper – Place high value on keeping our word and doing the right thing. Demonstrate honesty, integrity, and commitment.
  • Collaborative Integrator –Team player, unifier, relationship-oriented, win-win seeker, exemplify the concept of relationships through trust and unity.
  • Driven Intrapreneur – Exceed goals using independent creative thinking, optimism, self-confidence, and a can-do attitude.
  • Inspiring Coach – Help employees, clients and partners using knowledge, expertise, experience, and situational fluency.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range: $95,000- $125,000.

This position is also eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the Company's plan.

Please note that the quoted pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) experience, including industry or product-specific experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, and/or other applicable laws. 

We provide competitive, affordable, and diverse benefit programs that support your total health – from healthy body to healthy mind. These benefits support you and your family in all aspects of life:

  • Health and Welfare (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Transportation and Parking Accounts
  • Health Savings Accounts (with company contribution)
  • Retirement Planning (401k with matching contribution)
  • Legal Benefits
  • Identity Theft Protection
  • Pet Insurance
  • Wellness Program Offerings
  • Paid Time Off, accrued per pay period based on years of service starting at 15 days annually.
  • 8 Paid Holidays per year, including 1 floating holiday.

The compensation and benefits information is accurate of the date of this posting and subject to plan eligibility. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

The Company expects to accept applications for this position until July 31, 2026 but encourages interested applicants to apply as soon as possible. We will review this information and one of our Talent Acquisition professionals will reach out if your background aligns to the positions.
