jobs.title: Senior Director, Technology Strategic Sourcing & Category Management
jobs.excerpt: Our team members are at the heart of everything we do.
jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Serves as the single accountable owner for one or more technology categories within Cencora's global data and technology indirect spend portfolio, covering sourcing strategy, negotiation, supplier management, and portfolio and demand management for that scope. Owns the category roadmap for both near-term execution and multi-year delivery, and establishes clear sub-category ownership so every area of spend has a named owner. Directs enterprise-wide negotiations with major technology providers and owns the supplier performance, risk, and value agenda for assigned categories. Leads a team of Director-level category owners and sourcing professionals, building capability and a culture of accountability and commercial rigor. Acts as the defined sourcing business partner to assigned Technology senior leaders, translating their roadmaps and budgets into a forward demand plan so sourcing gets ahead of requirements rather than reacting to them. Establishes the governance, controls, and performance measures that convert category strategy into realized savings, improved service levels, and managed third-party risk.

Responsibilities

  • Directs technology category strategies for assigned spend areas, including demand assessment, sourcing approach, supplier segmentation, risk evaluation, and value engineering initiatives.

  • Leads category planning and sourcing execution by aligning business and technology requirements, market intelligence, financial objectives, and procurement priorities into actionable multi-year strategies.

  • Oversees supplier selection, negotiation, and contracting to improve commercial outcomes, service performance, and total cost of ownership.

  • Establishes governance, controls, and performance measures that strengthen policy compliance, implementation discipline, and realization of sourcing benefits.

  • Leads team performance, capability development, workforce planning, and talent management activities to support business priorities and sustained functional effectiveness.

Category Ownership and Operating Model

  • Acts as the single accountable owner for assigned technology categories, including the category roadmap, in-year execution plan, and multi-year strategy.

  • Defines and maintains sub-category ownership within the team so every area of spend has a named owner with clear scope, decision rights, and accountability.

  • Operates the category-based model rather than a vendor-tier model, segmenting suppliers within each category by value, risk, and criticality instead of by relationship status.

  • Leads completion of the transition from the legacy vendor-tier structure for assigned scope, including scope boundaries, handoffs, knowledge transfer, and stabilization of new ways of working.

  • Publishes and refreshes the category roadmap on a defined cadence, covering priorities, savings commitments, renewal timing, supplier strategy, and risk posture.

  • Represents assigned categories in functional planning and coordinates with peer category owners, including the MA&D category, where scope, suppliers, or agreements intersect.

Portfolio and Demand Management

  • Serves as the defined sourcing business partner to assigned Technology senior leadership team members, acting as their single point of contact for category sourcing.

  • Runs a standing cadence with business partners to capture roadmap, budget, and demand signals well ahead of need, typically 6 to 12 months in advance of requirement or renewal dates.

  • Maintains a rolling demand, renewal, and pipeline forecast for the category so spend is planned and proactively managed rather than processed tactically as it arrives.

  • Aggregates requirements across business units and regions to build leverage, reduce duplication, and rationalize overlapping suppliers and licenses.

  • Owns designated strategic vendor relationships within the category, including executive cadence, business reviews, roadmap alignment, innovation discussions, and escalation.

  • Challenges demand, specifications, and consumption with business partners before sourcing begins, using market intelligence, benchmarking, and should-cost analysis.

Category Strategy and Sourcing

  • Develops and executes multi-year sourcing strategies for assigned categories that align to enterprise priorities, technology roadmaps, and the annual financial plan.

  • Owns the sourcing pipeline and savings commitments for the assigned portfolio, and sequences initiatives to balance value capture against business capacity.

  • Directs evaluation of vendor solutions to confirm they meet business requirements, technical specifications, security standards, and compliance obligations.

  • Builds a pipeline of innovative suppliers and emerging technologies, including AI and data solutions, to support growth and digital transformation.

Negotiation and Contracting

  • Leads complex, enterprise-wide negotiations with major technology providers to secure favorable commercial and legal terms that optimize total cost of ownership, quality, and service delivery.

  • Directs structuring of master agreements, statements of work, service level commitments, subscription and license terms, renewal and true-up provisions, benchmarking clauses, and exit and termination rights.

  • Partners with Legal, Information Security, and Privacy to secure protections for data, intellectual property, audit rights, and regulatory requirements in technology contracts.

  • Serves as escalation point for contentious negotiations, supplier disputes, and commercial risk decisions within the assigned categories.

Supplier and Vendor Management

  • Holds suppliers in the assigned categories to agreed performance metrics and service levels.

  • Implements the vendor management framework for assigned categories, including performance reviews, scorecards, issue resolution, and continuous improvement plans.

  • Directs supplier assessments to confirm compliance with contractual obligations, security standards, and regulatory requirements.

  • Manages supplier risk across financial, operational, cyber, continuity, and reputational dimensions, and drives mitigation and remediation plans.

  • Advances supplier development, consolidation, and rationalization strategies, and leads commercial response to supplier audits and claims.

Financial Oversight and Value Delivery

  • Oversees spend for the assigned categories, tracks and analyzes category and supplier spend, and identifies cost savings, efficiency, and value creation opportunities.

  • Builds and applies financial models, ROI analysis, and cost structure analysis to support data-driven sourcing decisions and negotiations.

  • Validates savings with Finance and business partners, and reports realized value, pipeline coverage, and category performance to senior leadership.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Acts as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, providing insight into supplier capabilities, market trends, and sourcing opportunities for the category.

  • Partners with Information Security, Legal, Finance, and business leaders to align sourcing and supplier strategies with organizational needs.

  • Facilitates cross-functional collaboration on supplier onboarding, integration, adoption, and contract implementation to secure compliance and value capture.

  • Supports technology sourcing requirements for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and integration activity, including transition service arrangements and contract disposition.

Governance, Process, and Digital Enablement

  • Implements policies, procedures, and governance frameworks for technology sourcing and vendor management, including delegation of authority and code of conduct requirements.

  • Drives process improvement to streamline procurement workflows and improve cycle time, quality, and stakeholder experience.

  • Adopts AI and automation within the team's workflows to reduce administrative effort and shift capacity toward strategic category work.

  • Champions supplier diversity, ESG goals, and responsible sourcing practices across the technology supply base.

  • Strengthens use of procurement systems and analytics, including sourcing, contract lifecycle, and spend platforms, so category roadmaps and demand plans rest on reliable data.

Team Leadership

  • Builds, leads, and mentors a team of Director-level category owners and sourcing professionals, fostering collaboration, accountability, and excellence.

  • Sets objectives, manages performance, and provides coaching, development, and career pathing so the team has the skills and resources to succeed.

  • Manages workforce planning, resource allocation, and succession for the assigned categories, including capability build in the new operating model.

Education and Work Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience required.

  • Advanced degree (MBA, or master's in supply chain, computer science, or a related field) preferred.

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, and vendor management, including 6+ years in technology or data sourcing, or a related field required.

  • 8+ years of experience in a management capacity required, including experience leading managers or senior individual contributors.

  • Demonstrated track record negotiating and managing complex technology supplier contracts and portfolios of $100M+ in annual spend required.

  • Experience owning a technology category end to end within a category-based procurement or category management operating model required.

  • Experience leading teams through organizational or operating model change, including transition from a vendor or account-based structure to a category-based structure, preferred.

  • Experience in a Fortune 500 or similarly complex, large matrixed global organization preferred.

  • Certification in procurement, supply management, or project management (such as CPSM, CIPS, or PMP) preferred.

Skills and Knowledge

  • Deep expertise in strategic sourcing, outsourcing, and contract development across technology and data categories, including SaaS, cloud services, infrastructure, IT services, telecom, packaged software, cyber security, data solutions, and emerging technologies.

  • Proven ability to build and own a multi-year category roadmap and hold it current against shifting business and technology demand.

  • Exceptional negotiation and contract optimization skills with a strong command of commercial and legal terms.

  • Skilled at operating as a business partner to senior technology leaders, building forward demand visibility and converting roadmaps into sourcing plans.

  • Deep understanding of global sourcing practices, vendor management, compliance, governance, and risk management frameworks, including third-party and cyber risk.

  • Strong knowledge of the technology supplier landscape, licensing and consumption models, industry trends, and emerging technologies and their impact on sourcing strategy.

  • Strategic thinker able to translate business and technology needs into sourcing strategies and drive operational excellence through process optimization.

  • Strong financial acumen, including analysis of complex cost structures and ROI models, evaluation of supplier proposals, and data-driven decision making.

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build and sustain senior business relationships.

  • Ability to lead change, influence at all levels, and drive cross-functional alignment across a global matrixed organization.

  • Comfort operating with evolving scope and clarifying ownership boundaries while an operating model is still maturing.

  • Outstanding problem solving skills, applying the appropriate tools and level of analysis to the situation.

  • Proficiency in procurement tools (such as SAP Ariba or Coupa), contract lifecycle management systems, and data analytics platforms.

  • Ability to establish spend baselines, category profiles, risk assessments, controls, performance measures, and KPI reporting.

  • Proficiency in English for business communication across global stakeholders and suppliers.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. For details, visit

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT MEDEFERMedefer is a pioneer in virtual-first specialist healthcare.
jobs.description:
ABOUT MEDEFER

Medefer is a pioneer in virtual-first specialist healthcare. Founded by NHS consultants over a decade ago, we were delivering consultant-led virtual outpatient care well before “virtual hospitals” became a national priority. Our model has since been cited in government and NHS England material on the NHS Online vision as one of the service models informing this direction.

We sit at the intersection of clinical provider and technology company. Our CQC-registered service is powered by Medefer’s own electronic health record and referral platform, connecting GPs, consultants, diagnostic providers and hospitals into a single coordinated system. This approach has won multiple national awards for elective recovery, innovation and impact, and we now serve both NHS partners and private patients across the UK.

Medefer is built on three principles: innovate to solve real system problems, collaborate with clinicians and partners, and put patients first in every decision. As we scale across Integrated Care Systems and grow our private services, joining now means helping to define what modern specialist care looks like - and owning the financial strategy behind it.

JOB TITLE: Dementia Coordinator

REPORTING TO: Clinical Lead - Dementia

LOCATION:Remote

CONTRACT: Self-employed contractor

PAY RATE: £30.00 per hour

ROLE OVERVIEW:

Join us in our mission to transform patient care and be part of a dynamic and innovative team. We pride ourselves on a supportive, collaborative and inclusive culture and any individual working with Medefer will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of intelligent, driven and compassionate people who care deeply about transforming the way healthcare is delivered.

Everything we do is guided by our values: Patient First, Inventive and Collaborative, and brought to life through our five behaviours: Open, Adaptable, Curious, Compassionate and Accountable.

As a Dementia Coordinator, you will speak with patients who have purchased a memory assessment or an Alzheimer’s blood test through Medefer’s self-pay dementia service. Following the specialist’s written report, you will hold a supportive telephone or video call to talk through what happens next, discuss the practical and social side of living with memory problems, and connect patients and their families to the support available to them. You will document these interactions professionally so that they form part of the patient’s record.

This role is working on a contractor arrangement to enable Medefer to meet our fluctuating business requirements and the service in which you provide will be on an ad hoc and casual basis.

Initially the requirement is small, likely a few hours each week, with calls booked around your availability. There is scope for the role to grow, in hours and in scope, including contributing to the design of the coordinator service and supporting a wider coordinator team as the service develops.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • To hold supportive telephone or video calls with patients at agreed points in the dementia assessment pathway, at a time that suits the patient.

  • To support the patient in treatment decisions in light of information provided by the specialist.

  • To talk through the specialist’s report in practical terms and discuss the options for what the patient can do next.

  • To demonstrate effective communication skills, supporting patients in making decisions, planning care or seeking to make positive changes to promote a person centred approach in health and care.

  • To ensure patients and their families are provided with information and support, both verbal and written where required, to make an informed decision about their care and options.

  • To signpost and connect patients and carers to the support available to them, including NHS memory services, Admiral Nurse services, Alzheimer’s Society, local support groups, carer assessments, benefits advice, and lasting power of attorney and financial advice.

  • To provide health education and advice to patients and their carers, including practical brain health advice where the assessment found nothing of concern.

  • To hold a short suitability conversation with patients enquiring about the Alzheimer’s blood test, confirming they meet the agreed criteria and discussing what the test can and cannot tell them, escalating to the Clinical Lead where suitability is unclear.

  • To work within the agreed scope of the coordinator role, which is to explain and navigate rather than to assess. Diagnosis, clinical interpretation of results, prescribing and changes to a care plan sit with the consultant, and a dementia diagnosis is always communicated by a qualified clinician.

  • To escalate to the consultant on call any question that falls outside the coordinator scope, and to raise safeguarding concerns without delay.

  • To accurately and concisely document all contact provided.

  • To practise in accordance with the respective code of professional conduct and within the designated scope of practice, responsible and accountable for own decisions, actions and omissions at this level of practice.

OUR VALUES AND BEHAVIOURS:

Our values, Patient First, Inventiveand Collaborativeshape every decision we make and define how we work together. They are supported by five behaviours that apply to every colleague at Medefer.

All colleagues at Medefer are expected to consistently demonstrate our five behaviours, regardless of role or level:

Open:We demonstrate an open and growth mindset, communicate transparently, challenge constructively and are receptive to feedback.

Adaptable:We adjust our approach, respond constructively to change and contribute beyond our role, demonstrating flexibility.

Curious:We ask questions, seek understanding, collaborate with colleagues to generate new ideas and continually learn to improve decisions and outcomes.

Compassionate:We maintain awareness of ourselves and others, communicate with empathy, create psychological safety and recognise when others need support.

Accountable:We take ownership of our behaviours, decisions, performance and outcomes, follow through on commitments and raise risks early.

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES:

  • Registered Nurse with current NMC registration and a licence to practise.

  • Evidence of continued professional development.

  • Post registration experience in dementia care, gained within a memory service, an Admiral Nurse post, primary care, community mental health or a similar setting.

  • In-depth knowledge of the dementia diagnostic pathway, and detailed awareness of the national and local support available to patients and carers.

  • Advanced communication and listening skills, with experience of holding sensitive conversations with patients and families about memory problems and dementia.

  • Confident practice under the Mental Capacity Act, and confident recognising and raising safeguarding concerns.

  • Ability to work to a defined scope, and to escalate rather than answer when a question falls outside it.

  • Ability to work independently and autonomously, remotely, by telephone and video.

  • Currently working within an NHS or other clinical role and able to provide up to date documents in accordance with clinical compliance requirements.

  • Reliable availability once work is accepted.

  • Desirable: Admiral Nurse or other Dementia UK aligned experience; primary care dementia experience; familiarity with blood biomarker testing for Alzheimer’s disease; experience of service development or of writing operating procedures

Medefer is a Disability Confident Employer.

We commit to interviewing applicants who declare a disability and meet the minimum essential criteria for the job. If you would like to be considered under this scheme, please let us know in your application or by contacting our recruitment team.

Medefer fully complies with the Equality Act 2010. We are an equal opportunities employer, value diversity and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

The named individual has not consented to unsolicited marketing emails. ‘Direct marketing’ means the communication, by whatever means, of marketing material which is directed at individuals. Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR) apply to unsolicited emails, for which the individual has not provided consent. Medefer takes the privacy of individuals very seriously and failure to abide by this notice will result in action taken.

Position Overview

Win the programs that shape the future of cell and gene therapies. As FUJIFILM Biotechnologies’ Business Development Director for Advanced Therapies, you’ll own growth across the FUJIFILM Life Sciences Cell Therapy network—including FUJIFILM Biotechnologies, FUJIFILM Biotechnologies California, FUJIFILM Biotechnologies Texas (Viral Gene Therapy) and FUJIFILM Cellular Dynamics—turning cutting-edge science into scalable, GMP-ready solutions.

Company Overview

The work we do at FUJIFILM Biotechnologies has never been more important—and we are looking for talented candidates to join us. We are growing our locations, our capabilities, and our teams, and looking for passionate, mission-driven people like you who want to make a real difference in people’s lives. Join FUJIFILM Biotechnologies and help make the next vaccine, cure, or gene therapy in partnership with some of the most innovative biopharma companies across the globe. We are proud to cultivate a culture that will fuel your passion, energy, and drive - what we call Genki. Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

You will drive the full lifecycle of complex CDMO deals: target, qualify, shape, and close. Your command of CGT development, CMC/GMP requirements, and multi-stakeholder enterprise selling will unlock programs that move from concept to clinic—and ultimately, to patients. This role can sit on the West Coast, United States; Pacific Northwest, United States; or Central/Midwest, United States.

Why this role matters

  • Fuel growth where science meets scale: Your wins expand our Advanced Therapies portfolio and accelerate timelines for leading and emerging biopharma partners.
  • Own a strategic region: Lead our Commercial strategy in one of the most influential biotech ecosystems in the world—build a dominant pipeline and elevate our brand presence.
  • Orchestrate from first meeting to signature: Partner with Legal, Commercial Solutions, Demand Planning, Marketing, and Market Intelligence to shape competitive proposals, de-risk timelines, and land agreements set up for flawless execution.

What you’ll do

  • Lead complex, consultative sales cycles: Map stakeholders from R&D through CMC, MSAT, QA/RA, Procurement, and Legal; manage evaluations, RFPs, and governance processes.

  • Partner for execution: Maintain open communication with Demand Planning on capacity; collaborate with sales, product, marketing, and Market Intelligence to drive cohesive strategies.
  • Be accountable and data-driven: Keep systems and leadership current with pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and customer insights.

Technical sophistication expected

  • Understanding of phase-appropriate development and regulatory context: Pre-IND through BLA, QbD, tech transfer, PPQ, and comparability.
  • Comfort selling into GMP-regulated environments: Quality systems, compliance expectations, digital tools (e.g., CRM), and enterprise buying dynamics.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years in senior-level business development, account management, or program management within biopharma/CDMO, with a track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Existing network across biopharma and CGT ecosystems; proven ability to originate and mature net-new opportunities.
  • Demonstrated pipeline discipline and forecast accuracy in long-cycle enterprise sales.
  • Advanced negotiation, presentation, and business-writing skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; science-related field strongly preferred.

What sets you up to thrive

  • Hunter–strategist mindset: You’re proactive, resilient, and skilled at building from zero to one.
  • Executive presence: You influence cross-functional partners and senior leaders with clarity and credibility.
  • Commercial acumen: You know how to position value, defend margin, and align scope with operational capacity.
  • Collaborative operator: You integrate seamlessly with Legal, Commercial Solutions, Demand Planning, Product, Marketing, and Market Intelligence.
  • Clear communication: You make the complex simple—written, visual, and verbal.

Scope and accountability

  • Build and manage a high-quality, high-velocity pipeline aligned to territory strategy and capacity.
  • Facilitate partnerships within the global sales peer group and across FUJIFILM companies.
  • Align closely with global directors on territory growth, portfolio positioning, and market dynamics.
  • Provide structured customer feedback to inform future solutions, differentiation, and win rates.

Your impact from day one

  • Develop and execute a territory plan that targets high-fit accounts across CGT segments.
  • Convert conference and field activity into qualified opportunities with velocity and discipline.
  • Close complex, compliant agreements that accelerate sponsor timelines and deliver sustainable Company growth.

Our culture and values

  • Integrity and quality: We operate with transparency and rigor in GMP-regulated environments.
  • Respect and inclusion: We value diverse perspectives and foster a collaborative, supportive team culture.

  • Safety and responsibility: We prioritize safety, ethics, and stewardship in everything we do.

Ready to win the programs that power tomorrow’s therapies? Apply now to join FUJIFILM Biotechnologies as Business Development Director — Advanced Therapies.

jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

We are looking for an organized, adaptable, and proactive Senior Creative Operations Manager to join our dynamic Creative Team. Reporting to the Director of Creative Operations, you will own the operational side of the creative process from intake through delivery, partnering closely with Creative Leads and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure projects are well-defined, appropriately prioritized, and delivered on time and aligned with brief.

This is a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly. The ideal candidate is a confident problem solver and strong collaborator who can bring structure to complexity, anticipate challenges, and create clarity across multiple projects and stakeholders. You will also play an important role in identifying opportunities to improve workflows and create more efficient ways of working for the Creative Team.

You will provide regular visibility into project health, including work that is missing critical information, behind schedule, at risk, or otherwise impacted, and proactively work with the team to address issues before they become blockers.

This is a remote position, but candidates must work within one hour of Eastern Time (US). We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Serve as a primary operations partner for complex creative projects, including advertising campaigns, video, podcasts, social, and other creative initiatives across channels.
  • Own project planning and execution from intake through final delivery, developing project plans, roadmaps, timelines, and milestones while maintaining accurate project information and status within project management tools.
  • Review incoming creative briefs and partner with the Director of Creative Operations to manage the Creative Team’s weekly intake process, ensuring projects are clearly defined, appropriately scoped, prioritized, and ready for the Creative Team before kickoff. Identify and resolve gaps or questions early while helping evaluate timelines, team capacity, and appropriate project assignments.
  • Partner with Creative Leads and cross-functional stakeholders to balance needs, business priorities, resources, and deadlines, while proactively identifying and resolving risks, capacity constraints, dependencies, and potential timeline impacts.
  • Facilitate project kickoffs and weekly status meetings, ensuring deliverables, owners, timelines, decisions, and next steps are clearly documented and communicated.
  • Provide regular project updates and reporting to maintain visibility into priorities, project health, as well as overdue, at-risk, blocked, or otherwise impacted work.
  • Escalate complex or high-impact issues to the Director of Creative Operations with clear context and recommended solutions.
  • Proactively identify risks, capacity constraints, dependencies, and potential timeline impacts, and develop solutions to keep projects on track.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve processes, and increase operational efficiency across the Creative Team.
  • Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Meet key Creative Team members, leads, and cross-functional partners.
  • Gain an understanding of Toptal, our business, and what sets us apart.
  • Become familiar with our brand strategy, guidelines, messaging, and governance processes.
  • Learn the team structure, roles, priorities, and ways of working.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Develop a strong understanding of incoming creative briefs and project requirements.
  • Independently create project timelines and establish clear milestones for deliverables.
  • Coordinate and facilitate project kickoffs, including documenting key decisions and next steps.
  • Become proficient in our project management tools and processes.
  • Establish a regular cadence for tracking and communicating project status with the Creative Team.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Independently manage multiple creative projects from intake through delivery. Exercise discretion and independent judgment.
  • Build strong working relationships with Creative Leads and key stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify workflow challenges and recommend opportunities for improvement.
  • Establish a strong understanding of team capacity, priorities, and project dependencies.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Effectively plan and manage timelines across multiple projects and quarterly priorities.
  • Take ownership of increasingly complex and cross-functional projects.
  • Contribute to improving and documenting Creative Operations processes.
  • Help develop scalable onboarding resources and processes for future Creative Operations team members.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Take a strategic view of Creative Operations processes and identify opportunities to streamline and optimize how the team works.
  • Implement improvements that increase efficiency, clarity, and predictability across the creative workflow.
  • Build strong partnerships across Creative and cross-functional teams.
  • Take on additional operational responsibilities and contribute to the continued evolution of the Creative Operations function.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 5+ years of project or creative operations experience within an advertising agency, design studio, creative department, or similar environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple creative projects with competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong understanding of creative workflows and the ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable project plans.
  • Experience working with project management platforms such as Asana, Jira, Trello, Monday.com, or similar tools.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate project requirements, status, risks, and decisions.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to remain calm, resourceful, and solutions-oriented when managing tight deadlines or shifting priorities.
  • Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Creative and non-Creative teams.
  • A proactive mindset and demonstrated ability to identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • At Toptal, you’ll be expected to be a world-class individual contributor. This role is not simply about coordinating work or telling others what to do, you’ll be expected to actively contribute, solve problems, improve processes, and help the team operate at its best.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

Location: Sunrise, FL

The Technical Sales Engineer (TSE) will be a critical member of a major automotive account team located in Novi, Michigan. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to shape NXP’s business with one of the most exciting and innovative customers in the automotive industry. The TSE will develop and expand relationships with strategically important contacts at our customer, cultivating new design opportunities, influencing roadmap decisions, and executing our growth strategy. Your knowledge of the automotive industry and ecosystem will help leverage and position NXP as a best-in-class partner. The ideal candidate has a strong semiconductor background, Account Management experience, and able to work remotely as part of a cross functional team.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, deploy, and execute a best-in-class account strategy to maximize NXP design wins at a major automotive customer.

  • Provide strategic assessment of new business opportunities in cooperation with product teams. Evaluate opportunities based on the entire value chain, considering several criteria, such as technological differentiators, strategic fit, profitability, and timing.

  • Coordinate globally and facilitate joint business meetings across product teams, functional units, and geographies.

  • Drive strategy towards BL goals (i.e., roadmap development, alignment of support resources, product design in)

  • Provide deal dynamics intelligence including product requirements, decision criteria, roadblocks, timeline, budget, and competitors.

  • Understand and influence customer hardware architecture to position NXP's solutions across multiple technologies.

  • Develop solid and long-term influential relationships with key decision makers within customer teams at all levels to favorably position NXP as a trusted partner and adviser.

  • Conduct face-to-face customer management meetings to provide support, address issues, communicate updates and build strong relationships.

  • Provide customer product information, including roadmaps, demonstrations, pricing, and delivery quotations.

  • Develop and maintain an intimate working knowledge of the customer’s supply chain, production plans, ramp-up/-downs, and product demand.

  • Maintain and report awareness of major customer trends, trade development, and competitive activity.

  • Ability to travel as required (e.g. Ottawa, Canada; Novi, MI)

Qualifications:

  • Preferred 10+ years of sales experience in the semiconductor industry, preferably in the automotive space.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Proven ability to manage a complex sales cycle, with a track record of successful revenue attainment.

  • Technically adept understanding of hardware and software, and how businesses can leverage NXP to deliver better end products.

  • Highly organized with attention to detail and exceptional follow-up skills.

  • Ability to lead global, cross-functional resources to remove barriers and achieve sales goals.

  • Good understanding of a broad range of IC products including Microcontrollers, Power Management ICs (PMICs), and Ethernet, as well as a solid application development background.

  • Self-starter, motivated to work autonomously.

  • Excellent communication, negotiating, and presentation skills (oral & in writing).

  • Highly proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).

More information about NXP in the United States...

CACI is actively seeking a Test Team Manager to provide overall test strategy and tools management support for an SAP web-based supply chain management government system. The team lead is responsible for the planning and execution of test events for monthly maintenance, quarterly enhancement, and special project initiatives. Releases include Integration, Performance, UAT support, and Regression test events. The position is customer facing with multiple weekly status / progress updates to be provided verbally to USDA stakeholders. Additional required abilities include technical writing to maintain program Test Strategy documents and contractual release gate review deliverables (Test Readiness Review (TRR), Production Readiness Review (PRR) input). As a member of the Release Management (RM) team, you will leverage your experience and skillsets to support test event schedules as provided by the program in support of our customer’s mission to feed people and improve the procurement, distribution, and tracking of food commodities. The Test Manager will also oversee the Test Automation Team in their objective to deliver new/enhanced test automation capability to further support program test strategies and objectives as well as the full execution of existing automation capability as identified during testing scope processes, in accordance with release timelines.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the integration and management of the Micro Focus ALM tool test cycles, test lab, and dashboard modules.

  • Owner of the program Test Strategy document outlining test event execution, metrics reporting, test data management, and identification and future creation of test automation capability

  • Provide support for test status and strategy calls with USDA on lifecycle gate reviews and weekly PMO / CCB status meetings

  • Work across technical and functional teams to ensure program test requirements are met while enhancing capabilities.

  • Oversee demos of the new automation scenarios with USDA agency stakeholders, as necessary

  • Oversee automation Regression Test scope for monthly and special project releases, within the parameters of the release schedule

  • Manage volume test data creation requests in support of test events, as requested

  • Support OpenText ALM custom code / workflow changes as requested by the WBSCM RM

  • Identity and assess new automation capabilities for WBSCM interfaces and WBSCM reports

  • Manage the UFT software version compatibility with OpenText ALM (SaaS) upgrades

  • Support BASIS on security vulnerability remediation efforts related to UFT

  • Communicate effectively with diverse customer organizations and provide status to stakeholders.

Required:

  • Facilitate proof-of-concept / proof-of-capability of transition from UFT to Tricentis Tosca

  • Facilitate proof-of-concept / proof-of-capability of CoPilot AI solution (or alternate) to enhance test automation capability, whether entirely automated or in support of manual testing activities

  • Extensive, real-world experience in the design, development, and execution of automated testing scripts to reduce effort / cost with manual testing.

  • 12+ years of relevant business experience; 8+ years of automated test development and execution experience

  • 5+ years’ experience using OpenText and SAP tools (ALM, UFT, TAO)

  • Minimum Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent alternative education, skills, and/or practical experience is required.

Desired:

  • SAP functional awareness in core modules (ECC, SRM, CRM, FI, SD/MM, Portals, BW) preferred.

  • Cross functional coordination experience

  • Solution Manager/Automation/Performance Test experience are preferred.

Job Title: Remote Sales & Leasing Coordinator (Salon Suites) – Follow‑Up & Care Calls

Schedule: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST

Location: Remote (U.S. Timezone Alignment)

Compensation: $650 – $800 USD/month base + $50 – $100/month performance bonus

Role Overview

Make every stylist who inquires about a salon suite feel seen, supported, and followed up with exactly when promised—ensuring higher tour show rates and seamless lease signings across 8–14 U.S. locations.

You are the human glue connecting marketing, in‑person leasing agents, and incoming prospects. You won't be doing cold prospecting; your primary job is protecting, warming, and nurturing warm leads.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pre-Tour Care Touches: Reach out via personalized message or phone call within 24 hours of a booked tour to confirm details, share community benefits, and verify automated reminder sequences.
  • Promise-Based Follow-Up: Log all scheduled follow-ups into the CRM and reach out precisely on the promised date/time via text, DM, or call.
  • Post-Tour Nurture (24–72 Hours): Send post-tour recap messages, answer routine questions, escalate complex inquiries to local agents, and prompt completion of pending applications.
  • Sales Admin & CRM Hygiene: Update prospect pipeline statuses (Tour Scheduled, Showed, No-Show, Applied, Signed) and maintain clean notes and clear next actions for every lead.

Success Metrics & Outcomes

  • 100% compliance on pre-tour care touches and automated reminder setups.
  • 100% compliance on post-tour follow-up sequences within 24–72 hours.
  • Consistent month-over-month increase in tour show rates across assigned locations.
  • Direct contribution to monthly signed leases through completed nurture sequences.

Candidate Profile

  • Experience: 1+ years in appointment setting, sales administration, or high-touch customer support.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English with a warm, empathetic tone.
  • Organization: Extremely detail-oriented, process-driven, and reliable with time management and CRM task tracking.
  • Work Style: Thrives as the behind-the-scenes coordinator who ensures every customer experience feels polished and personal.

Compensation & Perks

  • Base Pay: $650 – $800 USD/month (based on experience).
  • Monthly Performance Bonus: $50 – $100 bonus awarded for achieving 95%+ on-time follow-ups and beating the previous month's baseline tour show rate.

jobs.excerpt: MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers.
jobs.description:
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.

To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner’s codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.

This is a hands-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.

Learn more about #LifeAtMongoDB here!

This role will be based remotely in Toronto.

What you’ll do at MongoDB

In this role, you will:

  • Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment
  • Design and build MongoDB-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions
  • Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover
  • Design and validate production-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or restricted on-premises environments
  • Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries
  • Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements

As an ideal candidate, you will have

  • 5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications
  • Strong application-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics
  • Application-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction-isolation assumptions
  • Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout
  • Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self-managed deployment environments
  • Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade-offs clearly
  • Willingness to spend significant time on-site with ISV partners and travel within the region

As an ideal candidate, you may also have

  • Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward-deployed, embedded, resident-engineer, or partner-engineering role
  • Familiarity with event-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production-readiness reviews
  • Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries
  • Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn

  • Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills
  • Broaden your perspective on how data-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

Staff Engineer / Technical Architect (Brahma Studio)
Location: Remote — UTC+0 to UTC+3 time zones
Brahma AI operates at the intersection of enterprise Media Asset Management (MAM) and generative media, managing over 100 million assets and 100 PB archives.
We are seeking a pragmatic, hands-on Staff Engineer / Technical Architect to serve as the system design authority for Brahma Studio. In this role, you will own the architectural blueprint and technical standardisation of our Studio platform—ensuring systems are rigorously thought through, architected, and documented before execution begins. While you will be the authority on architecture, you will remain close to the codebase, writing high-impact Python software and leading technical execution by example in an agile environment free from top-down bureaucracy.

Core Strategic Objectives

  • Own System Design Authority: Establish single-source technical truth across Brahma Studio by leading upfront system design, service boundary definitions, and architectural documentation (ADRs/RFCs).
  • Cross-Domain Architectural Alignment: Collaborate with peer architects across the broader organization to evaluate dependencies, negotiate technical constraints, and ensure Studio platforms integrate cleanly with shared company infrastructure.
  • Drive Pragmatic Simplification: Replace expedient workarounds with maintainable design patterns, streamlining build pipelines and optimizing oversized Docker containers.
  • Mastery of Python & GCP: Drive the architectural evolution of high-volume data processing systems built on Python and native GCP infrastructure.
  • Lead Through Production Code: Balance architectural leadership with hands-on development, writing clean production code and mentoring engineering teams.

Technical and Operational Responsibilities

1. System Design & Governance
  • Lead end-to-end system design for Studio initiatives, evaluating scalability, data flows, and trade-offs before implementation begins.
  • Partner with Product leads, Studio engineers, and peer architects across Brahma AI to align on cross-platform features, evaluate technical trade-offs, and negotiate interface contracts.
  • Author and maintain technical specs, RFCs, ADRs, and clear API contracts to establish reproducible design patterns and standardized software patterns across the team.
  • Factor performance limits, stress testing considerations, and system resilience directly into upfront solution designs and technical specs prior to build kickoff.
2. Codebase Hygiene & Refactoring
  • Audit and optimize production Docker builds to drastically reduce container footprints and deployment complexity.
  • Systematically replace expedient workarounds with maintainable abstractions, enforcing automated testing and code quality standards.
3. GCP Architecture & High-Volume Data Systems
  • Architect, profile, and optimize distributed, high-throughput data processing pipelines leveraging native Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services.
  • Implement robust observability, logging, and error handling across cloud-native microservices to ensure data reliability.
4. Software Engineering & Mentorship
  • Actively write production-grade Python code for core platform modules and critical frameworks.
  • Review code with a focus on system design and maintainability, mentoring senior engineers in structured architectural thinking.

Experience and Qualifications

1. Professional Background
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, focused on backend system design and high-volume enterprise data processing.
  • Proven track record as a system design authority (Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, or Architect) with experience evaluating complex edge cases before building.
2. Technical Skills
  • Expert Python: Idiomatic mastery of modern Python (asyncio, type hinting, performance profiling, memory management).
  • GCP-Native Expertise: Deep experience designing and operating architectures on Google Cloud Platform.
  • Containerization: Strong expertise in multi-stage Docker builds and container optimization.
  • Working Knowledge of Go: Ability to read, write, or integrate Go-based microservices where concurrency demands it.

Big Cartel is an e-commerce platform that gives creators, artists, makers, and small brands from all over the world the power to open their own online stores and make a living doing what they love. Big Cartel is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead our Seller Acquisition Product Team. You’ll own the in-product new seller journey across trials, onboarding, shop discovery, and first orders. Your success will be measured on new seller growth and retention through the first 90 days of the seller lifecycle.

You’ll report directly to the Co-CEO and work across engineering, design, growth and product marketing, data, and customer success.

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for the first 90 days of the in-product seller journey from trial through first sales

  • Measuring and communicating impact clearly, ensuring everything you do is aligned with the company strategy and priorities and drives measurable seller and business growth.

You’ll be a great fit for this role if…

  • You have strategic and economic fluency across consumer channel acquisition, unit economics, conversion, activation, retention, CAC, LTV, and cohort analyses.

  • You are an AI-native operator driving research synthesis, competitive teardowns, modeling, reporting, and prototyping with AI to validate an idea before spending engineering time on it.

  • You have strong commercial instincts, always directly connecting product decisions to measurable business outcomes

With AI accelerating engineering, more ships than any one PM can fully shepherd thus you set the priorities and you don't manage every feature and project to the last detail; however, you are accountable for all outcomes

  • You have 10+ years of product management experience, ideally with meaningful time spent on growth, activation, or subscription conversion

jobs.title: Fund Administration Manager - Eastern Europe
jobs.excerpt: The one-line version:As a Fund Administration Manager, you'll be forward deployed: embedded with the customer, owning outcomes instead of tickets.
jobs.description:
The one-line version:

As a Fund Administration Manager, you'll be forward deployed: embedded with the customer, owning outcomes instead of tickets. We are hiring experienced operators and deploying them directly into the daily running of the venture funds on Infra One.

About Infra One:

Infra One is an AI-native fund administration and investment platform operating across nine jurisdictions (Austria, Germany, UK, US, Luxembourg, Singapore, India, ADGM, Cayman Islands). Venture funds run their entire back office on us: formation and regulatory filings, LP onboarding, KYC/AML, capital calls, deal execution, quarterly reporting. Underneath sits an AI-first backend that does the heavy lifting, extracting data from corporate documents, pre-filling KYC reviews, drafting answers straight from the fund documents, routing investors to the right vehicle, reconciling capital calls. Our benchmark is not the traditional fund administrator with two-week email turnarounds, it is the product experience of the best fintech platforms, with AI doing the reading and humans in the loop who actually know what they're doing.

The role:

You run the operational engine of a small portfolio of venture funds. You are in the GP's WhatsApp group. You are the named person behind their back-office inbox. When their LP is stuck in KYC, when a founder sends over a convertible note to sign "today, ideally," when a fund-of-funds sends a seven-question due-diligence list covering fee mechanics and cross-border tax treatment, you handle it, end to end.

The work is fund operations: onboarding, closings, capital calls, deal execution, reporting, and everything in between. But almost every one of those operations runs through legal documents, LPAs, subscription agreements, CLAs, side letters. Not to give legal advice (we have internal legal and external counsel for that), but because an operator who can't read the documents is blocked twenty times a day, and one who can is unstoppable.

This is not a support queue, and it is not a law firm associate track. You own outcomes for named clients whose fundraises and deals move at startup speed, alongside an engineering team that ships fixes to the things you flag, often the same day.

Elsewhere in the industry, this job doesn't exist as one job. The large US platforms split it into four or five: a relations associate who talks to the GP, a deal-operations associate who executes, a fund accountant who closes the books, an in-house lawyer who reads the documents, an LP-relations team who answers investors. Every handoff between them is somewhere a client waits. We collapse the whole chain into one accountable person per client, and the only reason that works is the AI-first backend underneath you. At the incumbents, the people are the system. Here, the platform is the system: it reads the documents, drafts the answers, runs the checks, and moves the money at lightning speed, and you are its judgment, its signature, and its face to the client. One person with this backend outruns a five-person chain without it. That is the job.

Tasks

What you'll actually do:

A representative week, drawn from real client work:

  • Walk a GP's new LP through subscription and KYC, diagnose why their video identification keeps failing with our provider, and get them across the line with a fifteen-minute call.
  • Take a deal handoff from a GP ("€200k convertible at €5m pre, founder wants to close this week"), collect the company's corporate and AML documents, work through the CLA, catching that the conversion price in the documents doesn't match the agreed terms, and get signatures and the wire out within 48 hours.
  • Answer an institutional LP's due-diligence questionnaire: management fee mechanics, carry catch-up provisions, whether a foreign investor in an Austrian GmbH & Co KG has local tax filing obligations. Turn the best answers into reusable one-pagers so the next fund never has to wait.
  • Flag a side letter demanded by an LP as inappropriate for the check size, and give the GP language to decline without burning the relationship.
  • Keep the GP oriented: a live status overview, what's blocked and on whom, proactive reminders. Many GPs are brilliant and chaotic, your structure is part of the product.
  • Feed everything you learn back into the platform. When you flag that founders don't know what a UBO is, the flow gets rewritten. When an onboarding step confuses LPs, engineering ships a fix. You are the platform's eyes in the field.

Requirements

What we're looking for:

  • An operator, first. You have founded, joined early, or run something. You default to unblocking rather than gold-plating, you know when "N/A" is a complete answer on a checklist, and you understand that a fund's LPs compare us to the best software products they use, not to other administrators.
  • Extreme ownership and responsiveness. Our clients have two modes: now, or not at all. You close loops the same day, you say precisely when something will be done, and it is done then.
  • Precision under speed. Wrong numbers in a capital call, a mismatched signature block, a missed clause in a document, these are not typos in this job, they are incidents. You are fast and exact, and you know which of the two to sacrifice when you must (never the second).
  • Legal background (optional). A law degree or equivalent legal training, and genuine comfort with transaction documents: LPAs, subscription agreements, side letters, SAFEs, convertible loans, term sheets. You don't need to be qualified in any particular jurisdiction; you need to be able to read a sixty-page LPA and come back with the answer, not a summary of the question.
  • AI-fluent. You already work with LLMs daily, and "could the machine do this?" is your first question, not an afterthought. The role only works for people who treat the backend as a teammate to direct, not a tool to tolerate.
  • Fluent written and spoken English. German is a meaningful plus; so is any experience with EU or US fund structures.
  • Location and hours. Fully remote from Eastern Europe, South America, or the Philippines, with substantial daily overlap with Central European business hours.

Benefits

What you get:

  • A front-row seat to how venture funds actually work, formation to first close to deal execution to reporting, compressed into months instead of the decade it takes at a law firm or a legacy administrator.
  • AI leverage as the default, not the exception. The backend drafts, extracts, reconciles, and flags; you review, decide, and talk to humans. We automate the repetitive 80% so your time goes to judgment, clients, and edge cases, you will be more leveraged here than anywhere else you have worked, and you help decide what gets automated next.
  • Direct influence on the product. Your field observations become shipped features, sometimes within hours.
  • Direct access to founders, GPs, and LPs, the people most careers only ever see through six layers of hierarchy.
  • Compensation benchmarked at the top of your regional market, paid as a full-time remote engagement.

The test

If you read the week above and thought "that's five different jobs," this isn't for you. If you thought "finally, one job where I get to do all five", we should talk.

To apply, send us a short note (no cover letter theater) telling us about one deal, negotiation, or operational mess you personally untangled, and what you would have automated about it.

jobs.description:
The Role

We’re hiring an Experienced Technical Customer Support Engineer with a strong software background who loves solving complex problems for enterprise customers. You’ll be the technical front line for Idhammar’s products—triaging, troubleshooting, and resolving issues across application, database, integrations, networking, and cloud infrastructure layers.

What you’ll do

  • Own customer cases from intake to resolution using Jira Service Management (or similar) to meet and exceed SLAs.
  • Troubleshoot application, integration, and network-related issues across web, mobile, and API services; reproduce defects, isolate root causes, and deliver fixes or high-quality escalations.
  • Perform advanced database investigations using SQL Server/PostgreSQL: analyse slow queries, locks, deadlocks, index usage, and craft optimised SQL to remediate performance problems.
  • Support and maintain multi-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, IONOS Cloud):
  • Review logs/metrics, scale resources, and manage compute, storage, and networking.
  • Handle identity and access (IAM/Entra ID roles & policies), certificates, and secrets.
  • Coordinate patching and maintenance windows.
  • Diagnose and resolve networking and connectivity issues across TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, TLS/SSL, HTTP/HTTPS, firewalls/security groups.
  • Diagnose connectivity and data integration problems (ERP/SCADA/IoT, OPC UA, REST/gRPC, file-based ETL) with vendors and customer IT teams.
  • Conduct proactive health checks, patching, and minor hotfix deployments; contribute to playbooks and runbooks.
  • Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; provide incident updates and post-incident reports.
  • Create and improve knowledge base articles, customer guides, and internal troubleshooting recipes.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering on bug triage, feature feedback, and reliability improvements.

Typical issues you’ll handle

  • Query timeouts and blocking chains; designing/adjusting indexes and query plans.
  • Data ingestion failures (CSV/ETL/API), schema changes, and referential integrity issues.
  • API authentication/authorisation problems (OAuth2/OIDC), certificate or token expiry.
  • Application performance regressions after upgrades; log analysis and rollback/mitigation.
  • Network troubleshooting: packet loss, TLS handshake errors, DNS resolution failures, HTTPS/API connectivity problems, VPN/firewall misconfigurations.
  • Cloud environment alarms (CPU/IO, storage thresholds, scaling, networking) and unexpected cost spikes.

Requirements

Minimum qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Advanced SQL expertise (5+ years), including:
  • Complex joins, window functions, stored procedures, views.
  • Performance tuning (indexes, execution plans, statistics, partitioning).
  • Backup/restore basics, data migration, and scripting for maintenance.
  • Strong experience supporting .NET/Windows server applications and web APIs.
  • Proficiency in network troubleshooting:
  • TCP/IP fundamentals, routing, and DNS.
  • HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, and certificate handling.
  • VPNs, firewalls/security groups, load balancers.
  • Packet capture and analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump, or equivalent).
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud (Azure, AWS, IONOS Cloud), and familiarity with others:
  • Compute, storage, identity & access, monitoring/logging, secrets management.
  • Networking basics (VNet/VPC, firewalls/security groups, DNS, TLS).
  • Scripting/automation with PowerShell and/or Python.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar).
  • Excellent customer communication, incident handling, and documentation skills.

Nice to have

  • Experience with CMMS/EAM/OEE or manufacturing/industrial data; exposure to OPC UA, SCADA/PLC integrations.
  • Knowledge of Power BI (DAX, dataset refresh issues, gateway configuration).
  • Experience with PostgreSQL (including extensions like pg_stat_statements or pg_partman) and/or SQL Server performance tools.
  • Familiarity with ITIL, major incident management, and stakeholder comms.
  • Exposure to observability stacks (Azure Monitor, ELK/OpenSearch, Grafana, Prometheus).
  • Basic container knowledge (Docker) and Kubernetes fundamentals.

PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR DESIRED SALARY IN LKR PER MONTH

Benefits

  • Work From Home
  • Training & Development
