jobs.title: Director, Data Product and Growth Strategy
jobs.excerpt: At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent.
jobs.description:
At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent. We help companies of all sizes keep their services legal and safe for consumers. To do this, LegitScript combines big data with the world’s leading team of experts skilled in highly regulated and complex sectors, including transaction laundering detection, pharmaceuticals, online gambling, and more.

The result? Unmatched accuracy and deep risk analysis that identifies which commercial entities play by the rules, and which do not. Our diverse industry partnerships provide unique insights that keep businesses and governments at the forefront of emerging trends. That’s why LegitScript is trusted by the world's largest search engines, internet platforms, payment companies, and regulatory agencies.

Overview:

LegitScript's next stage of growth starts with finding it. The Director, Data Product and Growth Strategy owns that search: the next vertical, the size of the opportunity, the shape of the competitive field, and the business case that turns a market signal into a funded product. This is a strategy role with commercial accountability, not a research role. Success is measured in revenue paths opened, not documents produced.

You will own the front half of the product lifecycle — market problems, segmentation, positioning, pricing, and portfolio direction — and hand validated, quantified opportunities to product management and engineering for execution. You will also build the mechanism that moves market intelligence through LegitScript: collecting customer, competitive, and partner signals on a regular cadence, turning them into a point of view, and pushing that point of view up to the executive team and down into roadmaps.

What You'll Do:

  • Identify and validate new verticals, categories, and product offerings that expand LegitScript's addressable market beyond current lines of business.
  • Discover and validate market problems through structured interviews with customers, recent evaluators, and untapped prospects, backed by evidence rather than anecdote.
  • Map the competitive and alternative-solution landscape, including emerging entrants and adjacent-category threats, and develop a strategy for winning against each.
  • Build a repeatable market-intelligence system covering win/loss analysis, competitive tracking, customer discovery, and emerging-market research.
  • Define target markets, analyze segments, and confirm that the segments LegitScript pursues are large enough to support both current and future business.
  • Determine which distribution channels, including direct, partner, and referral, align with buying preferences in each target segment.
  • Own the multi-quarter product roadmap as a statement of vision and sequencing, and partner with product management and engineering to translate it into committed delivery plans.
  • Build business plans and financial models, in collaboration with finance, that give the executive team a clear basis for investment decisions.
  • Establish pricing, packaging, and distribution strategy for new and existing offerings.
  • Recommend build, buy, or partner paths for each identified market problem, including the partner profile and terms required to make the path work.
  • Create the value propositions that differentiate LegitScript in the mind of the buyer relative to competitors.
  • Partner with product management to hand off validated opportunities with a clear problem definition, target segment, success criteria, and commercial rationale.
  • Present investment recommendations to the executive team with a clear position and a defensible model behind it.

What You'll Bring:

  • 10+ years across product strategy, corporate strategy, product management, or business development, including time in B2B SaaS, fintech, regtech, compliance, or trust and safety.
  • Ability to structure an ambiguous commercial question, build the analysis that answers it, and defend the conclusion in front of an executive audience.
  • Direct experience monetizing data, including ownership of a data product sold or licensed externally, whether standing up a new licensed offering or growing an established data feed business.
  • Hands-on data fluency, including comfort running queries against large datasets independently, writing SQL, and working in Python on platforms such as Databricks and Power BI to size datasets, test coverage and field quality, and produce the evidence behind pricing and packaging decisions.
  • Working knowledge of what AI developers and operators of detection systems need from third-party data, including coverage and recall, confidence thresholds, schema and field-level utility, freshness, and delivery by batch export and near real-time API.
  • Written and verbal communication strong enough to carry a business case through executive scrutiny and make a data product understandable to a buyer with no technical background.
  • Experience with financial modeling, including market sizing, pricing analysis, unit economics, and investment cases, in collaboration with finance.
  • Experience negotiating or structuring data licensing and data-sharing agreements, including commercial terms, usage rights, and exclusivity.
  • Experience running structured customer discovery, with the judgment to apply product strategy frameworks rather than follow them mechanically.
  • Enough familiarity with the legal and contractual limits on data licensing, including permitted use, provenance, and privacy, to design products that clear them and to know when counsel is required.
  • Ability to influence across product, engineering, research, sales, and executive stakeholders without formal authority.

Preferred

  • Strategy consulting background, ideally at a firm known for analytical rigor and executive-level problem structuring, followed by time operating inside a company.
  • Direct experience driving AI transformation at a software company, including product repositioning, pricing and unit-economics changes, and separating durable AI advantage from table stakes.
  • Domain experience in payments, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, supplements, financial crime, marketplaces, or advertising platforms.
  • Living proximity to Portland, Oregon.

We succeed together, care deeply, stay curious, and inspire trust — and we look for those qualities in the people we hire. LegitScript offers competitive compensation, flexible work options, and a team that's genuinely invested in your success. If our mission resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Content Writer (Freelance)
jobs.excerpt: Grizzle is a content marketing agency that helps enterprise B2B and SaaS companies create and distribute authoritative, actionable, and value-driven content.
jobs.description:
Grizzle is a content marketing agency that helps enterprise B2B and SaaS companies create and distribute authoritative, actionable, and value-driven content. Our clients include Semrush, Pipedrive, Tide, CXL, and Web.com, to name a few. Our goal is to help them surpass their revenue, traffic, and brand awareness goals using a proven content marketing methodology.

About the job

We’re looking for talented content writers to work with us on an ongoing basis. We’ll provide you with a steady stream of interesting work, processes, courses to empower you to write articles you’re proud of, and ongoing support from our team of editors.

You’ll be given ample amounts of constructive feedback and dedication from our editors to help you become a stronger writer. This is one of the most cited reasons that writers have worked with us for years:

“As a writer, you want to work with people that get it. Grizzle gets it. They get the importance of good writing. They get that writers need a solid brief, space and time to work, and valuable (constructive, not negative) feedback. And that’s exactly what they deliver. More than that though, they look for ways to get better at helping writers thrive by—get this—talking to them. The regular check-ins are a wonderful thing. Being part of the Grizzle team is a wonderful thing. I’m a better writer for it.”

Clients have worked with us for years because we embed ourselves into their systems and adapt to their brand voice. Therefore, this role is best suited for writers who are comfortable with writing in different styles in-line with documented content guidelines.

Bonus points if you have subject matter expertise in marketing, sales, business finance, HR, or other business topic. We encourage you to check the FAQ at the bottom of this page.

Benefits of working with us

Over the last 7 years, we’ve created effective content marketing playbooks that help our clients surpass their growth goals. Our content performs well in highly competitive markets, and we’re dedicated to helping our clients meet their acquisition, sales, and revenue targets.

However, we’re not a content farm. We take the time to create high-quality content that’s full of unique insights and value-adds. We don’t replicate what’s already out there. Every piece of content must have a purpose. We haven't done our job properly if an audience doesn’t feel empowered by what they read.

If our mission aligns with your values, here are a few other benefits of joining our team:

  • Long-term and reliable freelance retainer

  • Learn about content marketing, SEO, and digital PR

  • Work on industry-leading and interesting SaaS accounts

  • Collaborate with talented content marketers and editors

  • Improve your own marketing skills

  • Access to our internal content and marketing courses

What you’ll be doing

You’ll create authoritative, long-form content that empowers and educates audiences while helping our clients meet their goals and make their lives easier.

Once hired, you’ll collaborate with our senior editors on briefs and drafts. You’ll be given the information and resources you need to create detailed angles and outlines for your content and ensure we go above and beyond competing articles.

From there, you’ll research and write long-form content that's full of detailed examples, actionable insights, and paragraphs that drive points home while closing loops and maintaining logical flow.

More specifically, you will:

  • Research topics and uncover pain points to produce angles and analyze the competitive landscape

  • Create outlines to communicate the logical flow of your narrative and help us collaborate with clients (this significantly reduces feedback during the draft stage and means fewer revisions for you)

  • Write engaging, practical, and informative content that educates, motivates, and inspires readers to take action

  • Share and break down examples and supporting imagery (screenshots, graphs, etc.)

  • Cite relevant and original sources when necessary

  • Follow client guidelines to match their brand voice, tone, structure, and preferences

  • Collaborate with the Grizzle team on each project via ClickUp

Content formats you’ll be writing

  • Blog Articles: Long-form content to drive traffic, educate readers, and convert them into leads, users, and customers.

  • Content Refreshing: Breathing new life into existing content with new sections, examples, and value takeaways.

  • Landing Pages: Product pages for SEO and other channels.

  • Email Content: Newsletters and campaigns.

  • Ebooks: Long-form guides that overdeliver on value.

We’re looking for content writers who:

  • Love creating actionable, in-depth content on a range of B2B topics

  • Strive to create the best piece of content available on a topic

  • Can easily adapt to different writing styles

  • Have acquired subject matter expertise in marketing, sales, finance, HR, or other business topics

  • Are hungry to become stronger writers and work with editors that will help them do so

  • Can write in a clear, concise manner

  • Understand on-page SEO and what makes content valuable

  • Are extremely well organized and can work to deadlines

  • Can communicate in a consistent and reliable manner

You’ll work closely with and learn from a sophisticated content marketing methodology. If you want to improve your marketing skills, you’ll see how we create great content and rub shoulders with some known names in the industry.

We pay our freelance writers per project. You can find info on our project rates here. This can increase after several months of working with us and for larger projects (such as ebooks).

FAQs

What's the typical word count for each project?

Word count can range anywhere from 1,000 to 4,000 words, depending on the specificity and complexity of each topic.

What sort of clients do you work with?

We work with B2B and SaaS brands. Industries range from sales and marketing to fintech and remote working. Check out the logos on our home page.

What's the process to get started?

We always start with a paid test task with multiple phases, followed by a client project.

What content formats do you create?

80% of our projects are blog articles. The rest is made up of landing page copy, ebooks, guest posts, etc.

What are your content workflows?

We have organized processes that are mapped out in ClickUp. You’ll receive a brief, then work with our editors to create an angle, outline, and write a value-driven draft. One round of revisions is baked into the process. Our content marketing editors (CMEs) and copyeditors are there to support you, polish content to perfection, and address client feedback.

Will the content be ghostwritten?

95% of our content is ghostwritten for clients. There’s the odd occasion where we can attribute a byline to our writers.

What project management software do you use?

We use ClickUp for project comms (and provide training on how to use it) and expect writers to keep open lines of communication with us there.

Job Description

A bit about this role:

Devoted Medical, the affiliated multi-disciplinary virtual care partner of Devoted Health, is dedicated to delivering exceptional healthcare by treating every member with the compassion of family. We are seeking a Physician, Transitions of Care to provide exceptional patient care to recently discharged patients and advance our innovative clinical model focused on preventing hospital readmissions.

This position represents an exceptional opportunity for an enthusiastic physician leader to drive clinical excellence of Devoted Medical's Transitions of Care (TOC) Program. This is an ideal role for an experienced Hospitalist, Post-Acute Physician, Virtual Care Physician, or Value-Based Primary Care Physician with a background in Geriatrics, Palliative Care, or Complex Care Management looking to lead virtual care delivery and readmission reduction strategies.

The TOC program provides virtual care in the 30-day window after a patient is discharged from the acute setting (hospital or skilled nursing facility), serving patients across multiple states with the goal of preventing readmissions through exceptional, comprehensive wrap-around care. The program leverages cutting-edge technology and artificial intelligence (AI) to provide the best care possible.

The Physician will deliver high-quality clinical care to patients at high risk for readmission as part of a collaborative interprofessional team (IDT) of healthcare professionals, including nurse practitioners, physicians assistants, registered nurses, medical assistants, and clinical coordinators. This role combines direct patient care (approximately 70% of time) with team development, coaching for clinical excellence within an IDT, leading clinical problem-solving, and facilitating rounds (approximately 30% of time focused on clinical supervision, escalations, and clinical model improvement). Leadership in this role is focused on clinical supervision rather than direct administrative management.

You will be supported by advanced AI-enabled technology and comprehensive Devoted Medical programs — including virtual urgent care, specialty care such as palliative care, complex care management, and clinical pharmacy services. Because Devoted is a tech-forward, fast-moving organization, physicians are expected to support the training and application of AI tools that enable an unprecedented quality of care for our patients. This position offers the opportunity to impact patient outcomes at scale in a modern, tech-supported care environment.

This role is designed for a physician with an entrepreneurial mindset who can leverage their deep clinical background to spearhead intricate quality improvement projects, cultivate a standard of clinical excellence within a distributed team, and champion the implementation of evolving AI technologies. In this capacity, the physician acts as the ultimate point for clinical escalations and manages oversight via collaborative practice agreements in various states.

Your Responsibilities and Impact Will Include:

Clinical Leadership & Patient Care (~70% of time):

  • Clinical Care for Transitions of Care: Deliver high-quality direct virtual patient care to patients recently discharged from the acute setting who are at high risk for readmission, focusing on complex transitions of care cases.

  • Clinical Escalations: Serve as the final escalation point for clinical questions and complex patient management decisions within your assigned interdisciplinary care team.

  • Clinical Outcomes Oversight: Oversee a narrow set of quality and clinical outcome metrics that are critical drivers of improved readmission rates.

Team Management & Clinical Supervision (~30% of time):

  • Clinical Supervision & Collaborative Practice: Provide supervision, teaching, and coaching to a team of Nurse Practitioners through collaborative practice agreements across multiple states, fostering a collaborative and supportive clinical environment.

  • Lead Interdisciplinary Rounds: Conduct weekly interdisciplinary rounds (3 hours/week) and readmission conferences to review high-risk patients, complex cases, and conduct deep-dive root cause analyses.

  • Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Provide clinical oversight and coaching for professionals across multiple disciplines. Collaborate closely with operations leads and senior managers for nursing, medical assistants, and clinical coordinators.

  • Foster an Open Clinical Culture: Champion a patient-centered and open clinical culture, fostering trust, transparency, honesty, and empowerment within a distributed team across geographic locations.

Technology, Innovation & Quality Improvement:

  • Clinical Innovation & Root Cause Analysis: Identify opportunities to improve the model of care through root cause analyses, identifying patterns of readmissions, developing strategies to prevent hospital readmissions, and driving quality improvement initiatives.

  • Technology & AI Enablement: Utilize and provide feedback on Devoted's proprietary electronic health information system (Orinoco) and contribute to the development, training, and application of AI-enabled clinical tools to support care within the TOC service.

  • Change Management & Innovation: Thrive in an entrepreneurial, high-growth environment with a high capacity for change management and agility. Drive innovation and process improvements to enhance the delivery of transitions of care services.

  • Advocate for Care Equity: Advocate for healthcare equity and accessibility within the organization and community, particularly for vulnerable patients at risk for readmission.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree.

  • Board certification in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or related specialty.

  • Minimum 3 years of post-residency clinical experience

  • Strong background in inpatient care and deep understanding of the transitions of care period.

  • Experience in the management of chronic medical diseases including heart failure, COPD, diabetes, hypertension, pneumonia, cellulitis, and urinary tract infections.

  • Experience leading interdisciplinary rounds and conducting deep-dive root cause analyses.

  • Direct experience supervising Nurse Practitioners or other healthcare professionals.

  • Proven ability to manage change, translate vision and strategy to front-line teams, and drive innovation in a dynamic healthcare environment.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with experience using data to drive clinical and operational improvements.

  • Collaborative mindset with ability to work effectively with interdisciplinary teams and business partners

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • Experience in hospital medicine, post-acute care, primary care, or geriatrics

  • Previous experience as a medical director or in a similar physician leadership role within value-based care or Medicare Advantage organizations.

  • Experience delivering care in a remote/virtual environment or with telehealth platforms.

  • Background in quality improvement methodologies and leading clinical initiatives.

  • Experience working in high-growth healthcare organizations

  • Experience serving diverse patient populations, with a focus on delivering care that aligns with our mission.

  • Entrepreneurial, growth-minded, and adaptable team player who is ready to innovate on transitional care delivery models within high-growth healthcare organizations.

Licensure and Certification:

  • Active medical license in good standing, with the ability and willingness to obtain licensure in additional states as the program expands (with support provided by Devoted).

  • Board certification in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or related specialty.

Salary Range: $280,000 – $338,000 / year plus eligibility for discretionary performance-based bonus paid out annually (Target bonus is 10%, payout based on terms of the bonus plan).

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

jobs.excerpt: Lyst is a global fashion shopping platform founded in London in 2010 and catering to over 160M shoppers per year.
jobs.description:
Lyst is a global fashion shopping platform founded in London in 2010 and catering to over 160M shoppers per year. We offer our customers the largest assortment of premium & luxury fashion products in one place, curating pieces from 27,000 of the world's leading brands and stores. In 2025, Lyst joined Zozo, operators of Zozotown, the leading fashion e-commerce platform in Japan. This partnership marks a bold new era for Lyst, as we accelerate our vision and work together to transform the future of fashion shopping through AI and technology.

At Lyst, we obsess over the customer, providing a search & discovery experience which offers inspiration, fulfilment, and personalisation. We believe that fashion is amazing but shopping for fashion often isn't, and use our technology, data and creativity to bring more joy, greater choice and fewer fails. Our mission is to help fashion shoppers make better choices and help fashion partners find better audiences as the category-leading destination for every fashion shopper.

The Role

We are looking for a highly proactive and extremely well-connected Partner Acquisition Contractor for an immediate start, 2-3 month project.

We don't need you to focus on internal projects or overarching strategy pieces; we are purely looking for an amazing, self-reliant executor who can hit the ground running. Your sole focus and objective will be leveraging your existing network to successfully onboard 100 Italian fashion brands to the Lyst platform ahead of our Peak season.

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, you will be expected to independently build your own target lists, proactively pitch, and negotiate partnerships with minimal intervention from the wider team.

Responsibilities

  • Rapid Partner Acquisition: Hit the ground running to proactively pitch, negotiate, and seamlessly onboard 100 Italian fashion brands to the Lyst platform before Peak season.
  • Independent Sourcing & Targeting: Independently supply a high-quality list of target brands to approach, requiring little to no intervention or direction from the internal team.
  • End-to-End Execution: Take complete ownership of the sales cycle for the Italian market—from initial outreach and objection handling to final negotiation and hand over to our technical onboarding specialist.
  • Relationship Leveraging: Utilise your existing rapport and connections within the Italian fashion industry to secure fast conversations and quick wins.

Requirements

  • Language & Location: Fluent/Native Italian speaker. Candidates based in Italy are preferred (However we’re open to Italian native speakers based in London as long as you have a deep understand of the italian fashion landscape)
  • Industry Network: Deep, working knowledge of the local Italian fashion space, coming with a "black book" of existing connections and established rapport with relevant fashion brands.
  • Pure Executor: You are a proactive, self-reliant self-starter. You know how to build a pipeline and close deals autonomously.
  • Sales & Negotiation: Proven ability to handle objections, negotiate terms, and articulate a clear value proposition to move partners from initial conversations to live on the platform at speed.
  • Commercial Understanding: A genuine interest in the business of fashion and the e-commerce/affiliate landscape, with the ability to build compelling business cases for why a brand should join Lyst.
  • CRM Proficiency: Experience using CRM tools (like Salesforce, Apollo) to accurately log your rapid outreach pipeline.

Benefits

jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Summary:

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager who owns the technical strategy and platform evolution behind a key product line — someone who thinks in platforms rather than features, operates with AI tools as core infrastructure, and translates deep technical work into clear business impact.


This role sits at the interface of Product and Engineering. You will own the technical roadmap for your area — new capabilities, platform infrastructure, technical debt, security, and scaling — and keep Architecture and Engineering aligned with the business-facing teams that depend on them. You should already be using AI to accelerate your own work, be comfortable reading architecture diagrams and reviewing API designs, and bring strong opinions about how SaaS platforms should be designed, measured, and scaled. Your work will help our customers reach their goals and drive Momentive’s growth forward.


This position reports to the Director of Product Management. This is a remote, US-based position.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create, own, and maintain the technical product roadmap for your area — spanning new features and capabilities, platform infrastructure, technical debt remediation, security fixes, and scaling mechanisms.
  • Develop an in-depth understanding of the platform architecture and how it interacts with product use cases, the broader Momentive portfolio, and third-party integrations.
  • Translate product-line needs and stakeholder input into clear technical requirements, initiatives, and epics for Engineering — identifying shared patterns and consolidating duplicated efforts into scalable, reusable capabilities.
  • Maintain alignment between Architecture/Engineering teams and Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and other non-R&D functions — translating complex platform decisions into clear business-impact narratives.
  • Work with Support to triage and prioritize operational issues impacting customers and the broader platform.
  • Drive Product/Architecture interface process improvement, ensuring clean handoffs and shared accountability across teams.
  • Monitor platform adoption, usage, performance, and reliability metrics, and use data to drive technical investment decisions.
  • Act as Product Owner when needed, operating with high autonomy in a role where success depends on influence across teams you do not directly control.
  • Use AI tools as core tools in your daily work — not as novelties, but as force multipliers for research, analysis, communication, and decision-making:
  • Use AI to prototype technical approaches, analyze cross-product usage data, and generate first-draft technical specifications and requirements that you then refine with engineering judgment.
  • Compress discovery and analysis cycles by using AI to synthesize stakeholder input, assess existing systems and data flows, and surface insights that would otherwise take weeks.
  • Stay current on AI tooling and platform patterns, and share effective approaches with the broader product and engineering organization.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent work experience; 5+ years in a software/SaaS environment, including 4+ years in a product management role.
  • Advanced technical understanding of networking, databases, operating systems, APIs, microservices, and cloud infrastructure — with the depth to read architecture diagrams, review API designs, and engage in detailed technical discussions with engineers.
  • Experience defining APIs, data contracts, and integration approaches, and managing platform or system migrations while maintaining continuity for dependent teams and customers.
  • Advanced understanding of Agile processes and deployment methodologies, including CI/CD; strong grasp of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Demonstrated, meaningful use of AI tools in your own workflow. You should be able to speak concretely to how AI has changed the way you work, what it’s replaced, and where you’ve found its limits.
  • Ability to derive and apply technical product strategy across one or more products on a 6–12 month time horizon, grounded in strong market and portfolio analysis.
  • Experience with secure coding, compliance, and security practices.
  • Strong experience with Jira and metrics tracking for optimal team output.
  • Experience working with Associations and/or Nonprofits is a plus.

Ideal Candidate Attributes:

  • Platform Thinker: Thinks in systems rather than features — building capabilities that scale across products and serve multiple teams through a shared core.
  • Technically Fluent: Comfortable in deep technical discussions with engineers, and able to translate complex architecture into clear narratives for leadership, product peers, and GTM teams.
  • Outcome-Focused: Draws a clear line from technical decisions to customer success and business results, and uses data to drive investment and prioritization.
  • Influential Leader: Drives outcomes across teams they do not directly control, building alignment and shared accountability through influence.
  • AI-Native: Treats AI as a core part of the job, not a novelty. Uses it daily to prototype, analyze, and communicate, and shares what works with the team.
  • Owner: Demonstrates significant initiative and end-to-end ownership, with an uncompromising commitment to product quality, reliability, performance, and scalability.

About Us

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com.

Why Work Here?

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here.

401(k) Savings Plan with Company Match

Flexible Planned Paid Time Off

Generous Sick Leave

Inclusive & Welcoming Environment

Purpose-Driven Culture

Work-Life Balance

Commitment to Community Involvement

Employer-Paid Short-Term Disability

Remote Work Flexibility

jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career

As the Principal for Competitive Intelligence within the Cortex Product Management organization, you are the strategic link between the competitive landscape and our product roadmap. You don't just report on the market; you influence what we build. By applying Structured Analytic Techniques (SATs) to technical competitive data, you will provide the "Inconvenient Truths" that challenge our product assumptions. You will be responsible for ensuring that Cortex doesn't just match competitor features, but maintains a structural architectural advantage that is validated by evidence and field reality.

Your Impact

  • Use Structured Analytic Techniques (like Analysis of Competing Hypotheses and Alternative Futures Analysis) to identify upcoming competitor pivots, ensuring the Cortex roadmap accounts for "next-gen" threats before they materialize in the field.

  • Ownership of DSPM + CIEM + ITDR portfolio, acting as the direct liaison and influencer to the Product Management organization. You will translate deep research results into Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), prioritize feature gaps based on competitive urgency, and present key takeaways to senior leaders.

  • Partner with the Enablement Lead to turn strategic product insights into "Kill" campaigns. When the competition launches a new capability, you define our immediate product-level counter-narrative.

  • Perform deep-dive assessments into competitor technical capabilities to identify where PANW has a "Technical Moat" and where we are at risk of commoditization.

  • Go beyond CRM data to conduct structured analytic deep dives on significant losses, delivering actionable product feedback to Engineering and PM leadership to remove technical friction in the sales cycle.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 8+ years in CI, Product Management, or Sales Engineering within the Cybersecurity space (DSPM, CIEM, DLP, IAM, PAM, & JIT).

  • Mastery of Structured Analytic Techniques. You must be able to move beyond "feature checklists" to produce high-nuance analysis that can withstand questioning from senior Product and Engineering leaders.

  • You can read a technical spec and understand the downstream implications for an enterprise security architect. You aren't just looking at the UI; you are looking at the architecture.

  • A core requirement for this team. You must be comfortable telling Product Leaders where their product is failing against the competition and backing it up with evidence.

  • Proven mastery in distilling high-density technical data and complex market signals into concise, high-impact "Bottom Line Up Front" (BLUF) briefings. (You must demonstrate the ability to strip away technical noise to deliver clear, actionable recommendations that direct-influence Product and Executive decision-making.)

  • Experience facilitating "Red Hat" analytic sessions for product launches to identify how competitors will likely attack our new features.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a PM or TMM is a significant plus, as you will need to speak the language of engineering trade-offs.

  • Experience in Structured All-Source Analysis or other formal intelligence frameworks used to evaluate technical claims.

  • Deep familiarity with how security products are actually deployed and used in a 24/7 SOC enterprise environment.

  • CI Certification like CIP or similar.

The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior ASIC Package Design Engineer to implement advanced ASIC package architecture, with a strong focus on flip-chip BGA (FC-BGA) and multi-chip module (MCM) solutions. This role supports the end-to-end package strategy for high-performance mixed-signal and digital SoCs from early architecture and trade studies through vendor engagement, qualification, and production ramp. You will collaborate with internal teams for package design, defining standards, influencing silicon and system architecture, and ensuring first-pass success for complex, high-speed, power-dense ASICs.

Responsibilities

  • Define ASIC package architecture for FC-BGA and MCM solutions, including substrate stack-up, ball-map strategy, power delivery, signal breakout, and mechanical constraints.
  • Lead package-level trade studies across cost, performance, power integrity (PI), signal integrity (SI), thermal, manufacturability, and reliability.
  • Establish package design standards, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Drive detailed design of FC-BGA packages for high-pin-count ASICs with high-speed SerDes, dense power grids, and RF signal content.
  • Define and review substrate stack-ups, via strategies, impedance control, escape routing, and reference plane planning.
  • Partner with silicon, RF, and systems teams to co-optimize die floorplans and package interfaces.
  • Support package-level SI/PI strategy, including high-speed digital interfaces, power delivery network (PDN) design, and decoupling strategy
  • Lead thermal architecture at the package level, including lid selection, TIMs, heat-spreaders, and mechanical interfaces to system cooling.
  • Manage relationships with external packaging vendors, substrate suppliers, and
    OSATs.
  • Drive material selection, substrate technology choices, and assembly process optimization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in ASIC package design, with deep expertise in FC-BGA.
  • Proven experience delivering high-pin-count, high-performance ASIC packages into production.
  • Strong understanding of substrate technologies and materials, SI/PI fundamentals at the package level, and thermal management for power-dense ASICs.
  • Fluent in SI/PI and EM simulation tools such as SIWave, HFSS, and ADS.
  • Experience working directly with OSATs and substrate vendors.
  • Knowledge of packaging qualification and test methodologies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with MCM or heterogeneous integration (chiplets, interposers, advanced laminates).
  • Background in high-speed digital or mixed-signal SoCs.
  • Familiarity with aerospace, space, or high-reliability electronics.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Base salary range for this role is $180,000 – $260,000 + equity in the company
  • Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/ coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

As an SDET, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the performance testing framework and automated test frameworks. The performance testing focus includes responsibility to evaluate application reliability, scalability, and responsiveness under varying levels of load and stress both at a Team level and at an Enterprise level. You will design and execute performance test strategies, build performance test scripts and frameworks, analyze system bottlenecks, and collaborate closely with engineering teams to ensure products meet performance and stability requirements. Once teams are set up and working in the performance model, you will shift focus to an SDET team testing execution, designing comprehensive test plans, and working closely with developers and product teams to ensure software quality and performance.

An effective SDET combines deep technical knowledge with a strong understanding of testing principles to build reliable, scalable, and maintainable test systems. You will be expected to provide comprehensive coverage including both automation and manual testing.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Define and execute comprehensive test strategies - including functional automation, load, stress, endurance, spike, and scalability testing.
  • Establish and maintain performance baselines and analyze test results over time to identify trends and performance regressions.

  • Identify system bottlenecks, performance degradation, and root causes through profiling and diagnostics.

  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous testing.
  • Identify, document, and track bugs through resolution.

  • Analyze test results and provide insights into product quality and potential risks.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning and retrospectives.

  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test processes, and best practices.
  • Experience testing APIs using tools such as Postman, REST-assured, or similar.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools and repository management (Bitbucket, Jenkins, or similar).
  • Experience with creating, setting up, and executing manual test cases (preferably in Zephyr).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • A passion for quality and a proactive attitude toward improving development and testing processes.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

Competencies

Programming Skills

  • Proficient in at least one programming language (e.g., Java, Python, TypeScript or JavaScript).
  • Able to write clean, maintainable, and reusable code.
  • Familiarity with object-oriented programming (OOP) concepts.

Performance Monitoring & Diagnostics

  • Working knowledge of APM tools (Grafana, New Relic, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics).
  • Ability to interpret logs, metrics, and traces to pinpoint performance issues.
  • Familiarity with profiling tools (GC analysis, thread dumps, heap dumps).

Test Automation Development

  • Building and maintaining performance testing frameworks using K6 (JMeter, Gatling, LoadRunner, are a plus).
  • Building and maintaining automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Selenium).
  • Writing automated tests for UI, API, and backend components.
  • Experience with data-driven, behavior-driven, or keyword-driven testing.

Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)

  • Integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Bitbucket, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Automating new feature functionality, regression testing and smoke tests as part of deployment cycles.

API Testing

  • Designing and executing tests for REST/SOAP APIs using tools like Playwright or Postman.
  • Validating status codes, response schemas, performance, and edge cases.

DevOps & Infrastructure Knowledge

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Understanding of version control systems (e.g., Bitbucket) and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).

Test Strategy & Planning

  • Ability to model real-world user behavior and traffic patterns.
  • Risk-based planning to identify high-impact test areas.
  • Defining testing testing scope, scenarios, workloads, and success criteria based on requirements.
  • White box and risk based testing mindset.

  • Impact-focused — you deliver the "so what?", not just the data.
  • An owner who takes pride in the cleanliness of their code and their documentation.

  • Produce reconciliation reports identifying money differences, position discrepancies, and operational exceptions.
  • Ensure all reconciliation breaks are researched, documented, and resolved within established service levels.

Operational Risk & Regulatory Controls

  • Ensure operational processes comply with applicable SEC, FINRA, and global market regulations.

  • Update operational procedures, controls, and documentation as business processes evolve.

Automation & Strategic Initiatives

Collaboration

  • Support department initiatives and perform additional responsibilities as business needs evolve.

  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while working independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable working remotely while collaborating across distributed teams

  • Adaptability to evolving regulatory requirements and business priorities

At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

In this role, you'll build and maintain the self-service developer portal and developer-facing tooling that make our client’s platform golden paths easy to find and use. Embedded within the Developer Experience team, you'll work in direct proximity to the team's UX researcher and content specialist, translating research-backed interaction patterns and onboarding flows into working, instrumented software within the same sprint cadence as the research that defines what developers need.

This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a mission-critical federal platform that aligns with Bixal's mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location:

This is a fully remote position that can be worked anywhere in the U.S. While most of the work is expected to be conducted virtually, there is potential for occasional travel for on-site meetings and working sessions (Washington, D.C.) at the discretion of the client. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship. U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to contractual requirement.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $135,000 – $138,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain the self-service developer portal and developer-facing tooling for a federal agency’s platform.

  • Design and automate cross-platform workflows spanning source control, CI/CD, issue tracking, observability, and collaboration tools to reduce manual developer toil.

  • Build reusable automation patterns (APIs, bots, webhooks, event-driven services, IaC, internal tooling) that standardize engineering workflows.

  • Integrate identity, access management, provisioning, and compliance controls across SaaS platforms to enable secure self-service.

  • Monitor and maintain workflow reliability, including failure detection, retry strategies, and audit logging.

  • Translate research-backed interaction patterns and onboarding flows into working, instrumented software.

  • Deliver platform improvements that measurably improve developer experience (reduced setup time, faster deployment cycles, improved release confidence).

  • Collaborate closely with the UX and documentation specialists on the team.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified and trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree and at least 8 years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and automating cross-platform workflows spanning source control, CI/CD pipelines, issue tracking, observability, and collaboration tools.

  • Proven ability to build reusable automation patterns (APIs, bots, webhooks, event-driven services, IaC, internal tooling).

  • Experience integrating identity, access management, provisioning, and compliance controls across SaaS platforms for secure self-service.

  • Strong capability in monitoring and maintaining workflow reliability, including failure detection, retry strategies, and audit logging.

  • Able to independently deliver platform improvements that measurably improve developer experience while preventing tool sprawl and fragmentation.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Tier 4 / High Risk Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience building internal developer portals or platform-as-product tooling.

  • Familiarity with GitLab, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, and Figma-integrated toolchains.

  • Experience applying human-centered design inputs directly into software delivery.

  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GSA USAi, AWS Bedrock, Microsoft Copilot).

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager - Enterprise
jobs.excerpt: Who we are:Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

Motive is looking for an experienced Technical Account Manager (TAM) to join our Global Technical Support organization to provide white-glove service, technical support, and executive-level communications to our customers. In this role, you will be adept at both building relationships and resolving issues. As a Technical Account Manager, your work day is focused on a proactive review of a book of accounts. Additionally, you will be reactively working on technical support cases of escalated accounts, issue escalation, training recommendations, and communicating procedural and status updates on the customer’s environment. You'll excel at solving problems quickly and efficiently and have a keen focus on finding a root cause to even the most obscure problem. You act as the customer advocate as you work closely with engineering, product management, and other key areas to innovate and improve performance around product requirements, enhancements, process improvements, and industry best practices.

What You’ll Do:

  • Determine how to resolve technical issues - what changes need to be made to underlying data/hardware/process and how to apply them with minimal user disruption by collaborating with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Investigate and determine root cause of errors/bugs -- use the data and tools to trace the origin of data inconsistencies and bugs and report them to Engineering.
  • Build/Execute new SQL queries for emerging issues to be used by the teams across Technical Support or to identify problem areas in your book of accounts.
  • Be the primary technical point of contact for a group of Motive’s Strategic/Enterprise/Mid Market Accounts.
  • Be accountable for the success metrics of the book of accounts.
  • Own or orchestrate the resolution of cases, help build strong partnerships, and provide an unparalleled support experience for assigned or escalated customers.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of assigned customer issues, including initial troubleshooting, identification of root cause, and issue resolution.
  • Meet or exceed customer expectations on response quality, timeliness, and overall customer experience.
  • Build, foster and maintain strong relationships with technical contacts at assigned customers.
  • Proactively gather updates on upcoming releases to ensure a seamless customer experience.
  • Understanding the core business of the assigned accounts & overseeing all Support activities on a macro level, at all levels of Support.
  • Ensuring specific account documentations are created, followed and improved.
  • Participate in on-call rotation; be available outside of normal working hours to facilitate customer upgrades and change management practices.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Technical Support or equivalent account ownership/Support structure.
  • Excellent customer communication skills in a variety of forms (written, live chat, conference calls, in-person).
  • Experience assessment of bespoke and deeply complex custom configurations that impact usability and customer workflows.
  • Experience with addressing customer escalations and relaying concise but efficient updates to the stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage critical and complex issues in high-pressure environments
  • Experience with hardware devices, firmware upgrades, change management and related testing practices.
  • Experience with Third Party integrations such as Transportation Management or Fleet Maintenance systems.
  • Familiarity with advanced troubleshooting techniques that utilize APIs, Python, Data Dog, SQL, and code review where needed etc.
  • Deep hardware fault analysis skills; identify trends and prevent field failures – Root Cause Analysis.
  • Technical educational background with preferred qualifications of Computer Science or Engineering or equivalent professional experience.
  • Motivated individuals with eagerness to learn and go above and beyond.

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

UK Candidate Privacy Notice here.

The applicant must be authorized to receive and access those commodities and technologies controlled under U.S. Export Administration Regulations. It is Motive's policy to require that employees be authorized to receive access to Motive products and technology.

All job postings are for existing vacancies. Please note; some interviews or new-hire training sessions may be held in person at one of our global offices.

jobs.excerpt: Location Our Engineering Manager - Revenue Management Azure House will be an integral part of our global R&D team.
jobs.description:
Location
Our Engineering Manager - Revenue Management Azure House will be an integral part of our global R&D team.
This role is based remotely in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.
Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.
With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity
The Engineering Manager is a hands-on, player-coach leadership role. You are embedded with your team - daily standup, code review, architectural calls, delivery planning, and performance management - and you own both the team's output and the team's growth.
This is a genuinely technical & leadership role. You are expected to write and review code, be a credible voice in architectural decisions, and stay current in your team's stack. You lead by demonstrating you can do the work at the highest level, not by title alone.The balance between hands-on contribution and leadership depends on the team's context, but your overarching mandate is the same: run the team, execute and deliver, and grow its impact.
Build the bench, raise the standard, and keep the operating cadence sharp as the work and the organization evolve. You work AI-augmented yourself, expect the same from your team, and push the team's craft forward with every new capability that lands.

Responsibilities
Team leadership & growth

  • Leading a team of engineers, owning both its delivery and its development.
  • Lead a mindset and process of continuous improvement within the team and meaningfully impact the team’s success over time. Small, compounding improvements, delivered via fast iterations, are the operating rhythm we expect, not an aspiration.
  • You are responsible for the professional well-being and career development of team members. Develop engineers through regular 1:1s, growth plans, performance reviews, and direct, candid feedback.
  • Develop the next layer of leadership - tech leads, senior engineers ready to manage, and ICs ready to step into staff roles.

    Technical leadership
  • Write code and review code. Be a credible voice in technical decisions because you have hands in the work, not because of your title - you are current, not rusty.
  • Drive the team's architectural and technical design decisions in partnership with senior ICs, ensuring alignment on approach and implementation.
  • Uphold engineering standards through thorough, constructive pull-request review and a healthy release process, keeping the team's components scalable and in a healthy state.
  • Work AI-augmented and lead an AI-augmented team, applying sharp judgment about where AI helps and holding the same quality bar for what ships.

    Roadmap & delivery
  • Own the team's commitments - what was promised, when it was promised, and the quality bar that was held.
  • Run a disciplined cadence of planning, prioritization, and delivery without becoming a process bureaucrat.
  • Partner closely with the Technical Product Owner and Product team on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs, maintaining a roadmap that reflects both near-term priorities and longer-term direction.
  • Understand the broader business objectives behind the work, translate that context for the team, and ensure engineering effort clearly aligns with those objectives.
  • React decisively to change - re-planning, re-prioritizing, and re-staffing as the business moves - while keeping the team engaged and steady through the shift.

    Hiring
  • Own hiring for your team. Interview thoughtfully, decide quickly, and refuse to lower the bar to fill seats.
  • Recruit, coach, and - when needed - make hard calls toward the standard the team is held to.
  • Operate as a role model for other engineering managers across the organization: share your operating model, mentor peers, and raise the management bench.
  • Day-to-day communication & collaborationUpwards: Communicate clearly and succinctly, giving leadership the right level of context and prioritizing escalations based on relevant, well-gathered information.
  • Downwards: Empower senior engineers to own key areas of the product, and coach team members to stay focused, intentional, and aware of their impact.
  • Sideways: Partner effectively with Product, Design, GTM, Customer Success, and other teams - raising challenges and opportunities constructively to support cross-team alignment.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of engineering experience, including 4+ years in engineering management roles where you actively coded as part of your responsibilities.
  • Hands-on, real-life experience building cloud-based SaaS products - running services in production for Azure (and ideally additionally on AWS/GCP) , and owning availability, cost, and the customer-facing surface
  • Strong background in understanding and leading teams in the FinOps space.
  • API first mindset, products are built not just for end user experience through UI,they are fully functional and available through APIs, so both humans and agents can interact with the platform.
  • Strong background in engineering management of multi-disciplinary teams, including full-stack engineers and data engineers.
  • A track record of taking an engineering team and visibly transforming it - measurable improvements in delivery velocity, technical quality, or team caliber.
  • Deep technical fluency in your team's primary stack. You can read, write, and review code at a senior level, and you are current - not rusty.
  • Strong opinions on how high-performing engineering teams operate, and a clear philosophy on hiring, coaching, performance management, and technical decision-making.
  • Excellent judgment under pressure. You make calls quickly with imperfect information, communicate them clearly, and take responsibility for the outcomes.
  • Direct, candid communication. You give hard feedback well, and you hear it well.

    Bonus Points
  • Strong Golang knowledge or experience
  • A strong, already-established AI-augmented workflow, with opinions on how to apply AI tools and agentic workflows to raise both velocity and quality.
  • Hands-on experience with more than a single cloud provider.
  • Background in scaling teams, processes, or technical systems as the organization grows.

Are you a Do’er?
Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.
What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.
We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do’ers, One Team
DoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.
