  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.

With deep roots in DARPA research, Silvus Technologies develops world-class advanced communications technologies that are reshaping the tactical communications landscape. From pure line-of-sight to extreme non-line-of-sight, Silvus radios form a self-healing, self-forming mesh network, enabling secure and reliable connectivity, including video and high-bandwidth data.

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.


Job Description

Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”?

THE OPPORTUNITY

Silvus is seeking a Director of Business Development, Electronic Warfare who will report to the Vice President of Strategic Growth on the Business Development team. The successful individual in this role will lead Silvus’ efforts to identify, shape, and capture opportunities within the electromagnetic-spectrum operations domain.

This role is ideal for a technically grounded business-development leader with deep experience across Electronic Support, Electronic Attack, and SIGINT mission areas who can translate complex technology into strategic growth initiatives. This individual will define and execute Silvus’ go-to-market strategies, cultivate relationships with key government and industry partners, and position the company as a leader in advanced networking and spectrum solutions supporting DoD modernization priorities.

This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location. Candidates must be based in the continental United States in order to be eligible for remote work.

Market Strategy and Development

Customer Engagement and Capture

Partnerships and Routes to Market

  • Evaluate and recommend business models and teaming strategies that maximize reach, speed to market, and return on investment.

  • Support cross-functional coordination to ensure seamless execution from opportunity pursuit through contract award.

Business Planning and Reporting

  • Travel Requirements – required to facilitate strong customer engagement.

Title:

Director, Enterprise Quality Programs

The Enterprise Director of Quality Programs is a strategic enterprise leader responsible for developing, implementing, governing, and continuously improving the organization's global quality management framework across domestic and international operations. This role supports a diverse portfolio of government, defense, aerospace, engineering, technology, and mission support contracts by ensuring quality programs align with business objectives, customer expectations, contractual obligations, and regulatory requirements.

The Director provides leadership to assigned and matrixed quality professionals while partnering with business unit leaders, program managers, functional organizations, and executive leadership to foster a culture of quality, operational excellence, accountability, customer focus, risk-based decision making, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will establish enterprise quality strategies, policies, governance processes, standards, and performance measures that support compliance with ISO 9001, AS9100, CMMI, customer-specific requirements, and other applicable regulatory frameworks.

This role requires exceptional strategic thinking, executive presence, organizational agility, and cross-functional leadership to influence stakeholders across multiple business units and geographic regions while balancing corporate governance with operational effectiveness.

Trinzic is being established as an independent public company through the planned separation of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, which is expected to be completed on January 4, 2027. This role offers a rare opportunity to join the organization during a pivotal period of growth and transformation, helping build and advance enterprise quality, compliance, and continuous improvement capabilities that will position the company for long-term success while serving critical government and commercial missions around the world.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Quality Leadership

  • Develop and execute the enterprise quality vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating model in alignment with corporate objectives and growth initiatives.
  • Establish enterprise-wide quality goals, governance mechanisms, and performance expectations that support business results and customer success.
  • Lead the design, implementation, and continual improvement of the corporate Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Serve as the senior advisor to executive leadership on quality performance, compliance risks, process maturity, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Promote a culture of quality excellence, accountability, customer-focused decision making, and continuous improvement across the enterprise.

Governance, Compliance & Regulatory Excellence

  • Establish and maintain enterprise quality policies, standards, procedures, controls, and governance frameworks.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements, including ISO 9001, AS9100, CMMI, customer-specific standards, government contracting requirements, and applicable international frameworks.
  • Lead enterprise readiness activities for certification audits, surveillance audits, recertifications, customer assessments, and regulatory reviews.
  • Direct corrective and preventive action programs arising from audits, assessments, customer findings, or internal evaluations.
  • Monitor emerging industry standards and regulatory developments and ensure timely integration into enterprise processes and governance structures.

Business Partnership & Operational Integration

  • Partner with business unit leadership, program management offices, and functional organizations to deploy enterprise quality initiatives and standards.
  • Provide strategic quality leadership and consultation across government and commercial programs.
  • Balance enterprise standardization with operational flexibility to support diverse customer and business requirements.
  • Build strong stakeholder relationships and influence decision-making across matrixed and geographically dispersed organizations.

Performance Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and oversee enterprise quality metrics, dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and leading performance indicators.
  • Analyze enterprise quality trends and provide actionable insights to executive leadership.
  • Drive data-informed improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance, strengthen compliance, and reduce business risk.
  • Champion Lean, Six Sigma, process optimization, and operational excellence methodologies across the organization.
  • Advance process maturity, corrective action effectiveness, and enterprise performance improvement initiatives.

Risk Management & Customer Satisfaction

  • Integrate quality and compliance principles into enterprise risk management processes.
  • Evaluate quality-related risks associated with programs, operations, suppliers, and strategic business initiatives.
  • Partner with business leaders to improve customer outcomes, contract performance, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Ensure timely resolution of quality concerns and strengthen customer confidence through proactive engagement and governance.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop assigned quality professionals and matrixed teams.
  • Build organizational capability through training, coaching, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing work environment.
  • Strengthen enterprise quality capability by promoting professional development, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Business Administration, Industrial Management, Operations Management, or a related field.
  • 12-15+ years of progressive experience in quality management, compliance, operational excellence, process improvement, or related disciplines.
  • 7+ years of leadership experience managing quality programs, teams, and enterprise initiatives within complex, multi-site organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting government, defense, aerospace, engineering, technology, or mission-focused organizations.
  • Experience managing enterprise quality systems across multiple business units, functions, and geographic regions.
  • Proven success leading quality transformation initiatives, compliance programs, audit readiness efforts, and enterprise process improvement initiatives.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep expertise in ISO 9001, AS9100, CMMI, and enterprise quality management systems.
  • Strong knowledge of government contracting environments and customer quality requirements.
  • Advanced understanding of quality auditing methodologies, root cause analysis, corrective action management, and process governance.
  • Expertise in risk management, performance measurement, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence methodologies.
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking, executive presence, and ability to influence senior leaders and stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership capabilities, including change leadership, team development, coaching, mentoring, and talent management.
  • Exceptional cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder engagement, matrix management, conflict resolution, and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience utilizing enterprise quality management systems, analytics tools, and performance reporting platforms.
  • Strong business acumen, including operational, financial, and customer-focused decision-making capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Quality Management, Operations Management, or a related field.
  • ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE).
  • ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA).
  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE).
  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt certification.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Experience supporting government departments, agencies, intelligence community organizations, or international government customers and contracts.
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed quality organizations and enterprise-wide quality programs.
  • Familiarity with FAR, DFARS, NIST, and related compliance frameworks.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide process standardization, digital transformation, and business modernization initiatives.

JOB OVERVIEW

ProSidian, an innovative management and consulting firm, is seeking a skilled and culturally sensitive Spanish Language Translator to contribute to a transformative initiative focused on comprehending drivers' attitudes and behaviors related to alcohol and non-alcohol drug use. The Spanish Translator will play a vital role in ensuring accurate and effective translation of survey materials between English and Spanish, facilitating inclusive data collection.

The Spanish Translator is a linguistics professional who accurately translates written English into written Spanish, and written Spanish into written English. A translator translates the tone and meaning of a written English survey to a written Spanish survey and interprets any written Spanish comments in written English. A Translator must be proficient enough in both languages to accurately translate between English and Spanish written languages.

As part of a collaborative venture with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), we are seeking a seasoned and adept team member to work on a comprehensive survey project aimed at enhancing road safety and reducing the risks associated with impaired driving. The successful candidate will ensure pricing strategies align with technical solutions and business goals to enhance the company’s competitive position.

This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Join the engineering team responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and operational excellence of the Idira Identity Security Management platform (formerly CyberArk), supporting Identity Security Administration (ISA), Secure Infrastructure Access (SIA), Privilege Cloud (pCloud), and Tenant Management (TM).

As a Senior Staff Escalation Engineer, you will investigate the platform's most complex production issues, partnering directly with global R&D teams to identify root causes, drive product improvements, and enhance platform reliability. You will own technical investigations from initial escalation through engineering resolution, collaborating closely with software engineers to diagnose software defects, improve product quality, and strengthen platform resiliency.

This is a hands-on software engineering role - not a traditional support position. Success requires the ability to think like a software engineer while approaching production issues with the curiosity of an investigator. As the engineering escalation point between Technical Support and global R&D, you will help resolve the platform's most technically challenging production issues while influencing product quality, improving operational processes, and helping Engineering build more reliable cloud services.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the highest level of engineering escalation for complex production issues across Identity Security Administration (ISA), Secure Infrastructure Access (SIA), Privilege Cloud, and Tenant Management (TM).

  • Own production investigations from initial escalation through root cause identification and engineering resolution.

  • Reproduce complex production issues and analyze logs, metrics, traces, telemetry, APIs, source code, and system behavior to isolate root causes.

  • Partner directly with global R&D teams to diagnose software defects, validate findings, and drive timely product fixes.

  • Translate investigation findings into actionable engineering defects with clear reproduction steps, log analysis, and supporting evidence.

  • Differentiate among software defects, configuration issues, infrastructure problems, and environmental conditions to ensure accurate ownership.

  • Serve as a technical leader during major production incidents, driving cross-functional collaboration to restore platform stability and prevent recurrence.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product Management, Cloud Operations, and Technical Support to restore platform stability and prevent recurrence.

  • Develop troubleshooting tools, automation, diagnostics, and technical documentation to improve investigation efficiency and operational excellence.

  • Analyze recurring production issues to identify systemic trends and influence long-term product, architectural, and operational improvements.

  • Mentor engineers and share technical expertise across Engineering, R&D, and Technical Support organizations.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation supporting production services.

  • Opportunity to leverage AI-assisted engineering approaches to improve troubleshooting, diagnostics, automation, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

  • This position requires authorization to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship due to customer and regulatory requirements associated with supporting regulated U.S. government cloud environments.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5 + years of extensive experience supporting large-scale enterprise SaaS or cloud-native platforms in Escalation Engineering, Software Engineering, Production Engineering, Sustaining Engineering, or a similar role.

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with software engineering and R&D teams to investigate product defects, reproduce issues, isolate root causes, and drive engineering resolution.

  • Ability to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve highly complex production issues beyond the scope of Tier 1 and Tier 2 support organizations.

  • Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills across distributed systems, cloud services, enterprise applications, APIs, and infrastructure.

  • Ability to understand complex SaaS architectures and troubleshoot issues across multiple technology layers.

  • Experience reading, reviewing, or debugging source code and translating production findings into actionable engineering defects.

  • Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills, particularly during high-pressure, critical incidents.

  • Ability to navigate conflicting priorities while driving successful engineering outcomes and maintaining a strong customer focus.

  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation supporting production services.

  • Ability to work remotely within the United States while maintaining regular availability during morning business hours in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone to support collaboration with global R&D teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using AI assisted engineering tools or applying AI/ML

technologies to software development, troubleshooting, automation,

incident investigation, or operational workflows.

Idira Platform Experience (CyberArk)

  • Experience supporting the Idira Identity Security platform (formerly CyberArk), including one or more of the following products:

    • Identity Security Administration (ISA)

    • Secure Infrastructure Access (SIA)

    • Privilege Cloud

    • Tenant Management (TM)

  • Experience with Identity Security, Identity Governance, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity and Access Management (IAM), or enterprise cybersecurity solutions.

  • Experience troubleshooting distributed microservices, cloud-native applications, REST APIs, authentication flows, and modern SaaS architectures.

Cloud & Security

  • Experience working for a cybersecurity or enterprise security software company.

Tenant Management (TM)

  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell to create diagnostic tools, automate troubleshooting, and improve operational efficiency.

Secure Infrastructure Access (SIA)

  • Strong understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems, including:

    • User management

    • Process management

    • File system management

    • System administration fundamentals

​

Privilege Cloud (pCloud)

  • 3+ years of experience with C#, including the ability to debug new features and legacy code, identify software defects, and support root cause analysis in partnership with R&D.

jobs.excerpt: Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?
jobs.description:
Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the role

Syndio is the leader in compensation equity and pay decision intelligence, helping the world's largest employers make fair, defensible, and transparent pay decisions at scale. As Decisions moves to general availability and our enterprise footprint grows, the quantitative depth behind our recommendations has to keep pace.

The Senior Domain Expert (Labor Economics, Statistics, or IO) is a hands-on quantitative practitioner on the Applied Pay Intelligence team. You work directly with our customers and are a senior individual contributor role that leads a small squad. You are the person our customers, our product, and the rest of the team turn to when the methodology has to hold up under scrutiny.

You own an area of Syndio's methodology and asset library, build the 1:many resources that scale your expertise across the customer base, partner directly with Product to embed methodology into Decisions and Essentials, and show up in the customer conversations where the numbers and the reasoning have to be right. You will translate custom analytics into product requirements and support product and development teams as needed on design and implementation plans, partner with the data science and development teams to ensure the product helps advance the outcomes of our total rewards customers.

Why this job is exciting

  • Lead a squad. You will be an individual contributor but you will own an area of Syndio's methodology and content — comparator group logic, regression modeling, remediation methodology, or a related domain. Guide the squad's roadmap, prioritize what gets built, and hold the technical bar for the work that ships.
  • Apply methodology in complex customer situations. Work through the statistical questions customers can't resolve inside the product: unusual workforce structures, small-group modeling, contested comparator choices, novel regulatory tests. Bring the methods, explain the tradeoffs, defend the approach.
  • Build 1:many resources. Turn recurring methodological questions into durable content — customer briefings, methodology guides, model documentation, worked examples — so recurring questions do not require a recurring meeting.
  • Partner with Product. Work directly with Product and AI teams to embed methodology into Decisions and Essentials. Translate quantitative rigor into product logic, review model outputs, catch the edge cases before customers do.
  • Show up for the moments that matter. Anchor customer QBRs, regulatory inflection points, and board-adjacent conversations where the methodology has to hold. Not every meeting — the ones where getting the math and the framing right changes the outcome.
  • Feed the frameworks upward. Surface what current frameworks don't yet cover. Bring specific customer patterns and methodological gaps to the Principal-level colleagues and to Product so the platform's intelligence keeps compounding.

About you

  • 5+ years of hands-on quantitative work in labor economics, statistics, econometrics, industrial-organizational psychology, or a directly related field, applied to compensation, workforce, or pay equity questions.
  • Deep facility with regression modeling and comparator methodology. You can build a defensible pay equity model, explain what it does and does not tell you, and defend the choices behind it in front of a non-technical audience.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate quantitative rigor into language a CHRO, a works council, or a CSM can act on, without losing the substance.
  • Experience embedding methodology into a product, a tool, or a repeatable workflow that other people execute — not just running the analysis yourself.
  • Strong judgment on the difference between what the data supports and what the customer wants it to say, and comfort holding that line.
  • Track record of building content, documentation, or enablement materials that reduce reliance on your calendar over time.
  • Comfort thinking about how quantitative expertise translates into AI-mediated product capability.
  • Experience in HR tech, compensation, people analytics, or a similarly data-intensive enterprise domain is a strong plus.

Why you'll love it here:

  • 💰 Competitive Compensation. For this role our salary is targeted at $143,000 -$160,000 per year. Final offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience and expertise. We take a geo neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location.
  • 🏆 Syndio Equity. So you can share in Syndio’s success.
  • 🏝 Flexible Vacation Policy. We encourage our team to recharge when they need to, plus paid sick & safe time, compassion leave, and voting leave.
  • Paid parental leave
  • 🩺 Medical, Dental, Vision. Syndio pays 90% of employee premiums, and 50% for dependents.
  • 🏥 Life Insurance & Disability. Syndio covers the full premium.
  • 🏦 401(k). To help you save for your future
  • Fully remote model -

The interview overview

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for our Senior Domain Expert position. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

  • 30 min interview with a member of our Talent Team
  • 45 minute zoom interview with the Hiring Manager (VP Applied Pay Intelligence)
  • 45 minute zoom interview with a Product partner
  • Panel interview with Applied Pay Intelligence team members - 1 hour
  • Final interview with executive - 30 minutes

At Syndio, we're building a diverse team that values candor, curiosity, and community. If you share these values and are interested in joining us, we'd love to talk with you even if you don't 100% meet the "about you" listed here. We don't expect anyone to have all the answers, as long as you're willing to learn and grow with us.

Syndio is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are building an inclusive and collaborative workplace as we grow, and we welcome team members regardless of gender/identity, sexual orientation, race or cultural background, religion, physical disability and age.

jobs.description:
The Capability Architecture Specialist establishes and administers Fortive's enterprise skills taxonomy, beginning with an externally acquired library and adapting it to the language, roles and strategic capabilities that matter across Fortive. The role is accountable for taxonomy integrity, metadata quality, governance workflows, version control, disciplined change management, and vendor management.

This is a hands-on data stewardship role with meaningful stakeholder influence. The Specialist partners with Talent Partners, HRBPs, HR Operations, HR Technology and subject matter experts to evaluate requests, resolve ambiguity and protect enterprise consistency. The role must be able to explain decisions clearly and challenge unsupported changes while remaining pragmatic and service oriented.

OPERATING MODEL

1 ARCHITECTURE & INTEGRITY2 GOVERNANCE & CHANGE3 ENABLEMENT & ADOPTIONOwn the skills taxonomy structure, standards, metadata and quality.Run transparent intake, review, approval and version-control processes.Help HR teams use the architecture consistently in talent decisions and systems.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIESESTABLISH AND MAINTAIN THE ENTERPRISE CAPABILITY ARCHITECTURE

  • Stand up Fortive's enterprise skills taxonomy from the ground up using an externally acquired skills library as the starting point.
  • Define the architecture, including domains, categories, skills, definitions, aliases, proficiency descriptors, relationships and required metadata.
  • Create clear design principles and naming standards that balance external market language with Fortive-specific business relevance.
  • Partner with Talent Partners, HRBPs and functional subject matter experts to validate priority skill families and translate business needs into scalable taxonomy updates.
  • Establish the initial baseline, migration approach and release plan, including the treatment of duplicates, legacy terms and local variants.

ADMINISTER TAXONOMY DATA & QUALITY

  • Maintain the authoritative taxonomy record and execute additions, revisions, and archival decisions with precision.
  • Apply data-quality controls to identify duplicates, conflicting definitions, inconsistent levels, missing metadata and broken relationships.
  • Maintain documentation, decision logs, version history and release notes so changes are traceable, explainable and auditable.
  • Coordinate scheduled refreshes using vendor updates, internal demand signals, emerging technology and changing business capability requirements.
  • Prepare clean, structured data files and requirements for configuration or integration by HR Technology and platform owners.

GOVERN REQUESTS & MANAGE STAKEHOLDERS

  • Design and operate a practical intake, triage, review and approval process for taxonomy changes across enterprise and OpCo stakeholders.
  • Evaluate requests against agreed criteria, evidence and enterprise standards rather than stakeholder seniority or local preference.
  • Resolve conflicting requests, recommend the best enterprise solution and escalate only where a genuine policy or strategic decision is required.
  • Respond confidently and constructively to challenge from senior HRBPs and leaders, explaining trade-offs and protecting the usability of the enterprise architecture.
  • Set clear expectations on scope, decision rights, service levels and release timing, and communicate outcomes with transparency and respect.

ENABLE CONSISTENT USE & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

  • Create practical guidance, templates and self-service resources that help HR teams select and apply skills consistently.

OWNSINFLUENCESDOES NOT OWN

  • Enterprise skills taxonomy data and metadata
  • Taxonomy design and naming standards
  • Change intake, quality controls and version history
  • Recommendations on add, change, merge and retire decisions

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

jobs.description:
Zaelab is looking for a Release Manager to own and drive the software release process for a key client engagement.

In this role, you’ll bring structure, visibility, and predictability to how software moves into production. You’ll own the release process from planning and readiness through go-live and post-release stabilization, working across engineering, QA, DevOps, project teams, and client stakeholders to make sure everyone is aligned and releases happen smoothly.

This is not a hands-on development role. We’re looking for someone who understands the technical side of software delivery but thrives in the orchestration of it — connecting teams, anticipating risks, keeping dependencies moving, and making sure there is a clear plan when things don’t go as expected.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the release calendar — Build and manage the release schedule across the engagement, coordinating dependencies, freeze windows, environments, and competing workstreams.
  • Drive release readiness — Establish clear entry and exit criteria, facilitate go/no-go discussions, and ensure the right approvals are in place across engineering, QA, security, and client teams.
  • Lead cutover planning — Create detailed, actionable cutover plans with clear owners, timing, dependencies, and checkpoints. Coordinate dry runs and rehearsals for higher-risk releases.
  • Ensure rollback readiness — Make sure releases have documented and tested rollback plans, with clear triggers and decision ownership established before deployment.
  • Keep stakeholders aligned — Own release communications before, during, and after deployment, adapting the level of detail for technical teams, leadership, and client stakeholders.
  • Identify and manage risk — Surface potential blockers early, whether they’re related to testing, environments, dependencies, or timing, and bring forward clear mitigation options.
  • Improve how we release — Track release performance and trends, lead retrospectives, and continuously improve the processes that help teams ship reliably.
  • Partner with DevOps — Work closely with DevOps teams around deployment automation, environments, branching, and versioning. You won’t be expected to build pipelines, but you should understand how they work and how they impact release planning.

What You Bring:

  • 4+ years of experience in release management, delivery management, technical program management, or a similar role within software delivery.
  • Hands-on experience managing production releases end to end, including planning, readiness, go/no-go, cutover, and rollback.
  • Strong understanding of the SDLC, CI/CD concepts, deployment environments, and branching/versioning strategies.
  • Experience coordinating across engineering, QA, DevOps, project teams, and external or client stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear runbooks, release updates, and executive-level summaries.
  • A structured, calm approach to decision-making, particularly during high-pressure releases or production issues.
  • Experience working with tools such as Jira, Confluence, release workflows, and delivery dashboards.
  • Active use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot to work more effectively — whether creating release documentation, summarizing information, drafting communications, or improving workflows — combined with good judgment around validating AI-generated output.

  • Salesforce experience.

  • ITIL, SAFe Release Train Engineer, PMP, or similar certification.

You create clarity around releases before they happen. Teams know what is shipping, when it is shipping, who owns each step, what could go wrong, and what the plan is if it does.

You’re proactive rather than reactive, comfortable working across technical and business teams, and able to bring structure to complex client environments without adding unnecessary process.

MyTime is, at its heart, a product-driven organization because it delivers the most critical functions that allow a business to run from scheduling appointments to customer engagement to handling in-store and online payment processing. You will need to take full ownership of the development of specific areas of the product from strategy to execution.

You will be responsible for gathering and documenting customer requirements and translating them into stories for our design and development teams. From there, you’ll be expected to guide UX/UI design, define test cases, establish acceptance criteria, and work with the engineering team to ensure timely, defect-free launches. Finally, you’ll work closely with your peers in Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure customers are aware of upcoming changes to the product so as to minimize disruption to their day-to-day operations.

• Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to design and deliver new product capabilities that leverage Gen AI and LLM technologies to create transformative experiences.

• Defining detailed functional and technical requirements for new features and product enhancements.

• Building and managing multi-release roadmaps, ensuring alignment with strategic business goals and user needs.

• Partnering with UX/UI teams to create user-friendly, intuitive experiences that drive high engagement and measurable impact.

• Driving the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation to launch, and managing Epics & Stories to ensure smooth execution.

• Working closely with customer success, training, and support teams to ensure they are equipped with the knowledge to drive adoption and provide exceptional customer experiences.

• Analyzing product performance and customer feedback to continuously refine and improve the product.

• Using data analytics to make informed decisions, measure the effectiveness of AI-powered features, and drive future product improvements.

• Find a path to get things done despite roadblocks to get your work into the hands of users quickly and iteratively.

• Enjoy working in a fast-paced, design-driven, product development cycle.

This role will report into the VP of Product Management and will be fully remote.

  • 5+ years of B2B software product development / product management experience with a track record of launching successful features and managing them over multiple releases; Startup and SaaS experience preferred.
  • Evidence of a highly process driven and detail oriented approach with the ability to organize and document requirements in an understandable and actionable way.
  • Proven ability to work with a fast-paced, agile-driven engineering team, based on mutual trust, credibility, and respect.
  • Self-motivator with outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
  • Bachelors in Computer Science or Management Information Systems preferred.

MyTime is a fully remote company. The teams meet virtually throughout the day to collaborate. We provide a competitive base salary, performance bonus, startup equity, and healthcare benefits. We offer a transparent and exciting startup culture that is singularly focused on empowering people to make an impact in their jobs. We’re growing fast and solving a big problem, providing our employees the opportunity to make the tremendous impact that leads to true professional fulfilment. If you're interested, we'd love to talk!

MyTime is a fully integrated scheduling, payments, and automated marketing platform, specializing in large multi-location chains and franchises. Our mission critical software -- which includes in-store scheduling and online booking, client record management, email and SMS marketing, and a full point of sale for handling payments -- is used in every aspect of the customer journey. Our customers rely on their service businesses to remain competitive in the age of Amazon, and they need a next generation POS to help them achieve this growth. We aspire to be the AI-driven cloud based “operating system” of their business.

We also made it easy to plug our online booking, payments and messaging capabilities into the places customers are found today, including Google Search, Facebook, Instagram, and the merchants’ own websites and mobile apps. Upon adopting MyTime, our customers see average revenue growth of up to 30% through improved operational efficiency, greater customer retention, and access to new customer acquisition channels.

Our product is used at over 14,000 locations across the globe, ranging from single-location sole proprietors to multi-billion dollar Fortune 500 chains. As a completely cloud-based solution, MyTime is designed for quick and easy deployments. It’s lauded for its ease-of-use and short ramp-up time, having won numerous awards such as the Best Commerce Product of 2017 from the Local Search Association.

MyTime is backed by Upfront Ventures and Khosla Ventures and was founded by Ethan Anderson, a successful serial entrepreneur whose first startup, Redbeacon, won TechCrunch50 in 2009 and was acquired by The Home Depot.

Come help us realize our vision of becoming the world’s leading online scheduling and local commerce platform!

SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.

Job Description Summary:

The Commissioning Engineer is responsible for leading and supporting testing, commissioning, and initial energization activities for utility-scale high-voltage (HV) substations, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and photovoltaic (PV) facilities. This role requires some travel (approximately 20–30%) and active participation in field operations.

This position serves as the primary technical interface between Project Management, Owners, Utilities, OEMs, and Field Services, ensuring all commissioning and energization activities are executed safely, in compliance with project specifications, utility requirements, and applicable industry standards.

This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Job Description:

*This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned

Position Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Attend Owner, Utility, and stakeholder meetings as requested by the Commissioning Manager (PM).

  • Develop Testing & Commissioning (T&C) Plans aligned with project specifications, utility interconnection requirements, and industry standards.

  • Develop, review, and execute detailed Initial Energization Procedures for HV substations, the BESS facilities and the PV AC Power collection systems.

  • Lead and support initial substation energization activities, including readiness verification and field coordination.

  • Perform high voltage switching operations as required for initial energization and commissioning activities.

  • Perform or coordinate harmonic measurements and power quality assessments during commissioning and post-energization.

  • Develop substation operations and training documentation and deliver onsite training to Owner and Operations personnel.

  • Provide post-energization technical support, including system monitoring, troubleshooting, and commissioning closeout activities.

  • Provide on-call technical support for site events, including system trips and abnormal operating conditions.

  • Review EPC contract exhibits and project documentation to define Testing & Commissioning scope of work and division of responsibility (DOR).

  • Provide onsite training and mentor junior staff.

Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Minimum of 8–10 years of experience in testing and commissioning of HV substations, BESS, and utility-scale PV facilities.

  • 3-4 years’ experience performing and directing high voltage switching operations.

  • Strong technical knowledge of protection and control systems, power quality, and harmonic analysis.

  • 1-2 years of experience developing commissioning plans, energization procedures, and technical training materials.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interface effectively with Owners, Utilities, and internal stakeholders.

  • Proven commitment to safety, demonstrated by an excellent safety record, consistent compliance with company and client safety programs, and adherence to applicable OSHA, NFPA 70E, and utility switching and clearance procedures, including work in energized and high-risk electrical environments.

  • Electrical Engineer or 10yrs experience in utility scale substation testing or operations

  • High voltage switching experience

  • NETA Certification (Level II, III, or IV)

  • Experience with harmonic analyzers and power quality monitoring equipment.

46.000 - 56.000 € / Jahr

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Please Note: While assigned hours are generally consistent from week to week, there are no guaranteed minimal hours and positional needs will vary depending on Chaplain availability and Client requirements.

Chaplain Part-time Davenport, IA

Likely 2 to 4 hours per week

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.

Ministry

  • Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.
  • Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.
  • May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.
  • May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.
  • May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.
  • Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.
  • May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.
  • May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.
  • Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.
  • Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).
  • Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.
  • With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.

Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. jobs.description:
Overview

Verantos ( is the global leader in high-validity real-world evidence (RWE) for life sciences. By incorporating robust clinical narrative data, artificial intelligence (AI) technology, and measured validity, Verantos is the first company to generate research-grade evidence at scale across therapeutic areas.

The Verantos Evidence Platform integrates heterogeneous real-world data sources and generates evidence with the accuracy required for market access, health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), medical affairs, and regulatory use. Leveraging data science, AI, and advanced data sources such as electronic health records (EHRs), the platform supports complex clinical studies across multiple therapeutic areas. Today, some of the largest biopharma companies in the world are Verantos customers.

As a Senior Clinical Informaticist, you will help shape how clinical data is transformed and made usable for research by leading efforts in knowledge management, semantic normalization, and data quality. You will collaborate with clinicians, scientists, data scientists, product managers, and engineers to define scalable approaches for mapping clinical concepts, identify where and how key concepts can be captured, develop concept lists for cohort creation, and design clinical data quality checks to ensure datasets meet clinical expectations.

Your work will directly support high-impact research by ensuring that the right concepts are captured, standardized, and accessible across diverse data sources. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of clinical insight and technical implementation, transforming complex healthcare data into research-grade evidence that advances decision-making at scale.

Responsibilities

Knowledge management

  • Create and maintain concept groups.
  • Review customer code lists and recommend updates as needed.
  • List and define critical variables for each pragmatic registry.

Semantic normalization

  • Map claims data and health system data to standard concepts in the OMOP Common Data Model (CDM).
  • Semantically normalize CDM-converted data coming from multiple different health systems and map high priority unmapped concepts

Data usability

  • Create documentation on how to best use data to generate insights.
  • Collaborate with customers to help them understand how to leverage data to answer research questions.

Data Quality

  • Define disease-area–specific data quality testing processes.

Concept Identification

  • Determine how to best capture concepts needed to answer customer research questions and analyze prevalence of concepts for feasibility assessments.
  • Specify annotation projects to capture complex clinical ideas.

Qualifications

Required

  • MD or DO degree required; completion of an accredited residency program strongly preferred.
  • Minimum of 2 years of clinical experience required.
  • Experience working with standard clinical vocabularies such as SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD-10-CM, CPT, or HCPCS, including an understanding of their structure and use in representing clinical data.
  • Familiarity with EHR systems and common clinical documentation practices.
  • Strong understanding of data captured in structured EHRs, unstructured EHRs (e.g., clinical notes), and claims datasets, including which types of concepts each source best captures.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.

Preferred

  • Advanced training or certification in clinical informatics.
  • Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in clinical informatics or a closely related role.
  • Demonstrated expertise in semantic mapping of source clinical terms to standard vocabularies (e.g., SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS).
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills applied to complex clinical data challenges, such as resolving semantic ambiguity, aligning heterogeneous data sources, or developing scalable mapping solutions.
  • Experience defining and reviewing data quality tests on clinical datasets.
  • Experience with the OMOP Common Data Model.
  • Proficiency with terminology mapping tools.
  • Familiarity or experience with AI-based extraction from unstructured clinical notes.
  • Strong understanding of the hierarchical structure and relationships in standard clinical terminologies.
  • Proficiency in tools for data analysis or transformation (e.g., SQL, Excel, Python, or R).
  • Prior involvement in projects involving phenotyping or computable cohort definitions.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with technical teams to design and implement repeatable, scalable approaches to knowledge-driven workflows.
  • AI-first mindset, with a focus on leveraging automation to develop scalable, repeatable solutions for clinical data normalization, concept identification, and quality assessment.

Position: Instructor/Facilitator - Subject Matter Expert - 3 positions

Engagement Type: Consultancy

Location: Fully Remote, with extensive travel

McColm & Company (McColm) is a mission-driven and customer-focused professional services firm that equips change makers with the knowledge, skills, and insights they need to succeed in an increasingly complex world. McColm specializes in supporting U.S. federal customers with national security, human services, foreign affairs, and emergency response-focused portfolios by managing bespoke professional training programs, delivering effective capacity building solutions, and providing highly specialized technical assistance and analysis expertise to decision makers.

McColm’s Justice and Resilience Practice supports U.S. Government clients working to support the spiritual readiness of our Armed Forces. McColm seeks three Subject Matter Expert Instructor/Facilitators to deliver the U.S. Navy, Naval Chaplaincy School's annual Professional Development Training Course (PDTC). The FY2027 topic is Character Formation for Spiritual Readiness.

The position is fully remote and requires virtual meetings and briefings with government personnel and stakeholders, along with extensive travel.

This position is classed as a 1099 Independent Contractor.

Duties

The Instructor/Facilitator will be part of the three (3) person team. Duties include but are not necessarily limited to the following:

Preparation (September – December 2026)

  • Familiarize with curriculum and training materials
  • Participate in client meetings
  • Participate in Walk Thru and Validation events

Delivery (January – June 2027)

  • Deliver the 3-day PDTC at assigned field sites at assigned locations - there are 12 total deliveries
  • Arrive on site the day before each course and meet with NCS personnel and/or the host command chaplain to confirm readiness
  • Capture participant and host-command feedback after each event
  • Maintain professional appearance, conduct, and installation compliance standards throughout

Requirements

Education

  • PhD, DPhil, or thesis-based master’s degree (e.g., MA, STM, ThM) preferred
  • Professional doctorates and non-thesis master’s degrees will be considered based on relevant expertise and experience in the course topic

Experience and skills

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver engaging, high-impact presentations to large audiences (100+), sustaining attention across a full training day and driving clear course outcomes.
  • Working knowledge of institutional ministry in a pluralistic environment; able to quickly gain proficiency in the curriculum and execute with minimal oversight
  • Subject-matter depth in character formation, moral and spiritual development, virtue ethics, or a closely related field, and familiarity with current research on the topic
  • Practical experience instructing in the specialty area and comfort with instructional presentation technologies
  • Experience with, or strong understanding of, the U.S. Navy Chaplain Corps, military chaplaincy, or Sea Services ministry is highly desirable
  • Skilled facilitator of small-group activities, case studies, and scenario-based discussion, not only lecture

Eligibility and availability

  • U.S. citizen or otherwise authorized to work in the United States; fluent in written and spoken English
  • Able to obtain installation access credentials (DBIDS/visitor access) and to complete required Level I Antiterrorism Awareness and OPSEC awareness training
  • Valid U.S. passport with validity extending beyond July 2027, and eligibility for Letters of Authorization for overseas travel (Italy, Japan)
  • Available for the full engagement period and field schedule.
  • Willing and able to travel frequently, including long-haul international travel.
  • Prior experience supporting U.S. Government clients a plus.

Benefits

Compensation is offered according to job requirements, market dynamics, and experience/skills of the successful candidate. Contract and consultant roles are not eligible for benefits.

jobs.description:
DDC-ITS is seeking an experienced Sr. z/OS 3rd Party Software Support Technician to plan, implement, sustain, and provide technical guidance for IBM System z/OS third-party software, utilities, upgrades, and maintenance activities. This role supports mission-critical IBM mainframe environments and requires expertise in software installation, lifecycle management, troubleshooting, performance support, and systems integration within a parallel sysplex environment. The successful candidate will work independently and collaboratively to ensure software products remain secure, compliant, stable, and aligned with organizational change management processes.

Responsibilities:

  • Plan, implement, sustain and provide technical guidance for product installations, upgrades, and maintenance to include IBM System z/OS 3rd party software/utilities.

  • Initiate calls to the vendor to ascertain proper prerequisite software levels, report problems and receive follow-through procedures.

  • Assist in the management of the technical life cycle of the z/OS software product, package, or subsystem assigned.

  • Use IBM SMP/e to successfully receive and apply z/OS software on an IBM Mainframe. This requires experience interpreting SMP/e output messages to resolve software installation issues and requirements.

  • Use required software tools, including IBM SMP/e, IBM system utilities (including IEBGENER (generalized copy utility), IEBCOPY (utility to copy, compress, merge partitioned data sets), IDCAMS (access method services), to create, populate, update and configure required datasets and parameter libraries and members to successfully implement software installations and upgrades on the IBM mainframe platform.

  • Use system logs, create and interpret system traces and dumps, job output, and monitoring tools to diagnose and resolve IBM z/OS product abends on the IBM z/OS mainframe platform.

  • Provide customer support (internal and external) on questions and incidents relating to the software maintained on the mainframe systems, to include changes, upgrades, new and discontinued features, and known problems.

  • Ensure that all system resources required for software installation is available for successful implementation. Ensure shared storage resources and the tools used to manage resource sharing are properly maintained.

  • Provide technical, engineering, and consulting services/support in running software products in a parallel sysplex environment.

  • Ensure installed software products are compliant with the current mainframe OS.

  • Ensure new release/version analysis is performed outside of the production environment before deployment to production environments.

  • Initiate release processes based on an approved Release Management Change Advisory Board (RMCAB) change request for new Mainframe products and upgrades to existing products.

  • Develop test plans, test cases, and test data for each release test effort. Test plans will include security compliance, functional, integration, performance, and regression testing to detect and resolve flaws that may impact the security, integrity, and stability of the product. 

  • Coordinate with other system programmers and managers whenever the installation of a software product interfaces with another software product and will require changes to, or have an impact on, the other software. Contractor shall determine the impacts and risks to changes requested before change implementations are performed.

  • Ability to work in a team environment and share developed solutions for approval and implementation.

  • Adhere to, and participate in this organization’s Change Management and CAB policies and procedures.

  • Work independently, conduct research, and provide training for lower level employees.

Qualifications:

  • Years of Experience: 7-10 years

  • Education Level: Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math

  • Clearance Requirements: Secret

  • Certification Requirements: IAT-II

jobs.description:
Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

Prosper is growing 3x year over year and are at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 400+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

The Role

We're hiring Licensed Psychologists (Ph.D/Psy.D) to conduct autism assessments for adults via telehealth. You'll join a team dedicated to creating affordable, accessible diagnostic services while helping to shape best practices in adult autism assessment.

Our clinicians come from diverse backgrounds and career stages - whether you're building your career foundation, balancing work with other responsibilities, or expanding your clinical expertise, we offer flexibility to match your needs.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct comprehensive autism assessments for adults via telehealth
  • Deliver actionable feedback to clients following evaluations and develop personalized post-assessment plans
  • Write clear, thorough clinical reports that document findings and recommendations
  • Participate in case consultations and clinical collaborative opportunities
  • Focus on direct client care while we handle administrative tasks and insurance billing

What We Offer

Flexible Work Options:

  • Schedule autonomy (7am-10pm - 7days a week)
  • Part-time/Contract roles start at just 18 hours per week
  • Full-Time salaried positions available with benefits
  • Work from your private office or space, regardless of geographic location

Clinical Support Structure:

  • Administrative support including scheduling, billing and insurance done for you, not by you so you can focus on clinical work
  • Purpose-built technology for effective telehealth assessment and report writing
  • Paid, structured onboarding program - we will set you up for success no matter your level of experience with Autism
  • Inclusive, neurodiversity-affirming community of clinicians that values diverse perspectives and collaborative growth

Professional Development:

  • Regular case consultation groups and monthly case conferences in a Project ECHO format
  • Mentorship opportunities with experienced clinicians while you acclimate to our processes and systems
  • Clear career advancement opportunities with pathways to lead roles and clinical leadership positions

Benefits (Full-time Positions):

  • Comprehensive Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • 15 days PTO plus major holidays

What We Look For:

Required Qualifications:

  • Doctoral degree (PhD/PsyD) from an APA-accredited program
  • Current state licensure as a Licensed Psychologist with no disciplinary actions
  • Identity-affirming approach to patient care
  • Strong clinical judgment and clinical interview skills
  • Proficient remote communication abilities
  • Tech competence and self-direction
  • Desire to support an underserved population of autistic adults

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PSYPACT licensure or eligibility
  • Experience with adult diagnostic evaluations
  • Background working with neurodivergent populations

Join Our Team

Ready to transform lives while advancing your career? Apply today to join Prosper Health's team of dedicated professionals making a real difference for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Prosper Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those who identify as neurodivergent, LGBTQ+, or BIPOC.

For those interested in 1099 opportunities, we offer a per assessment rate, paid upon submission of the assessment.

Weekly pay
$1,650—$2,200 USD

We also offer salaried roles that come with full benefits.

Annual Salary Range
$100,000—$120,000 USD

More about Prosper Health

  • Our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindess, and high-performance. We set ambitious goals and hold ourselves accountable to achieving them.
  • We always ensure that we integrate perspectives from experts in our space, including clinicians and autistic self-advocates.
  • Our team members come from places such as Bain, McKinsey, BCG, FirstHand Health, Rula, SeatGeek, Benchling, and schools like Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Yale, Penn, Dartmouth, Northwestern, Vanderbilt, and more.
  • Here are a few of our favorite operating principles:
    • Clients first - Our job is to solve real problems for our clients. Choose what makes life better for the client, even if it’s harder for us. Never lose sight of the person on the other side.
    • Find a Way - We use ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination to bend the world to accomplish our goals. We’re resourceful and do more with less.
    • Raise the Bar - We grow deliberately, by asking how things can improve and by giving and seeking feedback. We insist on the highest standards and keep pushing them higher.
    • Be a Good Person - Be kind, be honest, and make it fun to work here. Tell the truth even when it’s uncomfortable. Treat people with respect and go out of your way to do nice things for your teammates.

jobs.description:
HireHawk is a fast-growing staffing and recruitment solutions company helping businesses build high-performing teams through both onshore and offshore hiring support. We partner with companies across multiple industries to solve hiring challenges, improve recruiting efficiency, reduce operational friction, and connect them with rigorously vetted talent.

HireHawk goes beyond traditional staffing by supporting the full hiring infrastructure companies need to scale, including recruiting, talent sourcing, payroll coordination, compliance support, onboarding workflows, and ongoing workforce management.

About the Role

This is a hands-on outbound GTM and sales execution role for someone who can build, manage, and continuously improve a scalable outbound engine.

The Outbound GTM Lead will own the infrastructure, workflows, and day-to-day systems required to keep HireHawk’s SDR team operating at full capacity. This includes lead list creation, prospect segmentation, contact enrichment, Apollo workflows, call prioritization, CRM processes, SDR enablement, call review, outbound reporting, and multichannel campaign development.

The immediate priority for this role is to strengthen and scale HireHawk’s phone-based outbound motion by ensuring SDRs consistently have high-quality, relevant prospects to call, clear scripts and qualification criteria, structured follow-up processes, and actionable coaching based on call performance.

As the outbound engine matures, this role will also build and optimize additional outbound channels, including email and LinkedIn, to support or independently generate qualified opportunities.

This is not a pure marketing role and not a traditional Account Executive role. The focus is on building the systems, processes, messaging, and SDR execution required to generate more qualified meetings and create a predictable outbound pipeline.

The Outbound GTM Lead will work closely with SDRs, sales leadership, and account management to ensure HireHawk’s outbound motion is structured, measurable, repeatable, scalable, and aligned with our staffing and recruitment services.

Responsibilities:

Outbound Infrastructure & List Building

  • Build, optimize, and manage HireHawk’s outbound infrastructure across Apollo, CRM systems, sales engagement tools, data enrichment platforms, and reporting systems.
  • Own lead list creation, prospect segmentation, contact enrichment, phone-number validation, sequence setup, and outbound campaign execution.
  • Develop high-quality prospect lists segmented by ICP, industry, buyer persona, geography, company size, hiring activity, hiring signals, and staffing need.
  • Ensure SDRs consistently have sufficient volumes of high-quality, phone-ready prospects to maintain strong daily calling activity.
  • Build repeatable systems for sourcing, enriching, validating, prioritizing, and routing leads to SDRs.
  • Continuously improve list quality based on connect rates, conversation quality, meeting conversion, and SDR feedback.
  • Identify and test new prospecting signals, data sources, and enrichment methods that improve outbound performance.

SDR Enablement & Call Performance

  • Partner closely with SDRs to improve daily outbound execution, call prioritization, productivity, follow-up discipline, and qualified meeting conversion.
  • Regularly review SDR call recordings and live call performance to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Provide actionable feedback and coaching on call openings, value propositions, qualification, objection handling, follow-up, and meeting conversion.
  • Develop and continuously improve cold-call scripts, talk tracks, objection-handling frameworks, and follow-up cadences.
  • Track recurring objections and market feedback and use those insights to improve targeting, messaging, scripts, and campaign strategy.
  • Help establish realistic activity and conversion benchmarks for SDR performance.
  • Build repeatable SDR playbooks, SOPs, workflows, training materials, and call-review processes.

Outbound Strategy & Multichannel Growth

  • Build and optimize outbound workflows across cold calling, email, LinkedIn, and CRM-based follow-up.
  • Prioritize channels based on measurable business impact rather than activity alone.
  • Initially focus on strengthening HireHawk’s phone-based outbound engine before scaling additional outbound channels.
  • Develop email and LinkedIn outbound programs once the core SDR calling process is operating effectively.
  • Determine when email and LinkedIn should function as follow-up and air-cover channels versus independent lead-generation channels.
  • Develop persona-specific and industry-specific messaging based on buyer pain points, market feedback, and campaign performance.
  • Run structured outbound experiments across ICPs, messaging, channels, call scripts, and hiring signals.

Analytics, Reporting & Process Improvement

Analyze SDR activity and outbound campaign performance across:

  • dials
  • connect rates
  • conversations
  • positive conversations
  • meetings booked
  • show rates
  • qualified meetings
  • qualified opportunities
  • conversion rates
  • performance by list, persona, industry, and campaign
  • Identify where outbound conversion is breaking down across list quality, targeting, messaging, call execution, follow-up, or qualification.
  • Build and maintain dashboards that make outbound performance clear and actionable.
  • Use performance data to continuously improve lists, scripts, workflows, SDR execution, and campaign strategy.
  • Maintain CRM hygiene, accurate lead stages, follow-up tasks, campaign attribution, and reporting discipline.
  • Reduce unnecessary manual work through automation while maintaining high data quality and strong SDR execution.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in a staffing agency, recruitment firm, RPO, talent acquisition company, HR services business, or workforce solutions company.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and managing outbound prospecting workflows using Apollo or similar sales intelligence and engagement platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience creating, enriching, validating, segmenting, and prioritizing outbound prospect lists.
  • Strong understanding of outbound cold calling, SDR workflows, call prioritization, prospecting sequences, follow-up cadences, and qualified meeting generation.
  • Experience working directly with SDRs or BDRs and improving their performance through call review, coaching, scripts, objection handling, and process development.
  • Ability to analyze outbound funnel performance and identify whether problems are caused by targeting, list quality, messaging, call execution, follow-up, or qualification.
  • Experience building or improving outbound sales systems and processes from the ground up.
  • Experience creating multichannel outbound campaigns across phone, email, LinkedIn, and CRM-based follow-up.
  • Strong understanding of staffing and recruitment buyer personas, pain points, objections, and sales motions.
  • Experience creating outbound messaging, cold-call scripts, email copy, LinkedIn messaging, and objection-handling frameworks.
  • Experience using AI and automation tools to improve list quality, prospect research, hiring-signal identification, segmentation, personalization, campaign development, and workflow efficiency.
  • Strong analytical and operational mindset with the ability to translate outbound performance data into practical improvements.
  • Highly organized, process-driven, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Comfortable joining live sales calls, listening to SDR recordings, reviewing call notes, and providing direct performance feedback.
  • Comfortable being hands-on with execution rather than operating only at a strategy or management level.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Clay, Instantly, Smartlead, Zapier, Make, or similar GTM tools.
  • Experience managing or supporting high-volume cold-calling environments.
  • Familiarity with power dialers, parallel dialing, call analytics, and SDR productivity tools.
  • Experience developing outbound motions targeting U.S.-based SMBs and mid-market companies.
  • Experience building outbound systems in a startup or high-growth environment with limited resources.
  • Experience improving outbound performance without significantly increasing SDR headcount.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted lead research, enrichment, segmentation, call analysis, and messaging workflows.

What success looks like:

Within the first 30–60 days:

  • SDRs consistently have enough high-quality, phone-ready prospects to maintain strong daily outbound activity.
  • Prospecting and list-building workflows are structured, repeatable, and increasingly automated.
  • Call scripts, objection handling, qualification criteria, and follow-up processes are clearly documented and actively improving.
  • SDR calls are reviewed regularly and coaching is tied to measurable performance data.
  • Outbound reporting clearly identifies where conversion is succeeding or breaking down.

Within the first 90 days:

  • HireHawk has a repeatable and scalable phone-first outbound system.
  • Manual list-building requirements have been significantly reduced.
  • SDR productivity and qualified meeting generation have improved.
  • Clear outbound playbooks and SOPs are in place.
  • Email and LinkedIn campaigns are being tested and scaled based on their ability to support or independently generate qualified opportunities.
  • The outbound engine is structured well enough to support additional SDR headcount without creating operational bottlenecks.

We are looking for a Principal product manager to lead the team building out AI Observability and Evaluation features used by developers to measure the accuracy, relevance, performance and safety of artificial intelligence models, agents and RAG applications. You’ll operate with one foot in the factory and one foot in the field, bridging between our customers and our engineering team. You’ll translate the needs of our customers for ensuring their models and agents perform reliably before and during production.

Qualifications

  • Perform primary research, interviewing end-users and buyers to deeply understand their AI Observability and Evaluation needs and benefits sought.
